features.name: Geestbrug

facts.text: The first bridge opened in 1350 to restore a road cut by the newly dug Haagvliet.
facts.sourceQuote: De historie van de Geestbrug gaat terug tot 1350 toen de eerste brug over de net gegraven Haagvliet geopend werd; deze moest de bestaande weg over de strandwal van Voorburg naar Rijswijk herstellen, die nu immers door de Trekvliet of Haagvliet werd doorsneden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The history of the Geestbrug dates back to 1350 when the first bridge over the newly dug Haagvliet was opened; this had to restore the existing road over the beach wall of Voorburg to Rijswijk, which was now cut through by the Trekvliet or Haagvliet.

facts.text: A double lift bridge replaced the old fixed structure in 1892 before the current bascule version arrived.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1892 werd de oude vaste brug vervangen door een dubbele ophaalbrug. In 1933 werd de huidige basculebrug geopend als verbinding tussen de Geestbrugweg in Rijswijk en de Prinses Mariannelaan in Voorburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1892, the old fixed bridge was replaced by a double lift bridge. In 1933, the current bascule bridge was opened as a connection between the Geestbrugweg in Rijswijk and the Prinses Mariannelaan in Voorburg.

facts.text: About 200 Spaniards died during the Battle of the Geestbrug following their defeat in Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de terugtocht van de in 1574 in Leiden verslagen Spanjaarden, die met rond 1100 man onder bevel van Don Alonzo Lopez Gallio naar Den Haag trokken om daar te overwinteren, volgde met onder anderen de Geuzen de Slag bij de Geestbrug. Tijdens deze veldslag lieten zo'n 200 Spanjaarden het leven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the retreat of the Spaniards defeated in Leiden in 1574, who with around 1100 men under the command of Don Alonzo Lopez Gallio marched to The Hague to winter there, the Battle of the Geestbrug followed, among others, by the Geuzen. During this battle, about 200 Spaniards lost their lives.

facts.text: Rijswijk lost its border with Voorburg at this site in 2002.

facts.text: A planned tunnel under the water was instead built under the residential area Voorburg-West.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nijmegen also has a Trêveszaal (in the Town Hall). The Treaty of Nijmegen was signed there in 1679.

facts.text: The Trêveszaal takes its name from the 1608 peace negotiations held there between the Dutch Republic and Spain.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1608 vonden in een van deze vertrekken vredesonderhandelingen plaats tussen de Republiek der Zeven Verenigde Nederlanden en de Spanjaarden. De Trêveszaal of Bestandszaal, zou hier later zijn naam aan ontlenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1608, peace negotiations took place in one of these rooms between the Republic of the Seven United Provinces and the Spanish. The Trêveszaal or Archive Hall, would later take its name from here.

facts.text: In 1588, the States-General began using rooms on this site for their meetings.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1588 begon de Staten-Generaal gebruik te maken van vergaderruimten in de gebouwen die toen op deze plaats stonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1588, the States-General began to use meeting rooms in the buildings that were then located on this site.

facts.text: The King delivers his annual Speech from the Throne here every third Tuesday of September.
facts.sourceQuote: Every third Tuesday of September, on Prinsjesdag, this is where the King holds his annual Speech from the Throne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Every third Tuesday of September, on Prinsjesdag, this is where the King holds his annual Speech from the Throne.

facts.text: The Prime Minister's office has occupied the small northern tower called the Torentje since 1982.
facts.sourceQuote: The Prime Minister's office has since 1982 been located in the small tower in the northern corner, simply called the Torentje ("Little Tower").
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Prime Minister's office has since 1982 been located in the small tower in the northern corner, simply called the Torentje ("Little Tower").

features.name: Kunstmuseum Den Haag

facts.text: Victoria Hefting became the museum's first female director shortly after World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Soon after the war, the Gemeentemuseum appointed its first female director, Victoria Hefting – one of the first women to assume such a position in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Soon after the war, the Gemeentemuseum appointed its first female director, Victoria Hefting – one of the first women to assume such a position in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Hefting was forced to resign in 1950 because married women were legally barred from government service.
facts.sourceQuote: Unfortunately, her time as director was short. Hefting remarried in 1950 and was obliged to resign. it was legally not permitted for married women to work in government services, a law that would not be repealed until 1957.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Unfortunately, her time as director was short. Hefting remarried in 1950 and was obliged to resign. it was legally not permitted for married women to work in government services, a law that would not be repealed until 1957.

facts.text: The institution was founded in 1866 as the Museum voor Moderne Kunst before adopting its current name.
facts.sourceQuote: The Kunstmuseum Den Haag is an art museum in The Hague in the Netherlands, founded in 1866 as the Museum voor Moderne Kunst. Later, until 1998, it was known as Haags Gemeentemuseum, and until the end of September 2019 as Gemeentemuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kunstmuseum Den Haag is an art museum in The Hague in the Netherlands, founded in 1866 as the Museum voor Moderne Kunst. Later, until 1998, it was known as Haags Gemeentemuseum, and until the end of September 2019 as Gemeentemuseum Den Haag.

features.opening: The Kunstmuseum Den Haag is an art museum in The Hague in the Netherlands, founded in 1866 as the Museum voor Moderne Kunst.

features.name: Beeld en Geluid Den Haag

facts.text: In 2019, the institution was renamed after being taken over by the Hilversum organization.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2019 werd het museum overgenomen door het Hilversumse Beeld en Geluid en kreeg de naam Beeld en Geluid Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2019, the museum was taken over by the Hilversumse Beeld and Geluid and was renamed Beeld en Geluid Den Haag.

facts.text: The institution was established in 1929 under the original name 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum'.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum is 1929 als Stichting 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum' opgericht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 1929 as a foundation called 'Het Nederlandsche Postmuseum'.

facts.text: Despite its name, the museum covered telegraphy and telephony alongside mail history and philately.
facts.sourceQuote: Anders dan de naam doet vermoeden, was het een museum over de geschiedenis van post, filatelie (het verzamelen en de studie van postzegels en bijbehorende zaken), telegrafie en telefonie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Contrary to the name suggests, it was a museum about the history of mail, philately (the collection and study of stamps and related items), telegraphy and telephony.

features.opening: Beeld & Geluid in Den Haag is in 1929 opgericht als Postmuseum.

features.name: Kerk van Eikenduinen

facts.text: Count William II of Holland founded the Kerk van Eikenduinen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd gesticht door graaf Willem II van Holland en verkreeg bekendheid door de aanwezigheid van een bijzonder reliek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded by Count William II of Holland and gained fame due to the presence of a special relic.

facts.text: A cemetery named Oud Eik en Duinen emerged around the ruin over centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: Tegenwoordig wordt de resterende ruïne, een rijksmonument, vooral geassocieerd met de begraafplaats die in de loop van de eeuwen rondom de ruïne ontstond, Oud Eik en Duinen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Nowadays, the remaining ruin, a national monument, is mainly associated with the cemetery that emerged over the centuries around the ruin, Oud Eik and Duinen.

facts.text: Bishop Jan van Diest officially permitted the conversion of this chapel into a parish church in 1331.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1331 gaf bisschop Jan van Diest van Utrecht toestemming de kapel te verbouwen tot een echte parochiekerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1331, Bishop Jan van Diest of Utrecht gave permission to convert the chapel into a real parish church.

features.opening: De Kerk van Eikenduinen, beter bekend onder de naam Ruïne of Kapel van Eikenduinen, was een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw gelegen in de oude duinen tussen…

features.name: The Hague Academy of International Law

facts.text: Inauguration was delayed by WWI, with the first summer courses starting in July 1923.
facts.sourceQuote: The inauguration of the academy was planned for October 1914 but was delayed by the outbreak of World War I in the preceding summer, and preparations could not be resumed until 1921. When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The inauguration of the academy was planned for October 1914 but was delayed by the outbreak of World War I in the preceding summer, and preparations could not be resumed until 1921. When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.

facts.text: The academy received 353 students from 31 countries at its 1923 opening, including 35 women.
facts.sourceQuote: When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the Summer Courses started on 14 July 1923 at the Peace Palace, 353 students originating from 31 countries attended, of whom 35 were women.

facts.text: Twelve judges of the International Court of Justice have studied or taught here.
facts.sourceQuote: The academy's alumni, faculty, and administration have included heads of state; foreign ministers; ambassadors; 12 judges of the International Court of Justice; one former secretary-general of the United Nations, Boutros Boutros-Ghali; and two Nobel Prize recipients.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The academy's alumni, faculty, and administration have included heads of state; foreign ministers; ambassadors; 12 judges of the International Court of Justice; one former secretary-general of the United Nations, Boutros Boutros-Ghali; and two Nobel Prize recipients.

facts.text: Courses are conducted in English and French, except for specific external programs.
facts.sourceQuote: Courses are taught in English and French and, except for External Programme Courses, are held in the Peace Palace.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Courses are taught in English and French and, except for External Programme Courses, are held in the Peace Palace.

features.opening: The Hague Academy of International Law (French: Académie de droit international de La Haye) is a center for high-level education in both public and private…

features.name: Internationaal Homomonument

facts.text: After 47 submissions, the unanimous choice was the design by Hague artist Theo ten Have.
facts.sourceQuote: Na een voorronde waarbij 47 inzendingen werden ontvangen volgde voor de drie als meest geschikt beoordeelde ontwerpen een kans om deze verder uit te werken. Daarna viel uiteindelijk unaniem de keuze op het ontwerp van de Haagse kunstenaar Theo ten Have.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After a preliminary round in which 47 submissions were received, the three designs judged to be most suitable had the opportunity to further develop them. After that, the choice ultimately fell unanimously on the design of the Hague artist Theo ten Have.

facts.text: The statue is steel on a granite pedestal rising more than seven meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: Het werd omschreven als een stalen beeld op een granito voetstuk van ruim zeven meter hoogte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was described as a steel statue on a granite pedestal of more than seven meters high.

facts.text: Blue represents awareness, knots symbolize conflicts, and rising pink stands for liberation.
facts.sourceQuote: Het blauw is de basis voor de bewustwording, de knopen erin symboliseren de conflicten en het omhoog reikende roze staat voor de bevrijding.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The blue is the basis for the awareness, the knots in it symbolize the conflicts and the rising pink stands for liberation.

facts.text: Internationaal Homomonument means International Homomonument, honoring global victims of sexual orientation persecution.
facts.sourceQuote: Het dient ter herdenking van alle lesbische vrouwen en homoseksuele mannen in de wereld die vervolgd en onderdrukt zijn of worden vanwege hun geaardheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It serves as a memorial to all lesbian women and gay men in the world who have been persecuted and oppressed or are being persecuted and oppressed because of their sexual orientation.

facts.text: Dutch artist Theo ten Have designed this 1993 memorial located at the Koekamp in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: Internationaal Homomonument Den Haag is een gedenkteken uit 1993 aan de Koekamp in Den Haag, ontworpen door Theo ten Have.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Internationaal Homomonument Den Haag is a monument from 1993 at the Koekamp in The Hague, designed by Theo ten Have.

facts.text: The monument remembers all lesbian women and gay men worldwide facing oppression due to their sexual orientation.
facts.sourceQuote: Het dient ter herdenking van alle lesbische vrouwen en homoseksuele mannen in de wereld die vervolgd en onderdrukt zijn of worden vanwege hun geaardheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It serves as a memorial to all lesbian women and gay men in the world who have been persecuted and oppressed or are being persecuted and oppressed because of their sexual orientation.

features.opening: Internationaal Homomonument Den Haag is een gedenkteken uit 1993 aan de Koekamp in Den Haag, ontworpen door Theo ten Have.

features.name: Museon-Omniversum

facts.text: Frits van Paasschen initiated the museum in 1904 to teach children about industry.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was initiated in 1904 by the newspaper director Frits van Paasschen, who wanted to establish a museum where children could learn about industry.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was initiated in 1904 by the newspaper director Frits van Paasschen, who wanted to establish a museum where children could learn about industry.

facts.text: Geologist Herman van Cappelle redirected the collection toward natural history and ethnology.
facts.sourceQuote: Under the museum's first director, the geologist Herman van Cappelle, the collection policy moved towards natural history and ethnology.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Under the museum's first director, the geologist Herman van Cappelle, the collection policy moved towards natural history and ethnology.

facts.text: The original industrial vision was never realized despite being the founding concept.
facts.sourceQuote: Although science and technology became important domains for the museum, the original idea has never been realized.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although science and technology became important domains for the museum, the original idea has never been realized.

facts.text: Museon-Omniversum derives its short name from the original Dutch Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Museon is a shortening of the museum's original extended Dutch name - Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Museon is a shortening of the museum's original extended Dutch name - Museum ten bate van het Onderwijs.

facts.text: In 2022, this museum merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum to become Museon-Omniversum: One Planet.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2022, the museum has been merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum, and goes by the name Museon-Omniversum: One Planet
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2022, the museum has been merged with the nearby cinema Omniversum, and goes by the name Museon-Omniversum: One Planet

facts.text: The institution houses extensive collections spanning geology, biology, archaeology, and ethnology.
facts.sourceQuote: It has an extensive collections in the domains of geology, biology, archaeology, history, science and ethnology.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has an extensive collections in the domains of geology, biology, archaeology, history, science and ethnology.

features.opening: Museon is a museum for science and culture in The Hague, Netherlands, with a strong focus on education.

features.name: Vissersmonument

facts.text: The oldest Vissersmonument was unveiled on September 26, 1922 to honor fishermen killed in World War I.
facts.sourceQuote: Het oudste ervan werd op 26 september 1922 onthuld ter nagedachtenis aan die Scheveningse vissers, die tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog door oorlogsgeweld op zee het leven hadden gelaten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The oldest of them was unveiled on September 26, 1922 in memory of those Scheveningen fishermen who lost their lives during World War I due to war violence at sea.

facts.text: Scheveningen actually contains a trio of distinct Vissersmonument memorials rather than just one.
facts.sourceQuote: Scheveningen telt een drietal Vissersmonumenten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scheveningen has a trio of Vissersmonumenten.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina unveiled the memorial in September 1922 alongside her husband Prince Henry.
facts.section: Daar waar nacht noch nevel is
facts.sourceQuote: Het kunstwerk is ontworpen door een Scheveningse architect en het werd in september 1922 officieel onthuld door koningin Wilhelmina. Zij werd vergezeld door haar echtgenoot, prins Hendrik.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The artwork was designed by a Scheveningen architect and was officially unveiled in September 1922 by Queen Wilhelmina. She was accompanied by her husband, Prince Henry.

facts.text: An inscription comforts widows with the phrase They are there where there is neither night nor fog.
facts.section: Daar waar nacht noch nevel is
facts.sourceQuote: Eronder, in een kleinere belettering, staat voor de gelovige vissersweduwen en hun wezen de troostgevende tekst: Zij zijn daar waar nacht noch nevel is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Below, in smaller lettering, is the comforting text for the faithful fishermen's widows and their dependents: They are there where there is neither night nor fog.

features.opening: Scheveningen telt een drietal Vissersmonumenten.

features.name: KB, nationale bibliotheek

facts.text: KB, nationale bibliotheek received its 'Royal' title in 1806 from King Louis Bonaparte.
facts.sourceQuote: King Louis Bonaparte gave the national library in 1806 the predicate 'Royal'.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: King Louis Bonaparte gave the national library in 1806 the predicate 'Royal'.

facts.text: Napoleon transferred the Royal Library to The Hague while allowing Paris to seize publications.
facts.sourceQuote: Napoleon Bonaparte transferred the Royal Library to The Hague as property, while also allowing the Imperial Library in Paris to expropriate publications from the Royal Library.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Napoleon Bonaparte transferred the Royal Library to The Hague as property, while also allowing the Imperial Library in Paris to expropriate publications from the Royal Library.

facts.text: The library's founding collection relied on books confiscated from William V.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection would be based on the confiscated book collection of William V.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection would be based on the confiscated book collection of William V.

facts.text: KB, nationale bibliotheek holds the world's first web collection granted UNESCO Memory of the World status.
facts.sourceQuote: It is the first web collection in the world that has been granted this status.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is the first web collection in the world that has been granted this status.

features.opening: The KB National Library of the Netherlands (legal Dutch name: Koninklijke Bibliotheek [ˈkoːnɪŋkləkə ˌbiblijoːˈteːk] 'Royal Library', or KB [kaːˈbeː]) is the…

features.name: World Peace Flame

facts.text: Seven flames from five continents merged in Bangor on July 31, 1999 to create the World Peace Flame.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 31 juli 1999 werden zeven vlammen vanaf vijf continenten samengebracht in Bangor in Noord-Wales. Van die zeven vlammen werd een achtste vlam gemaakt, de Vlam van de Wereldvrede.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On July 31, 1999, seven flames from five continents were brought together in Bangor, North Wales. From those seven flames an eighth flame was made, the Flame of World Peace.

facts.text: The initiative stems from the Life Foundation, co-founded by guru Mansukh Patel in 1978.
facts.sourceQuote: De vredesvlam is een initiatief van de spirituele en charitatieve instelling Life Foundation. Deze stichting werd in 1978 opgericht, onder meer door de (zelf benoemde) goeroe Mansukh Patel, die ook bekendstaat om zijn vredeswandelingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The peace flame is an initiative of the spiritual and charitable institution Life Foundation. This foundation was founded in 1978, among other things by the (self-proclaimed) guru Mansukh Patel, who is also known for his peace marches.

facts.text: The surrounding path features 196 stones representing nations, including pieces from the Berlin Wall and Robben Island.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument wordt sinds 2004 omringd door het "Wereldvredespad" langs een rand van 196 stenen en steentjes uit 196 landen. Sommige stenen zijn bijzonder: zo ligt er een brok steen uit de Berlijnse Muur en een steen van Robbeneiland, de plek waar Nelson Mandela jarenlang gevangen zat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2004, the monument has been surrounded by the "World Peace Path" along a border of 196 stones and pebbles from 196 countries. Some stones are special: there is a piece of stone from the Berlin Wall and a stone from Robben Island, the place where Nelson Mandela was imprisoned for years.

facts.text: Visitors are invited to add their own prayer for peace while walking around the monument since its 2004 opening.
facts.sourceQuote: Opened April 2004 Please add your prayer for peace as you walk around.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Opened April 2004 Please add your prayer for peace as you walk around.

features.opening: De Wereldvredesvlam is een sinds 1999 brandende vlam in Wales.

features.name: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag

facts.text: The pedestal reads Door Burgers Daad, on Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel van de beeldengroep is de tekst te lezen Door Burgers Daad, op Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal of the sculpture group can be read the text Door Burgers Daad, on Maurits Raad deez Cingel Ontstaat.

facts.text: Sculptor Joop van Lunteren created this monument in 1932.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd geplaatst in 1932 en is van de hand van de beeldhouwer Joop van Lunteren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was placed in 1932 and was created by the sculptor Joop van Lunteren.

facts.text: Maurits received permission only for a wide embankment because he lacked approval to fortify the city.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij kreeg geen toestemming van de Staten van Holland om de stad te ommuren, wel om een brede verdedigingssingel aan te leggen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He did not receive permission from the States of Holland to fortify the city, but to build a wide defensive embankment.

features.opening: Prins Maurits en de burgers van Den Haag is een monument ter ere van prins Maurits dat zich bevindt op de Heerenbrug in Den Haag.

features.name: Spinozahuis

facts.text: The painter Jan van Goyen commissioned the house in 1646 before selling it to Havick Steen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het huis werd in 1646 gebouwd in opdracht van de schilder Jan van Goyen die het verkocht aan Havick Steen, de vader van Jan Steen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built in 1646 at the behest of the painter Jan van Goyen who sold it to Havick Steen, the father of Jan Steen.

facts.text: Visitors can consult specialized studies on Spinoza within the house's dedicated study room by appointment.
facts.sourceQuote: In Domus Spinozana bevindt zich een studiezaal en bibliotheek waar bezoekers op afspraak studies over Spinoza kunnen raadplegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Domus Spinozana there is a study room and library where visitors can consult studies on Spinoza by appointment.

features.opening: Domus Spinozana of Spinozahuis is een huis aan de Paviljoensgracht 72 in Den Haag, Nederland, waar de filosoof Spinoza verbleef tot aan zijn dood.

features.name: Catshuis

facts.text: Jacob Cats, a prominent poet and politician, lived in the building starting July 14, 1652.
facts.sourceQuote: As Huis Sorgvliet it was built on the site of a former farm, part of the living quarters were likely incorporated in the left wing, by Jacob Cats (1577–1660), a prominent poet and politician who lived there from 14 July 1652.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As Huis Sorgvliet it was built on the site of a former farm, part of the living quarters were likely incorporated in the left wing, by Jacob Cats (1577–1660), a prominent poet and politician who lived there from 14 July 1652.

facts.text: Hans Willem Bentinck acquired the estate in 1675 as chamberlain to future King-Stadholder William III.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1675 estate Sorgvliet came into the possession of Hans Willem Bentinck, chamberlain of the future King-Stadholder William III (1650–1702).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1675 estate Sorgvliet came into the possession of Hans Willem Bentinck, chamberlain of the future King-Stadholder William III (1650–1702).

facts.text: A bronze bell and tower were installed by Willem Bentinck in 1738.
facts.sourceQuote: His son, Willem Bentinck, had a bronze bell and tower installed in 1738.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His son, Willem Bentinck, had a bronze bell and tower installed in 1738.

facts.text: Dries van Agt was the last prime minister to actually live in this official residence.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been the official residence of the Prime Minister of the Netherlands since 1963, although Dries van Agt was the last premier to live there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been the official residence of the Prime Minister of the Netherlands since 1963, although Dries van Agt was the last premier to live there.

facts.text: Jacob Cats originally commissioned the villa as his private home between 1651 and 1652.
facts.sourceQuote: Built between 1651 and 1652 for Jacob Cats as private villa, it was renamed after him after his death.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Built between 1651 and 1652 for Jacob Cats as private villa, it was renamed after him after his death.

features.opening: The Catshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈkɑtsɦœys]; English: Cats House), initially known as Huis Sorgvliet ([ˌɦœys ˈsɔr(ə)xflit]; Sorgvliet House), is the…

features.name: Bethelkerk

facts.text: The walls feature clean masonry with forty-two penances standing ten meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: De wanden bestaan uit schoon metselwerk met 42 penanten van 10 meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The walls consist of clean masonry with 42 penances 10 meters high.

facts.text: Ninety-three solar panels cover the roof of this historic church building.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het dak van de kerk bevinden zich 93 zonnepanelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are 93 solar panels on the roof of the church.

facts.text: Since 2016, church services have been broadcast via a livestream to viewers.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 2016 worden de kerkdiensten ook uitgezonden via een livestream.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 2016, the church services will also be broadcast via a livestream.

facts.text: Light enters through stained glass figures interspersed with colored lead glass.
facts.sourceQuote: Daartussen treed licht naar binnen door een mozaïek van figuurglas afgewisseld met gekleurd glas in lood.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Light enters through a mosaic of stained glass figures interspersed with colored lead glass.

features.opening: De Bethelkerk is een protestantse kerk in de Jurriaan Kokstraat te Scheveningen in de Nederlandse gemeente Den Haag.

features.name: Sinti- en Roma monument

facts.text: Construction errors required the monument to be completely disassembled and rebuilt with a new structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Nog voordat het monument officieel kon worden onthuld, werden er ernstige constructiefouten zichtbaar. Het monument werd verwijderd, uit elkaar gehaald en met een geheel nieuwe constructie weer in elkaar gezet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before the monument could be officially unveiled, serious construction errors became visible. The monument was removed, disassembled and reassembled with a completely new construction.

facts.text: A resident of Bilderdijkstraat joined a Sinti relative to negotiate a better solution with the municipality.
facts.sourceQuote: Een bewoner van de Bilderdijkstraat benaderde samen met een van de Sinti nabestaanden de gemeente, om te zien of een betere oplossing mogelijk was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A resident of Bilderdijkstraat approached the municipality together with one of the Sinti relatives, to see if a better solution was possible.

facts.text: On May 16, 1944, Dutch police and NSB members dragged the Berger family from their home to Westerbork.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gezin werd in de vroege ochtend van 16 mei 1944 samen met 18 andere Haagse zigeunergezinnen door Nederlandse politiemensen en NSB-landwachten uit hun huis gesleept en naar Westerbork overgebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the early morning of May 16, 1944, the family was dragged out of their home together with 18 other Hague Romani families by Dutch police officers and NSB farmers to Westerbork.

features.opening: Het Roma en Sinti-monument in de Haagse Vondelstraat tegenover de Bilderdijkstraat is een kubusvormig object met een bronzen herinneringsplaquette.

features.name: Zij waren eensgezind

facts.text: The Scheveningen site houses a UN Detention Unit for international suspects like those at the ICTY.
facts.sourceQuote: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

facts.text: International offenders here remain in pre-trial detention under direct United Nations responsibility.
facts.sourceQuote: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

features.name: HBS-Craeyenhout

facts.text: A stadium at Houtrust eventually held 25,000 spectators before WWII forced abandonment.
facts.sourceQuote: Here was a stadium that would eventually have capacity for 25 000 spectators. The construction of the Atlantic Wall forced HBS Houtrust to be abandoned in 1943 and the club got to shelter at VUC Schenkkade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here was a stadium that would eventually have capacity for 25 000 spectators. The construction of the Atlantic Wall forced HBS Houtrust to be abandoned in 1943 and the club got to shelter at VUC Schenkkade.

facts.text: In 1905 the team switched to all-black kits, earning the nickname 'Crows'.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1905 HBS chose a new outfit, which was completely black. The nickname 'Crows' dates from that time.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1905 HBS chose a new outfit, which was completely black. The nickname 'Crows' dates from that time.

facts.text: The club rejected professionalism in the 1950s and remains amateur.
facts.sourceQuote: The football club refused to enter into professionalism in the 1950s and has played at the amateur level ever since.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The football club refused to enter into professionalism in the 1950s and has played at the amateur level ever since.

features.opening: HBS Craeyenhout is an omnisports club based in The Hague that fields teams in association football, cricket and hockey.

features.name: Make art worthy

facts.text: Neighborhood protests against demolition helped save the building for conversion into apartments.
facts.sourceQuote: Mede door protest van omwonenden tegen geplande sloop is het kerkgebouw uiteindelijk behouden gebleven om er appartementen van te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In part due to protests from neighbors against planned demolition, the church building was eventually saved to make apartments out of it.

features.opening: De Valkenboskerk is een kerkgebouw in de wijk Oostbroek in Den Haag.

features.name: Bombardement Alexanderkazerne 10 mei 1940

facts.text: A German bombing on May 10, 1940, killed 66 Dutch military personnel at the Alexanderkazerne.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Monument Bombardement Alexanderkazerne is een oorlogsmonument langs de Oude Waalsdorperweg in Den Haag, dat de herinnering levend houdt aan 66 Nederlandse militairen die om het leven kwamen tijdens een Duits bombardement op 10 mei 1940 op de Alexanderkazerne.

facts.text: Members found temporary shelter on the top floor of restaurant Bagatel during the war.
facts.sourceQuote: De club kreeg één dag om alles te ontruimen, en vond onderdak op de bovenste verdieping van restaurant Bagatel op de hoek van de Passage, waar nu hotel Novotel staat. Daar kwamen de leden van de Vereeniging in de oorlogsjaren bijeen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The club had one day to clear everything, and found shelter on the top floor of restaurant Bagatel on the corner of the Passage, where the Novotel hotel now stands. That is where the members of the Vereeniging gathered during the war years.

facts.text: The banquet hall was burned down and demolished in 1965 after post-war renovations.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de oorlog werd Welgelegen gerenoveerd. In 1965 is de feestzaal afgebrand en gesloopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the war, Welgelegen was renovated. In 1965, the banquet hall was burned down and demolished.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were already several gentlemen's clubs in The Hague in 1851: the Grande Société dates back to 1748 (the first society in the Netherlands), the Sociëteit de Besognekamer from 1795, the Nieuwe or Littéraire Sociëteit De Witte from 1782. Nevertheless, De Vereeniging quickly grew to 300 members.

features.name: Galerij Prins Willem V

facts.text: French forces abducted the collection just twenty years after the gallery opened in 1774.
facts.sourceQuote: Though built in 1774, the gallery has not been continuously open, mostly because the collection was abducted by the French 20 years after it opened and another 20 years passed before most of the works were recovered.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Though built in 1774, the gallery has not been continuously open, mostly because the collection was abducted by the French 20 years after it opened and another 20 years passed before most of the works were recovered.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum, which was founded by the Oud Loosduinen Foundation, was opened in 1983 by Mayor Frans Schols of The Hague.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was made by the Jewish sculptor Appie Drielsma in 1992.

facts.text: Four pillars represent the neutral, Roman Catholic, Protestant, and Jewish pillars of society during WWII.
facts.sourceQuote: De vier zuilen van het monument symboliseren de vier zuilen in de samenleving ten tijde van de Tweede Wereldoorlog: neutraal, rooms-katholiek, protestants en joods.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The four pillars of the monument symbolize the four pillars in society at the time of World War II: neutral, Roman Catholic, Protestant and Jewish.

facts.text: A monastery and church for the Dominicans were first built here in 1397 following reforms by Raymond of Capua.
facts.sourceQuote: Reforms undertaken by Raymond of Capua, brought a renewed growth to the order, and it is around this time in 1397 that a monastery and church was first built for the Dominicans in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Reforms undertaken by Raymond of Capua, brought a renewed growth to the order, and it is around this time in 1397 that a monastery and church was first built for the Dominicans in The Hague.

features.opening: The Kloosterkerk (or Cloister Church) is a church on the Lange Voorhout in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: Bevrijdingsmonument

facts.text: Bevrijdingsmonument means liberation monument, honoring 24 resistance fighters from Loosduinen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bevrijdingsmonument in Loosduinen herdenkt 24 verzetsmensen uit het Nederlandse voormalige dorp Loosduinen die het leven lieten gedurende de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The liberation monument in Loosduinen commemorates 24 resistance fighters from the former Dutch village of Loosduinen who lost their lives during World War II.

facts.text: The bronze phoenix rises from ashes atop a stone obelisk with names on its front.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een uit de as herrijzende bronzen feniks op een stenen obilisk. Op de voorzijde staan de namen van de 24 verzetsmensen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a phoenix made of bronze rising from the ashes on a stone obelisk. On the front are the names of the 24 resistance people.

features.name: CBG Centrum voor familiegeschiedenis

facts.text: CBG Centrum voor familiegeschiedenis was founded on May 15, 1945 to unite archive collections.
facts.sourceQuote: It is a non-profit foundation that was founded on May 15, 1945, with the aim of bringing together a number of archive collections and making research of genealogy and related studies easier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a non-profit foundation that was founded on May 15, 1945, with the aim of bringing together a number of archive collections and making research of genealogy and related studies easier.

facts.text: The centre publishes genealogy books like Nederland's Adelsboek and Nederland's Patriciaat.
facts.sourceQuote: The CBG publishes many books pertaining to genealogy, for instance the Nederland's Adelsboek and the Nederland's Patriciaat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The CBG publishes many books pertaining to genealogy, for instance the Nederland's Adelsboek and the Nederland's Patriciaat.

features.name: 'De Wachter'

facts.text: Crown lanterns were reinstalled on both sides of the inner courtyard to restore the square's original allure.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen aan beide zijden van het plein (binnenplantsoen) weer kroontjeslantaarns, zodat het monumentale plein in allure weer aansluit bij de Vijverberg, Voorhout en Willemspark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Crown lanterns have been installed again on both sides of the square (inner courtyard), so that the monumental square once again connects in allure with the Vijverberg, Voorhout and Willemspark.

facts.text: Hedgebeeches line the outer edge to divert attention away from parked cars while thirty trees fill the interior.
facts.sourceQuote: Langs de buitenrand zijn haagbeuken geplant die de geparkeerde auto's aan het oog onttrekken. Daarbinnen zijn ruim dertig bomen geplaatst en langs het schelpenpad zijn nieuwe perken aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hedgebeeches are planted along the outer edge to divert the eye from the parked cars. Within it, more than thirty trees have been planted and new hedges have been laid along the shell path.

facts.text: Water from the Haagse Beek still flows under Javatraat before dropping as a waterfall into Willemspark.
facts.sourceQuote: Een klein gedeelte is nog overkluisd en water van de Haagse Beek stroomt vanuit laatste deel Nassauplein onder de Javatraat kruising door en met een watervalletje komt de beek uit in het Willemspark en van daar in de Singelgracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A small part is still locked and water from the Haagse Beek flows from the last part of Nassauplein under the Javatraat intersection and with a waterfall the stream flows into the Willemspark and from there into the Singelgracht.

features.opening: Nassauplein is een lang rechthoekig plein in de Archipelbuurt in Den Haag met maar 43 huisnummers.

features.name: Pulchri Studio

facts.text: The colony modeled itself after the successful Barbizon artist group near Paris.
facts.sourceQuote: The model was the successful artist colony of Barbizon south of Paris in the forest of Fontainebleau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The model was the successful artist colony of Barbizon south of Paris in the forest of Fontainebleau.

facts.text: Founding members included Lambertus Hardenberg, Willem Roelofs, Jan Hendrik Weissenbruch and Bartholomeus Johannes van Hove.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the founding members of Pulchri has been Lambertus Hardenberg, Willem Roelofs, Jan Hendrik Weissenbruch and Bartholomeus Johannes van Hove.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the founding members of Pulchri has been Lambertus Hardenberg, Willem Roelofs, Jan Hendrik Weissenbruch and Bartholomeus Johannes van Hove.

facts.text: Hendrik Willem Mesdag served as chairman of the association from 1898 to 1907.
facts.sourceQuote: Many painters, who are today attributed to the Hague School, had position on the board and made this cooperative to a stronghold: Bosboom was chairman from 1852 to 1853, Israëls from 1875 to 1878, and Mesdag from 1898 to 1907.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many painters, who are today attributed to the Hague School, had position on the board and made this cooperative to a stronghold: Bosboom was chairman from 1852 to 1853, Israëls from 1875 to 1878, and Mesdag from 1898 to 1907.

facts.text: The cooperative initially had no exhibition rooms for displaying works.
facts.sourceQuote: Right at the beginning this cooperative had no exhibition rooms.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Right at the beginning this cooperative had no exhibition rooms.

features.opening: Pulchri Studio (Latin: "For the study of the beautiful") is a Dutch art society, art institution and art studio based in The Hague ('s-Gravenhage), Netherlands.

features.name: Our Lady of Good Counsel Church

facts.text: The original church was destroyed in 1945 during the bombing of Bezuidenhout.
facts.sourceQuote: De voorloper van deze kerk, eveneens met de naam Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk werd in 1945 verwoest tijdens het bombardement op het Bezuidenhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The predecessor of this church, also named Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk, was destroyed in 1945 during the bombing of Bezuidenhout.

facts.text: Architect Jan van der Laan designed a square central building instead of a neo-Gothic basilica.
facts.sourceQuote: In plaats van een exacte herbouw van de neogotische kruisbasiliek werd er gekozen voor een nieuw ontwerp door Jan van der Laan in de stijl van de Bossche School. De vierkante centraalbouw paste beter bij de nieuwe liturgische ideeën van na de oorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Instead of an exact reconstruction of the neo-Gothic cruciform basilica, a new design by Jan van der Laan in the style of the Bossche School was chosen. The square central building suited the new liturgical ideas of the post-war period better.

facts.text: Construction took eight years, running from 1946 until completion in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw begon in 1946 en was voltooid in 1954.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1946 and was completed in 1954.

features.opening: De Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-van-Goede-Raadkerk, of kortweg de Goede-Raadkerk is een rooms-katholiek kerkgebouw aan de Bezuidenhoutseweg in de Haagse wijk Bezuidenhout.

features.name: Eben Haëzerkerk

facts.text: Het Kompas moved into the building in autumn 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds het najaar van 2019 is christelijk ontmoetingscentrum Het Kompas in het kerkgebouw gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the fall of 2019, the Christian meeting center Het Kompas has been located in the church building.

facts.text: Temporary services returned to this church between February and April 2020 due to hall renovations elsewhere.
facts.sourceQuote: Van zondag 2 februari tot en met 4 april 2020 worden er in deze kerk tijdelijk diensten gehouden vanwege de verbouwing van de kerkzaal van de Bethaniëkerk in Den Haag.[1]
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From Sunday, February 2 to April 4, 2020, temporary services will be held in this church due to the renovation of the church hall of the Bethaniëkerk in The Hague.[1]

features.opening: De Eben-Haëzerkerk is het kerkgebouw van de Gereformeerde Gemeente in Scheveningen.

features.name: Evangelisch Lutherse Gemeente

facts.text: A secret church existed on this site starting in 1615 before the current complex was built.
facts.sourceQuote: Waar de kerk staat, bevond zich sinds 1615 een schuilkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Where the church stands, there has been a secret church since 1615.

facts.text: Land purchases between the 1620s and 1656 expanded the site into a full church complex with annexes.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1620-1656 werden stukken grond rond dat gebouw opgekocht en zo ontstond een complex van een kerk met bijgebouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1620s-1656, plots of land around that building were purchased and thus a complex of a church with annexes was created.

facts.text: Pieter de Swart sketched the facade alongside bricklayer Coenraad Hoeneker.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1757 schetste Pieter de Swart een voorgevel, samen met de Amsterdamse metselbaas Coenraad Hoeneker, die ook voor het interieur zorgde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1757, Pieter de Swart sketched a facade, together with the Amsterdam bricklayer Coenraad Hoeneker, who also took care of the interior.

facts.text: Three high arched windows with small rosette distribution crown the brick facade.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarboven heeft de gevel drie hoge boogramen met kleine roedeverdeling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Above that, the facade has three high arched windows with small rosette distribution.

features.opening: De Evangelische Lutherse kerk in Den Haag ligt aan de Lutherse Burgwal.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The following players were called up to represent their national teams in international football and received caps during their tenure with Quick Den Haag: Years in brackets indicate careerspan with Quick Den Haag.

facts.text: The club secured the Dutch National Cup four times between 1909 and 1916.
facts.sourceQuote: Quick is the Dutch national football champion of 1908 and Dutch National Cup winner of 1909, 1910, 1911, and 1916.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Quick is the Dutch national football champion of 1908 and Dutch National Cup winner of 1909, 1910, 1911, and 1916.

features.opening: HV & CV Quick, also known as Quick Den Haag, is a Dutch football and cricket club from The Hague.

features.name: Grote of Sint-Jacobskerk (The Hague)

facts.text: Bartholomeus Eggers sculpted the cenotaph of Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam in 1667.
facts.sourceQuote: The church is remarkable for its fine tower and chime of bells, and contains the cenotaph monument of Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam, designed and sculpted by Bartholomeus Eggers in 1667, and the renaissance tomb of Gerrit van Assendelft (1487–1558).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is remarkable for its fine tower and chime of bells, and contains the cenotaph monument of Jacob van Wassenaer Obdam, designed and sculpted by Bartholomeus Eggers in 1667, and the renaissance tomb of Gerrit van Assendelft (1487–1558).

facts.text: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptized and married within these walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptised and married there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Members of the House of Orange-Nassau have been baptised and married there.

facts.text: Alongside the Binnenhof, this structure stands as one of The Hague's oldest buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: Together with the Binnenhof, it is one of the oldest buildings in The Hague.

features.opening: The Kinderboekenmuseum (Children's Book Museum) is a museum in The Hague, Netherlands, dedicated to Dutch language children's books.

features.name: Church of St. John & St. Philip

facts.text: King William I closed the church in 1822, but his son reopened it in a temporary wooden building in 1844.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1822 werd deze kerk gesloten op bevel van koning Willem I. Zijn zoon koning Willem II, die het vaak met zijn vader oneens was, stond in 1844 toe dat de kerk heropend werd. Dit gebeurde in een tijdelijk houten gebouw naast de koninklijke bibliotheek in de tuin van Paleis Noordeinde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1822, this church was closed at the orders of King William I. His son King William II, who often disagreed with his father, allowed the church to be reopened in 1844. This took place in a temporary wooden building next to the royal library in the garden of Noordeinde Palace.

facts.text: The Greeven family moved to The Hague in 1937 due to business restrictions in Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: Greeven was an American businessman who had become a Baháʼí in New York City in 1927 and moved to Germany in 1930; the family's move to The Hague in 1937 was due to business restrictions in Germany; the Greevens remained in the Netherlands until 1940.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Greeven was an American businessman who had become a Baháʼí in New York City in 1927 and moved to Germany in 1930; the family's move to The Hague in 1937 was due to business restrictions in Germany; the Greevens remained in the Netherlands until 1940.

facts.text: A letter from ʻAbdu'l-Bahá was delivered to the Central Organisation for Durable Peace in 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1920, two Persian Baháʼís, Ahmad Yazdani and Hand of the Cause Ibn-i-Asdaq, brought a letter from ʻAbdu'l-Bahá to the Central Organisation for Durable Peace in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1920, two Persian Baháʼís, Ahmad Yazdani and Hand of the Cause Ibn-i-Asdaq, brought a letter from ʻAbdu'l-Bahá to the Central Organisation for Durable Peace in The Hague.

facts.text: The first Dutch Baháʼí, Jan Piet de Borst, converted in Bussum on August 3, 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: Jan Piet de Borst of Wassenaar was the first to officially register in the Baháʼí Faith, converting to the religion in Bussum on 3 August 1947; another Dutchman, Hans Slim of Wassenaar, converted on 20 August 1947.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Jan Piet de Borst of Wassenaar was the first to officially register in the Baháʼí Faith, converting to the religion in Bussum on 3 August 1947; another Dutchman, Hans Slim of Wassenaar, converted on 20 August 1947.

facts.text: Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek arrived from the US in October 1946 to pioneer the faith in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuote: In June of that year, the committee asked Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek, a Dutch woman who had spent World War II in the United States and became a Baháʼí during that time, to return to the Netherlands to pioneer. She arrived in October 1946 and set up her home in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June of that year, the committee asked Rita van Bleyswijk Sombeek, a Dutch woman who had spent World War II in the United States and became a Baháʼí during that time, to return to the Netherlands to pioneer. She arrived in October 1946 and set up her home in Amsterdam.

facts.text: Louis Gustave Löhlefink became the first Baháʼí in Rotterdam when he joined in February 1953.
facts.sourceQuote: The first Baháʼís in Rotterdam was Louis Gustave Löhlefink who joined the religion on 8 February 1953.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first Baháʼís in Rotterdam was Louis Gustave Löhlefink who joined the religion on 8 February 1953.

features.name: Sint Paschalis Baylon

facts.text: A painting of the holy Paschalis Baylon by Lodewijk Schelfhout adorns the southern side altar.
facts.sourceQuote: De noordelijke eindigt in de preekstoel, de zuidelijke in een zijaltaar met retabel gewijd aan de heilige Paschalis Baylon met een schildering door Lodewijk Schelfhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The northern one ends in the pulpit, the southern one in a side altar with a retable dedicated to the holy Paschalis Baylon with a painting by Lodewijk Schelfhout.

facts.text: Plans for the church began in 1910 alongside new housing projects in Benoordenhout.
facts.sourceQuote: Plannen voor deze nieuwe kerk beginnen in 1910, tegelijk met de eerste plannen voor nieuwe woningbouw in Benoordenhout.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Plans for this new church began in 1910, at the same time as the first plans for new housing in Benoordenhout.

facts.text: In 2015, the church joined the Maria Sterre der Zee parish following a merger.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2015 volgde een nieuwe parochiefusie, de kerk hoort sindsdien bij de parochie Maria Sterre der Zee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2015, a new parish merger followed, the church has since been part of the parish Maria Sterre der Zee.

features.opening: De Sint-Paschalis Baylonkerk aan de Wassenaarseweg in Den Haag is gebouwd tussen 1919 en 1921.

features.name: Heilige Antonius Abtkerk

facts.text: The apse mosaic uses two million Venetian glass stones and is the largest north of Paris.
facts.sourceQuote: In het mozaïek, dat 12 meter hoog is en ruim 17 meter breed, zijn 2.000.000 Venetiaanse e-mailsteentjes (smalti) verwerkt door atelier Mauméjean Frères uit Parijs. Het is het enige grote emailmozaïek in Nederland en het grootste ten noorden van Parijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the mosaic, which is 12 meters high and nearly 17 meters wide, 2,000,000 Venetian email stones (smalti) have been processed by atelier Mauméjean Frères from Paris. It is the only large email mosaic in the Netherlands and the largest north of Paris.

facts.text: Architects Joseph Cuypers and Pierre Cuypers jr. designed this commercial-expressionist church.
facts.sourceQuote: De Antonius Abtkerk is een rijksmonument, in 1926-1927 gebouwd door architect Joseph Cuypers en zijn zoon Pierre Cuypers jr. in een zakelijk-expressionistische stijl met een rijk versierd art-deco-interieur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Antonius Abtkerk is a national monument, built in 1926-1927 by architect Joseph Cuypers and his son Pierre Cuypers jr. in a commercial-expressionist style with a richly decorated art deco interior.

facts.text: A large choir mosaic commemorates the cholera epidemic that struck between 1848 and 1849.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze koorafsluiting is gedecoreerd met een groot, kleurrijk mozaïek dat de cholera-epidemie van 1848-1849 herdenkt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This choir end is decorated with a large, colorful mosaic that commemorates the cholera epidemic of 1848-1849.

features.opening: De Antonius Abtkerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan het einde van de Scheveningseweg in Den Haag.

features.name: Prinses Julianakerk

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina, Queen Mother Emma, and Princess Juliana attended its 1928 opening.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste dienst in de Nederlands Hervormde Julianakerk, in 1928, werd bijgewoond door Wilhelmina der Nederlanden, de Koningin-Moeder Emma van Waldeck-Pyrmont en Prinses Juliana.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first service in the Reformed Julianakerk in the Netherlands, in 1928, was attended by Wilhelmina of the Netherlands, Queen Mother Emma of Waldeck-Pyrmont and Prinses Juliana.

features.opening: De Prinses Julianakerk in Den Haag is een kerk in de Scheveningense wijk Duindorp.

features.name: Luchtwachttoren 5C1

facts.text: The tower features a square base of 6.5 by 6.5 meters and tapers to a height of six meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren heeft een vierkant grondvlak van 6,5 x 6,5 meter, loopt naar boven taps toe en is zes meter hoog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower has a square base of 6.5 x 6.5 meters, tapers upwards and is six meters high.

facts.text: Since 2009, the tower has held the status of a municipal monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2009 is de toren een gemeentelijk monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2009, the tower has been a municipal monument.

features.opening: Luchtwachttoren 5C1 is een luchtwachttoren in de zeereep aan het Zwartepad in de wijk Oostduinen in Scheveningen, in de duinen ten noorden van Scheveningen,…

features.name: Korzo Theater

facts.text: The venue opened as a cinema named Corso in 1936 before closing sixty-six years later.
facts.sourceQuote: Korzo werd in 1936 als een bioscoop onder de naam Corso opgericht. Zesenzestig jaar later sloot de bioscoop zijn deuren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Korzo was founded in 1936 as a cinema under the name Corso. Sixty-six years later, the cinema closed its doors.

facts.text: Artists and students ransacked the empty building before it reopened as Korzo Theater in February 1984.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadien stond het bioscooppand ongeveer vier jaar leeg, totdat het werd gekraakt door een groep kunstenaars en studenten. In februari 1984 opende in het gekraakte bioscooppand het Korzo-theater voor experimentele dans en muziek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After that, the cinema building stood empty for about four years, until it was ransacked by a group of artists and students. In February 1984, the Korzo theater opened in the vandalized cinema building for experimental dance and music.

facts.text: Old stained glass windows from the former chapel were preserved during the renovation process.
facts.sourceQuote: De oude glas-in-loodramen van de kerk zijn bewaard gebleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The old stained glass windows of the church have been preserved.

facts.text: Korzo Theater began operations in the early 1910s as a theater and production house.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater en productiehuis werd begin jaren tien van de 20e eeuw opgericht en organiseert muziek- en dansvoorstellingen uit Australië, Azië, Europa, Noord, Zuid- en Midden-Amerika.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater and production house was founded in the early 1910s and organizes music and dance performances from Australia, Asia, Europe, North, South and Central America.

facts.text: The venue presents music and dance acts originating from Australia, Asia, and the Americas.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater en productiehuis werd begin jaren tien van de 20e eeuw opgericht en organiseert muziek- en dansvoorstellingen uit Australië, Azië, Europa, Noord, Zuid- en Midden-Amerika.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater and production house was founded in the early 1910s and organizes music and dance performances from Australia, Asia, Europe, North, South and Central America.

features.opening: Korzo is een theater en productiehuis uit Den Haag.

features.name: Joods Kindermonument

facts.text: Joods Kindermonument honors the 2000 Jewish children from The Hague who perished in camps.
facts.sourceQuote: In totaal hebben ongeveer 2000 Joodse kinderen uit Den Haag de kampen niet overleefd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In total, about 2000 Jewish children from The Hague did not survive the camps.

facts.text: Dismissed university professors joined teachers to educate Jewish children at the Joods Lyceum.
facts.sourceQuote: Sommige Joodse leraren, die van de Duitsers niet meer mochten werken op hun oude scholen, gingen hier onderwijs geven. Ook Joodse professoren die bij de universiteit waren ontslagen, gingen op het Joods Lyceum lesgeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some Jewish teachers, who were no longer allowed to work at their old schools by the Germans, went to teach here. Jewish professors who had been dismissed from the university also went to teach at the Joods Lyceum.

facts.text: The Joods Kindermonument was unveiled on November 20, 2006, which is International Children's Day.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Joods Kindermonument is onthuld op 20 november 2006, de Internationale Dag van de Rechten van het Kind.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Joods Kindermonument was unveiled on November 20, 2006, International Children's Day.

facts.text: A replica of a bronze plaque originally housed in the Museum since 1952 now stands on the square.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plein bevindt zich ook een replica van de bronzen plaquette die zich sinds 1952 in het Museon bevindt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the square there is also a replica of the bronze plaque that has been in the Museum since 1952.

features.name: Indisch monument

facts.text: Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu laid a garland at the Indisch monument in 1991.
facts.sourceQuote: Three years after the monument was unveiled, Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu laid a decorative garland at the monument on July 19, 1991 during his state visit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three years after the monument was unveiled, Japanese Prime Minister Toshiki Kaifu laid a decorative garland at the monument on July 19, 1991 during his state visit.

facts.text: A Dutch Indo demonstrator later threw that wreath into the water during the same day.
facts.sourceQuote: Later that day, the wreath was thrown into the water by a Dutch Indo demonstrator.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later that day, the wreath was thrown into the water by a Dutch Indo demonstrator.

facts.text: The monument features 17 bronze sculptures alongside a map of Southeast Asia.
facts.sourceQuote: It consists of 17 bronze sculptures, a map of Southeast Asia and the inscription, "The spirit conquers".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of 17 bronze sculptures, a map of Southeast Asia and the inscription, "The spirit conquers".

facts.text: Queen Beatrix unveiled the structure on August 15, 1988.
facts.sourceQuote: Designed by Jaroslawa Dankowa, the monument was unveiled on August 15, 1988 by Queen Beatrix.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Designed by Jaroslawa Dankowa, the monument was unveiled on August 15, 1988 by Queen Beatrix.

features.name: Christus Triumfatorkerk

facts.text: Christus Triumfatorkerk derives its name from a specific text found in the Bible.
facts.sourceQuote: De Christus Triumfatorkerk ontleent zijn naam aan een tekst uit de Bijbel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Christus Triumfatorkerk derives its name from a text in the Bible.

facts.text: Construction plans for the church were first drawn up in 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste plannen voor de bouw dateren uit 1957.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first plans for construction date back to 1957.

facts.text: The architect placed the pulpit at the center while ensuring clear views of the font.
facts.sourceQuote: De architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) kreeg als richtlijnen mee: de preekstoel moet een centrale plaats innemen, het liturgisch centrum en doopvont moeten duidelijk zichtbaar zijn en de geluidsisolatie moet goed zijn. Verder werd hij in zijn ontwerp vrij gelaten in de inrichting van de kerkzaal en de situering van het "kerkelijk centrum".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect Geert Drexhage (1914-1982) was given the following guidelines: the pulpit must occupy a central place, the liturgical center and baptismal font must be clearly visible and the sound insulation must be good. In addition, he was left free in his design in the layout of the church hall and the location of the "ecclesiastical center".

facts.text: The entire church structure sits just above street level rather than below it.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw ligt net boven straatniveau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building is just above street level.

features.name: De Drie Stoepen

facts.text: Van Braxhoofden combined Louis XIV facades with Louis XVI central decorations and carved console cornices.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij koos daarbij voor elk huis een gevel in Lodewijk XIV-stijl, met een versierde middenpartij in een Lodewijk XVI-stijl en een kroonlijst op gesneden consoles, een hardstenen plint en hardstenen stoep.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He chose a facade in Louis XIV style for each house, with a decorated central part in a Louis XVI style and a cornice on carved consoles, a stone base and stone pavement.

facts.text: Three Hague mayors including Jacobus van Neck lived at this address during the eighteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Onder de achttiende-eeuwse bewoners bevonden zich de secretaris van de Sociëteit van de Hoge Collegiën en van Den Haag, Paulus van Assendelft, de griffier van de Hoge Raad van Holland, Zeeland en West-Friesland, Nicolaas van der Haar, alsmede drie Haagse burgemeesters: Jacobus van Neck (1702-1752), diens zoon Abraham van Neck (1734-1789) en Johan Patijn (1723-1787).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the eighteenth-century residents were the secretary of the Society of the High Colleges and of The Hague, Paulus van Assendelft, the clerk of the High Council of Holland, Zeeland and West Friesland, Nicolaas van der Haar, as well as three Hague mayors: Jacobus van Neck (1702-1752), his son Abraham van Neck (1734-1789) and Johan Patijn (1723-1787).

facts.text: Count of Spaen resided here from 1749 with his wife, a descendant of Stadtholder Maurice of Orange.
facts.sourceQuote: Rijksvrijheer van Spaen (1703-1768), generaal-majoor in het Staatse leger, woonde hier vanaf 1749 op nummer 69 met zijn vrouw Elisabeth Agnes Jacoba gravin van Nassau la Lecq, afstammelinge van stadhouder Maurits van Oranje en diens geliefde Margaretha van Mechelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Count of Spaen (1703-1768), major general in the State army, lived here from 1749 at number 69 with his wife Elisabeth Agnes Jacoba Countess of Nassau la Lecq, descendant of Stadtholder Maurice of Orange and his beloved Margaretha of Mechelen.

features.opening: De Drie Stoepen is de gezamenlijke naam van drie naast elkaar gelegen rijksmonumenten uit de eerste helft van de achttiende eeuw, in het centrum van Den Haag.

features.name: Museum Bredius

facts.text: The house was built in 1755 by architect Pieter de Swart alongside neighbors at numbers 14 and 15.
facts.sourceQuote: The house was built together with its neighbours (numbers 14 & 15) by the architect Pieter de Swart in 1755, and was home to a series of important Heren up to the 1930s, when it was purchased by Frits Lugt, to house his large collection of drawings and prints that later, along with the initial donation by Cornelis Hofstede de Groot (1863–1930), formed the basis for the Rijksbureau voor Kunsthistorische Documentatie (RKD), and is now mostly housed in the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, National Library of the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The house was built together with its neighbours (numbers 14 & 15) by the architect Pieter de Swart in 1755, and was home to a series of important Heren up to the 1930s, when it was purchased by Frits Lugt, to house his large collection of drawings and prints that later, along with the initial donation by Cornelis Hofstede de Groot (1863–1930), formed the basis for the Rijksbureau voor Kunsthistorische Documentatie (RKD), and is now mostly housed in the Koninklijke Bibliotheek, National Library of the Netherlands.

facts.text: The city of The Hague purchased the building in 1955 to house the Bredius collection.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1955 the house was purchased by the city of The Hague for the Bredius collection, which until then was housed in the former home of its donor, Abraham Bredius (Amsterdam, 1855 - Monaco, 1946).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1955 the house was purchased by the city of The Hague for the Bredius collection, which until then was housed in the former home of its donor, Abraham Bredius (Amsterdam, 1855 - Monaco, 1946).

facts.text: A generous sponsor funded a remodel restoring the interior to its original Louis XV style.
facts.sourceQuote: The decision to move to the present location was made possible with the gift of a generous sponsor to remodel it in the original Louis XV style.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The decision to move to the present location was made possible with the gift of a generous sponsor to remodel it in the original Louis XV style.

facts.text: Visitors enjoy an accurate restoration of the eighteenth-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection is remarkable for its seventeenth-century etchings and paintings, but is most attractive to visitors for its accurate restoration of the 18th-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection is remarkable for its seventeenth-century etchings and paintings, but is most attractive to visitors for its accurate restoration of the 18th-century Herenhuis interior with period furnishings.

facts.text: While holding seventeenth-century etchings and paintings, the site is most attractive for its restored interior.

features.name: Heilige Martha Kerk

facts.text: New Catholic migrants from around the world arrived in the 1970s and 1980s, saving the church from closure.
facts.sourceQuote: De bevolkingssamenstelling van de wijk veranderde sterk in de jaren 1970 en 1980 en de oorspronkelijke autochtone bewoners trokken weg. Nieuwe katholieke migranten uit alle delen van de wereld kwamen in de Schilderswijk wonen en maakten ook gebruik van de Marthakerk, die daardoor weer bestaansrecht kreeg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The population composition of the district changed significantly in the 1970s and 1980s and the original indigenous residents moved away. New Catholic migrants from all over the world came to live in the Schilderswijk and also used the Marthakerk, which therefore gained the right to exist again.

facts.text: While other local churches were demolished, this one survived the sharp decline in attendance during the 1960s.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 1960 liep het kerkbezoek in de Schilderswijk sterk terug. Andere kerken zoals de Sint-Jozefkerk werden afgebroken, maar de Marthakerk bleef open.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1960s, church attendance in the Schilderswijk declined sharply. Other churches such as the Sint-Jozefkerk were demolished, but the Marthakerk remained open.

facts.text: Mortared pillars are covered with colored slate and windows feature stained glass.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemetselde pilaren zijn bekleed met gekleurde leisteen. De vensters zijn voorzien van glas-in-loodramen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The mortared pillars are covered with colored slate. The windows are equipped with stained glass windows.

facts.text: In 1924, the church gained a tower with a saddle roof and an extra southern bay.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1924 werd de kerk door Molenaar jr. uitgebreid met een extra travee aan de zuidelijke entree en de toren met zadeldak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1924, the church was expanded by Molenaar jr. with an additional bay at the southern entrance and the tower with saddle roof.

facts.text: The entrance displays a large rose window above seven small pointed arch windows.
facts.sourceQuote: Boven de ingang bevindt zich het grote roosvenster, met daaronder 7 kleine spitsboogvensters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Above the entrance is the large rose window, with 7 small pointed arch windows below it.

features.opening: De Sint-Marthakerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Den Haag.

facts.text: Jet de Ranitz became chairman on December 1, 2014, succeeding Doekle Terpstra.

features.name: Sint Agneskerk

facts.text: An octagonal tower stands directly next to the neo-Gothic façade.
facts.sourceQuote: Margry ontwierp een driebeukige kruiskerk in neogotische stijl, met een achthoekige toren direct naast de façade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Margry designed a three-aisled cruciform church in neo-Gothic style, with an octagonal tower directly next to the façade.

facts.text: A 1983 fire destroyed the wooden barrel vault and part of the tower.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk raakte zwaar beschadigd bij een brand in 1983 waarbij het houten tongewelf en een deel van de toren verloren gingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was severely damaged in a fire in 1983 in which the wooden barrel vault and part of the tower were lost.

facts.text: Illegal foreigners known as White illegals held a hunger strike here in 1998.
facts.sourceQuote: De Sint-Agneskerk kreeg in 1998 landelijke bekendheid toen een groep illegaal in Nederland verblijvende buitenlanders, de zogenaamde Witte illegalen, in de kerk een hongerstakingsactie hielden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Sint-Agneskerk gained national fame in 1998 when a group of illegal foreigners living in the Netherlands, the so-called White illegals, held a hunger strike in the church.

features.opening: De Sint-Agneskerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Beeklaan in Den Haag.

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'Grenadiers en Jagers'

facts.text: Fierce fighting occurred at Ypenburg Airport during the 1940 German attack on the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Duitse aanval op Nederland in 1940 werd rond Vliegveld Ypenburg fel gevochten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German attack on the Netherlands in 1940, fierce fighting took place around Ypenburg Airport.

facts.text: An annual commemoration is held here every May 10th since 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: De tekst op het monument is als volgt: TER HERINNERING AAN ONZE KRIJGSMAKKERS DIE IN DE MEIDAGEN VAN 1940 EN DAARNA HIER EN OVERZEE HUN LEVEN GAVEN VOOR HET VADERLAND Sinds 2010 vindt er jaarlijks op 10 mei bij dit monument een herdenking plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The text on the monument reads as follows: IN REMEMBRANCE OF OUR WAR VETERANS WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES HERE AND ABROAD IN THE DAYS OF MAY 1940 AND THEREAFTER FOR THE PATRIOTIC LAND Since 2010, an annual commemoration takes place on May 10 at this monument.

facts.text: Seventh-grade students from Basisschool De Startbaan maintain the monument and attend its ceremonies.
facts.sourceQuote: Leerlingen van Basisschool De Startbaan hebben het monument geadopteerd: kinderen van groep 7 verzorgen het monument en zijn bij de herdenking aanwezig.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students of Basisschool De Startbaan have adopted the monument: children from group 7 take care of the monument and are present at the commemoration.

facts.text: Artist Dirk Bus created the image for this memorial.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd gemaakt door kunstenaar Dirk Bus en is onthuld in 1951.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image was created by artist Dirk Bus and was unveiled in 1951.

facts.text: Oorlogsmonument 'Grenadiers en Jagers' honors the Regiment Garde Grenadiers and Jagers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Monument Grenadiers en Jagers is een monument ter nagedachtenis aan militairen uit het Regiment Garde Grenadiers en Jagers die sinds 1940 omgekomen zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Monument Grenadiers en Jagers is a monument in memory of military personnel from the Regiment Garde Grenadiers and Jagers who have died since 1940.

features.opening: Het Monument Grenadiers en Jagers is een monument ter nagedachtenis aan militairen uit het Regiment Garde Grenadiers en Jagers die sinds 1940 omgekomen zijn.

features.name: Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum

facts.text: Entry was free for visitors during the entire year of 2010 as a special gesture.
facts.sourceQuote: Als geste was het museum in 2010 gratis toegankelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a gesture, the museum was free to enter in 2010.

facts.text: Sunday rides on historic electric trams through The Hague are offered during opening hours.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens openingsuren worden op zondagen vanuit het museum ritten met historische Haagse elektrische trams door Den Haag gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During opening hours, on Sundays, rides with historic Hague electric trams through The Hague are held from the museum.

facts.text: A 2011 exhibition gathered preserved Blue and Yellow Tram cars to mark the abolition of lines to Leiden.
facts.sourceQuote: Van september t/m november 2011 werd de tentoonstelling 'Retourtje Leiden' gehouden ter gelegenheid van het 80-jarige bestaan van de NVBS en de opheffing van de tramlijnen tussen Den Haag en Leiden precies een halve eeuw geleden. Zo veel mogelijk van de nog bewaard gebleven museumwagens van de Blauwe Tram en de Gele Tram zijn hiertoe bijeengebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From September to November 2011, the exhibition 'Retourtje Leiden' was held on the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the NVBS and the abolition of the tram lines between The Hague and Leiden exactly half a century ago. As many of the still preserved museum cars of the Blue Tram and the Yellow Tram as possible have been brought together for this purpose.

features.opening: Het Haags Openbaar Vervoer Museum (HOVM) is sinds 1989 gevestigd in een oude tramremise, de remise Frans Halsstraat te Den Haag.

features.name: KM21

facts.text: The venue opened in 2002 under the original name Gem, Contemporary Art.
facts.sourceQuote: KM21 was set up in 2002 by the Kunstmuseum Den Haag under the name Gem, Contemporary Art, (abbreviated to GEM) to display the contemporary visual art held by the museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: KM21 was set up in 2002 by the Kunstmuseum Den Haag under the name Gem, Contemporary Art, (abbreviated to GEM) to display the contemporary visual art held by the museum.

facts.text: KM21 opened its doors in 2002 as a branch of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was established in 2002 as part of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was established in 2002 as part of the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.

facts.text: Visitors can experience film screenings, lectures, and live performances alongside art exhibitions.
facts.sourceQuote: In addition to exhibitions, activities such as lectures, discussions, performances, film screenings and book presentations also take place.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to exhibitions, activities such as lectures, discussions, performances, film screenings and book presentations also take place.
