features.name: Muzee Scheveningen

facts.text: Muzee Scheveningen opened in 2006 after merging two local museums.
facts.sourceQuote: Muzee Scheveningen ontstond in 2006 na het samengaan van Museum Scheveningen en het Zeemuseum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Muzee Scheveningen was founded in 2006 after the merger of Museum Scheveningen and the Maritime Museum.

facts.text: Artworks depict the fishing village history and seaside resort life.
facts.sourceQuote: Er zijn schilderijen en tekeningen te zien vooral rondom de visserij en de geschiedenis van het vissersdorp en de badplaats, samen met het wonderlijke dierenleven in zee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are paintings and drawings to see, especially around the fishing and the history of the fishing village and the seaside resort, together with the wonderful animal life in the sea.

facts.text: A tropical marine aquarium is featured within the permanent exhibition.
facts.sourceQuote: Een tropisch zeeaquarium maakt eveneens deel uit van de vaste tentoonstelling.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A tropical marine aquarium is also part of the permanent exhibition.

features.name: Koningin Regentes Emma van Waldeck Pyrmont

facts.text: Koningin Regentes Emma van Waldeck Pyrmont served as regent from November 1890 until August 1898.
facts.sourceQuote: Ter Herinnering aan Hare Majesteit de Koningin-Moeder Emma Adelheid Wilhelmina Theresia Prinses van Waldeck-Pyrmont, Gemalin van Zijne Majesteit Willem III Koning der Nederlanden, Koningin-regentes van 24 XI 1890 tot 31 VIII 1898, Geboren 2 VIII 1858 Arolsen, Overleden 20 III 1934, 's-Gravenhage.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In memory of Her Majesty the Koningin Mother Emma Adelheid Wilhelmina Theresia Princess of Waldeck-Pyrmont, Spouse of Her Majesty William III King of the Netherlands, Koningin regent from 24 November 1890 to 31 August 1898, Born 2 August 1858 Arolsen, Died 20 March 1934, The Hague.

features.opening: Het Monument voor koningin Emma staat in Benoordenhout in Den Haag, in het Rosarium aan het Jozef Israëlsplein.

features.name: Vredeskapel

facts.text: King William III helped donate funds while Queen Beatrix attended its 125th anniversary service.
facts.sourceQuote: Koning Willem III was betrokken bij bovengenoemde schenking, koningin Juliana woonde een dienst bij in 1988 en koningin Beatrix woonde op 13 november 2005 de jubileumdienst bij, ter ere van het 125-jarig bestaan van de Vredeskapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: King William III was involved in the aforementioned donation, Queen Juliana attended a service in 1988 and Queen Beatrix attended the jubilee service on November 13, 2005, in honor of the 125th anniversary of the Vredeskapel.

facts.text: After closing, the baptismal font and communion service moved to Duinzigt while the Statenbijbel stayed behind.
facts.sourceQuote: Het doopvont en het avondmaal-servies zijn na de sluiting in de Duinzigtkerk geplaatst, de Statenbijbel bleef vooralsnog in de Vredeskapel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The baptismal font and the communion service were placed in the Duinzigt church after closing, the Statenbijbel remained in the Vredeskapel for the time being.

features.opening: De Vredeskapel is een voormalig kerkgebouw van de Hervormde Gemeente in de Malakkastraat (Archipelbuurt) in de Nederlandse plaats Den Haag.

features.name: Ridderzaal

facts.text: From the early 17th century, the building served as a major book trading place.
facts.sourceQuote: From the early 17th century, the Ridderzaal became an important trading place for booksellers, as Westminster Hall was in London.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the early 17th century, the Ridderzaal became an important trading place for booksellers, as Westminster Hall was in London.

facts.text: At various times, the hall functioned as a hospital ward and the offices for the state lottery.
facts.sourceQuote: In later centuries it served a variety of purposes - as a market hall, a promenade, a drill hall, a public record office, a hospital ward, even the offices of the state lottery.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In later centuries it served a variety of purposes - as a market hall, a promenade, a drill hall, a public record office, a hospital ward, even the offices of the state lottery.

facts.text: In May 1948, delegates from Europe, Canada, and the USA met here to discuss European integration.
facts.sourceQuote: The Congress of Europe, considered by many as the first federal development of post-war European history, was held in The Hague in May 1948 with 750 European delegates as well as observers from Canada and the United States of America. The Hall of Knights was the main venue used for the congress.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Congress of Europe, considered by many as the first federal development of post-war European history, was held in The Hague in May 1948 with 750 European delegates as well as observers from Canada and the United States of America. The Hall of Knights was the main venue used for the congress.

facts.text: The Dutch monarch delivers the speech from the throne here on Prinsjesdag.
facts.sourceQuote: It is used for the annual state opening of Parliament on Prinsjesdag, when the Dutch monarch drives to Parliament in the Golden Coach and delivers the speech from the throne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is used for the annual state opening of Parliament on Prinsjesdag, when the Dutch monarch drives to Parliament in the Golden Coach and delivers the speech from the throne.

features.name: Peace Palace

facts.text: Andrew Carnegie donated $1.5 million to build the Peace Palace and fund its international law library.
facts.sourceQuote: Andrew Dickson White, whose efforts were instrumental in creating the court, secured US$1.5 million ($50,000,000, adjusted for inflation) from Scottish-American steel magnate Andrew Carnegie to build the Peace Palace to house the court as well as to endow it with a library of international law.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Andrew Dickson White, whose efforts were instrumental in creating the court, secured US$1.5 million ($50,000,000, adjusted for inflation) from Scottish-American steel magnate Andrew Carnegie to build the Peace Palace to house the court as well as to endow it with a library of international law.

facts.text: Russian Czar Nicholas II proposed a conference to settle disputes peacefully due to arms race risks.
facts.sourceQuote: Faced with economic challenges caused by the military build-up, as well as the risk of a large-scale armed conflict, Russian Czar Nicholas II proposed a conference to develop peaceful mechanisms of settling international disputes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Faced with economic challenges caused by the military build-up, as well as the risk of a large-scale armed conflict, Russian Czar Nicholas II proposed a conference to develop peaceful mechanisms of settling international disputes.

facts.text: The Palace contains a 3.2-tonne vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, and marble from Italy.
facts.sourceQuote: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the gifts are a 3.2-tonne (3.1-long-ton; 3.5-short-ton) vase from Russia, doors from Belgium, marble from Italy, a fountain from Denmark, the clock for the clock tower from Switzerland, Persian rugs from Persia, wood from Malaysia, Indonesia, Brazil and the United States of America and wrought-iron fences from Germany.

facts.text: Wrought-iron fences were provided by Germany alongside wood contributions from Malaysia and Brazil.

features.name: Binnenpoort

facts.text: The gate was constructed in 1634 alongside the nearby Mauritspoort to enclose the Binnenhof.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is samen met de nabijgelegen Mauritspoort gebouwd in 1634 en werd gebruikt om het Binnenhof af te sluiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1634 together with the nearby Mauritspoort and was used to enclose the Binnenhof.

facts.text: Brick construction features sandstone surrounds with two lions positioned above the entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: De toegangspoort is van baksteen met zandstenen omlijstingen. Boven de poort bevinden zich twee leeuwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The entrance gate is made of brick with sandstone surrounds. Above the gate are two lions.

features.opening: De Binnenpoort of Middenpoort is een van de vier bewaard gebleven toegangspoorten die toegang geven tot het Binnenhof in Den Haag.

features.name: Louwman Museum

facts.text: Founder Pieter Louwman started the collection in 1934 by buying a 20-year-old Dodge.
facts.sourceQuote: It was founded in 1934 with the purchase of a 20-year-old Dodge by Dodge importer Pieter Louwman, the father of the current owner.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded in 1934 with the purchase of a 20-year-old Dodge by Dodge importer Pieter Louwman, the father of the current owner.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix opened the current museum on July 3, 2010, next to her former home Huis ten Bosch.
facts.sourceQuote: On 3 July 2010 the current museum in The Hague, named Louwman Museum, was opened by Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands, whose former home Huis ten Bosch neighbours the museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 3 July 2010 the current museum in The Hague, named Louwman Museum, was opened by Queen Beatrix of the Netherlands, whose former home Huis ten Bosch neighbours the museum.

facts.text: The name Louwman Collection was officially adopted on April 18, 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: On 18 April 2003 the name "Louwman Collection" was adopted.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 18 April 2003 the name "Louwman Collection" was adopted.

facts.text: The institution moved to its current location on Leidsestraatweg in 2010.
facts.sourceQuote: It has been situated on the Leidsestraatweg near the A44 motorway since 2010.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It has been situated on the Leidsestraatweg near the A44 motorway since 2010.

facts.text: The collection features historic coaches alongside cars and motorcycles.
facts.sourceQuote: The Louwman Museum is a museum for historic cars, coaches, and motorcycles in The Hague, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Louwman Museum is a museum for historic cars, coaches, and motorcycles in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.opening: The Louwman Museum is a museum for historic cars, coaches, and motorcycles in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: Bethlehemkerk

facts.text: Anne Klaas Straatsma was appointed as a preacher at this location in 1928.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1928 was Anne Klaas Straatsma reeds als predikant aangesteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1928, Anne Klaas Straatsma had already been appointed as a preacher.

facts.text: Rotterdam architects Johan Coenraad Meischke and Pieter Schmidt created the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw werd door de Rotterdamse architecten Johan Coenraad Meischke en Pieter Schmidt van het Architectenbureau Meischke en Schmidt ontworpen, en kon in 1931 in gebruik worden genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was designed by the Rotterdam architects Johan Coenraad Meischke and Pieter Schmidt of the Architectenbureau Meischke and Schmidt, and could be put into use in 1931.

facts.text: The tower rises 55 meters high and features a copper spire.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren is 55m hoog en heeft een koperen spits.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower is 55m high and has a copper spire.

facts.text: Princess Juliana and Prince Bernhard visited as an engaged couple with Queen Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuote: Prinses Juliana en prins Bernhard brachten hier als jong verloofd paar hun eerste kerkbezoek samen met koningin Wilhelmina.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Princess Juliana and Prince Bernhard brought their first church visit here as a young engaged couple together with Queen Wilhelmina.

features.opening: De Bethlehemkerk aan de Laan van Meerdervoort 627 in Den Haag is een kerkgebouw van de Protestantse Gemeente ‘s Gravenhage.

features.name: Paard

facts.text: Early years featured a permissive cannabis policy while banning hard drugs.
facts.sourceQuote: In its early years, the venue was noted for its permissive policy on use of cannabis which was also sold in the venue, although use of hard drugs was not allowed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In its early years, the venue was noted for its permissive policy on use of cannabis which was also sold in the venue, although use of hard drugs was not allowed.

facts.text: Funding from Music Center the Netherlands recognizes it as a distinguished 'kernpodia' venue.
facts.sourceQuote: Therefore, it receives funding from Music Center the Netherlands as one of seven distinguished venues (called 'kernpodia') of the Netherlands (together with Paradiso, Melkweg, Rotown, Tivoli, 013, Doornroosje) The venue was rewarded with the Nachttempel Award in 2005.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Therefore, it receives funding from Music Center the Netherlands as one of seven distinguished venues (called 'kernpodia') of the Netherlands (together with Paradiso, Melkweg, Rotown, Tivoli, 013, Doornroosje) The venue was rewarded with the Nachttempel Award in 2005.

facts.text: The main stage holds 1,100 people while the smallest GR8 room fits only 80 guests.
facts.sourceQuote: The venue has four stages, a main stage (capacity 1,100 people), a small stage (capacity 350 people), Paardcafe (capacity 200 people) and GR8 (capacity 80 people).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The venue has four stages, a main stage (capacity 1,100 people), a small stage (capacity 350 people), Paardcafe (capacity 200 people) and GR8 (capacity 80 people).

facts.text: Paard was formerly known as Paard van Troje, the Dutch term for Trojan Horse.
facts.sourceQuote: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the alderman of culture from The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the alderman of culture from The Hague.

facts.text: The venue opened on June 18, 1972 with support from The Hague's alderman of culture.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: PAARD, formerly known as Paard van Troje (Dutch for Trojan Horse), is a venue in The Hague, Netherlands founded on 18 June 1972 with the support of the alderman of culture from The Hague.

facts.text: Since 2024, Paard has managed GR8, a building containing a record store and theater hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2024, Paard has also managed GR8, a multi-purpose building with meeting rooms, a theater hall, and a record store on Prinsegracht 8.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2024, Paard has also managed GR8, a multi-purpose building with meeting rooms, a theater hall, and a record store on Prinsegracht 8.

features.name: Amare

facts.text: Neutelings Riedijk Architects won the design competition against Zaha Hadid and RAU.
facts.sourceQuote: Neutelings Riedijk Architecten won het uiteindelijk van Zaha Hadid en RAU.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Neutelings Riedijk Architects ultimately won against Zaha Hadid and RAU.

facts.text: The municipal council approved construction on November 8, 2012 after a year-long postponement.
facts.sourceQuote: Die besloot daarom in 2011 de keuze tussen nieuwbouw of renovatie een jaar uit te stellen, zodat het ontwerp voor nieuwbouw kon worden versimpeld om de kosten te drukken. Op 8 november 2012 stemde de gemeenteraad in met de bouw van het Spuiforum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Therefore, in 2011, it decided to postpone the choice between new construction or renovation for a year, so that the design for new construction could be simplified to reduce costs. On November 8, 2012, the municipal council approved the construction of the Spuiforum.

facts.text: All college parties voted in favor while every opposition party voted against the project.
facts.sourceQuote: Alle collegepartijen stemden voor, alle oppositiepartijen tegen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All college parties voted in favor, all opposition parties against.

facts.text: Cadanz, a collaboration of Boele & Van Eesteren and Visser & Smit Bouw, built the complex.
facts.sourceQuote: Het complex wordt gebouwd door Cadanz, een samenwerking van Boele & Van Eesteren en Visser & Smit Bouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex is being built by Cadanz, a collaboration of Boele & Van Eesteren and Visser & Smit Bouw.

facts.text: Delivery legally set for June 29, 2021, actually occurred two weeks later in July.
facts.sourceQuote: De oplevering, juridisch vastgesteld op 29 juni 2021, vond daadwerkelijk twee weken later plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The delivery, legally determined on June 29, 2021, actually took place two weeks later.

facts.text: A construction error caused the floor to sink, jamming doors shortly after delivery.
facts.sourceQuote: Kort na de oplevering, begin 2022, bleek de vloer van het gebouw door een bouwfout te zijn verzakt, waardoor deuren klem kwamen te zitten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Shortly after delivery, early 2022, it was discovered that the floor of the building had sunk due to a construction error, causing doors to jam.

features.opening: Amare is het onderwijs- en cultuurgebouw aan het Spuiplein in Den Haag.

features.name: Laaktheater

facts.text: Theater Pierrot dissolved after mismanagement and continued as Laaktheater in 2012.
facts.sourceQuote: Na mismanagement werd het Theater Pierrot ontbonden en ging in 2012 door als "Laaktheater".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After mismanagement, the Theater Pierrot was dissolved and continued as "Laaktheater" in 2012.

facts.text: Regular users include the Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater, and Filmclub Laak.
facts.sourceQuote: Vaste gebruikers zijn het Laaks Jeugdtheater, Medea-theater en Filmclub Laak.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Regular users are Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater and Filmclub Laak.

facts.text: The venue features a large studio specifically designed for dance lessons.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater heeft een theaterzaal met 135 zitplaatsen op een halfronde tribune, een grote studio voor o.a. danslessen en een kleine studio.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater has a theater hall with 135 seats on a semicircular balcony, a large studio for dance lessons, among other things, and a small studio.

features.opening: Het Laaktheater is een lijsttheater gelegen aan de Ferrandweg in de wijk Spoorwijk in Den Haag.

features.name: Monument van Puin

facts.text: Monument van Puin translates to 'Monument of Rubble' because it is made of debris from demolished WWII houses.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een grote bol bestaand uit stukken steenpuin afkomstig van huizen die in de Tweede Wereldoorlog zijn afgebroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a large ball consisting of pieces of rubble from houses that were demolished during World War II.

facts.text: The artist Donald Duk, born in Groningen, designed this unique structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Het 'Monument van Puin' is ontworpen door de in Groningen geboren kunstenaar Donald Duk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Monument van Puin' was designed by the artist Donald Duk, born in Groningen.

facts.text: The ball sits at the foot of a hill where it supposedly gathered its rubble while rolling down during its descent.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo is deze bal gesitueerd aan de voet van de naastgelegen heuvel vanwaar hij zou zijn afgerold en steeds meer puin tijdens het naar beneden rollen hebben vergaard.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, this ball is located at the foot of the adjacent hill from which it would have rolled down and accumulated more and more debris during its descent.

facts.text: Rubble from demolished coastal buildings formed dune-like piles for the Atlantic Wall during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Het 'Monument van Puin' herinnert de inwoners van Den Haag aan de op duinen gelijkende puinbergen nabij Kijkduin die tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog zijn ontstaan uit het verzamelde puin van afgebroken bebouwing langs de kust ten behoeve van de aanleg van de Atlantikwall in Scheveningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 'Monument van Puin' reminds the inhabitants of The Hague of the dune-like piles of rubble near Kijkduin that arose during World War II from the collected rubble of demolished buildings along the coast for the construction of the Atlantic Wall in Scheveningen.

features.name: Nationaal Onafhankelijkheidsmonument

facts.text: The name Eben-Ezer on the pedestal references a biblical victory of Israelites over Philistines rather than Dutch history.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de sokkel staat in grote zwarte letters de naam Eben-Haëzer, die verwijst naar de overwinning van de Israëlieten op de Filistijnen in het Bijbelboek 1 Samuel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal is the name Eben-Ezer in large black letters, which refers to the victory of the Israelites over the Philistines in the book of 1 Samuel in the Bible.

facts.text: Queen Juliana laid a wreath there on November 30, 1963 to mark 150 years of independence.
facts.sourceQuote: Op zaterdag 30 november 1963 legde koningin Juliana een krans bij het monument om te herdenken dat de Prins van Oranje 150 jaar eerder in Scheveningen was aangekomen en Nederland 150 jaar onafhankelijk was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On Saturday, November 30, 1963, Queen Juliana laid a wreath at the monument to commemorate that the Prince of Orange had arrived in Scheveningen 150 years earlier and that the Netherlands had been 150 years independent.

features.opening: Het Nationaal Monument op het Plein 1813 in Den Haag werd in 1869 onthuld ter nagedachtenis aan de overwinning op Napoleon, het einde van de Franse tijd in…

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'Dwangarbeiders'

facts.text: Marcel Prins designed this monument which was unveiled on November 1, 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op 1 november 1999 onthuld en is ontworpen door Marcel Prins.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was unveiled on November 1, 1999 and was designed by Marcel Prins.

facts.text: Over 30,000 of the nearly half million forced laborers never returned home from their captivity.
facts.sourceQuote: Van de ruim half miljoen mannen zijn ruim 30.000 dwangarbeiders niet teruggekeerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Of the nearly half million men, more than 30,000 forced laborers have not returned.

features.opening: Dwangarbeiders is een oorlogsmonument in Den Haag.

features.name: Theater aan het Spui

facts.text: Architect Herman Hertzberger designed the venue with a large room for 360 and a small room for 170.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater is een ontwerp van architect Herman Hertzberger en beschikt over twee zalen: de grote zaal met 360 stoelen en de kleine zaal met 170 stoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater is a design by architect Herman Hertzberger and has two rooms: the large room with 360 seats and the small room with 170 seats.

facts.text: The theater officially opened on March 6, 1993, during a ceremony by two city aldermen.
facts.sourceQuote: Theater aan het Spui werd op zaterdag 6 maart 1993 geopend door de wethouders Ans van den Berg (Cultuur) en Peter Noordanus (Stadsvernieuwing).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Theater aan het Spui was opened on Saturday, March 6, 1993 by the aldermen Ans van den Berg (Culture) and Peter Noordanus (Urban Renewal).

facts.text: Festivals like Movies that Matter and Holland Dance Festival regularly take place within its halls.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater huisvest een aantal festivals als Todaysart, CaDance, Movies that Matter, Holland Dance Festival en Writers Unlimited (voorheen Winternachten).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater hosts a number of festivals such as Todaysart, CaDance, Movies that Matter, Holland Dance Festival and Writers Unlimited (formerly Winternachten).

features.opening: Theater aan het Spui is een middelgroot vlakkevloertheater gelegen aan het Spui, het culturele hart van Den Haag.

features.name: Paleiskerk

facts.text: The pointed facade features a monumental rose window alongside large round arched side windows.
facts.sourceQuote: In de puntgevel zit een monumentaal roosvenster. In de zijmuren zijn grote rondboogvensters aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the pointed facade there is a monumental rose window. Large round arched windows have been installed in the side walls.

facts.text: Hague architect Klaas Stoffels designed the hall church specifically for the Baptist community.
facts.sourceQuote: De eenbeukige zaalkerk is voor de doopsgezinde gemeenschap ontworpen door de Haagse architect Klaas Stoffels.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hall church with a single nave was designed for the Baptist community by the Hague architect Klaas Stoffels.

facts.text: After restoration, the church is rented for weddings and concerts alongside regular services.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds de restauratie wordt de kerk beheerd door een stichting die de kerk, naast de reguliere kerkdiensten, verhuurt voor huwelijken, concerten, etc.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the restoration, the church has been managed by a foundation that rents the church, in addition to regular church services, for weddings, concerts, etc.

features.opening: De Paleiskerk of doopsgezinde kerk in Den Haag is een neoromaanse kerk uit 1886 aan de Paleisstraat, vlak bij Paleis Noordeinde.

features.name: Heilige Pastoor van Arskerk

facts.text: Heilige Pastoor van Arskerk honors John Maria Vianney, a pastor in Ars near Lyon.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is gewijd aan de Franse rooms-katholieke heilige Johannes Maria Vianney die pastoor was te Ars bij Lyon.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church is dedicated to the French Roman Catholic saint John Maria Vianney who was a pastor in Ars near Lyon.

facts.text: A separate exit allows visitors to leave without turning their backs on sacred matters.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de aparte uitgang hoeft de kerkganger zijn rug na de dienst niet naar heilige zaken toe te keren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the separate exit, the churchgoer does not have to turn his back to sacred matters after the service.

features.name: Nieuwe Badkapel

facts.text: The front facade displays two towers capped with distinctive round tops.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de voorgevel zijn twee torens met een ronde bovenkant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the front facade are two towers with a round top.

facts.text: Seven copper lamps hang from wooden barrel vaults inside the spacious interior.
facts.sourceQuote: De plafonds zijn houten tongewelven, waaraan zeven koperen lampen hangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ceilings are wooden barrel vaults, on which seven copper lamps hang.

facts.text: Modern furniture including a baptismal font was designed for the space in 1989.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1989 werden een nieuw avondsmaaltafel, doopvont, lessenaar en stoel voor de predikant ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1989, a new evening table, baptismal font, lectern and chair for the preacher were designed.

features.opening: De Nieuwe Badkapel is een kerk van de protestantse gemeente te Scheveningen.

features.name: Theater De Regentes

facts.text: At its opening, the facility was Europe's largest covered swimming and bathing hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de oprichting was De Regentes de grootste overdekte zwem- en badinrichting van Europa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the time of its establishment, De Regentes was the largest covered swimming and bathing facility in Europe.

facts.text: The 1920s structure features distinctive art deco architectural elements.
facts.sourceQuote: In het uit 1920 daterende gebouw met art-deco-elementen heeft menig Hagenaar zijn zwemdiploma behaald of de op de eerste etage gelegen tearoom bezocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Many Hagenaars have obtained their swimming diploma or visited the tearoom on the first floor in the 1920s building with art deco elements.

facts.text: A neighborhood initiative saved the dilapidated pool from demolition in 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: Omdat de renovatie en onderhoudskosten te hoog waren, is in 1995 besloten het pand te sluiten en te slopen. Na de sluiting namen buurtbewoners het initiatief om het markante gebouw voor de buurt te behouden en een nieuwe functie te geven voor de kleurrijke maar enigszins in verval geraakte wijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the renovation and maintenance costs were too high, it was decided in 1995 to close and demolish the building. After the closure, neighborhood residents took the initiative to preserve the striking building for the neighborhood and give a new function to the colorful but somewhat dilapidated district.

facts.text: Programming once featured Hindustani dance alongside Dutch opera and singer-songwriters.
facts.sourceQuote: Met ruimhartige ondersteuning van de Gemeente en met name Fonds 1818 veroverde De Regentes een plek in de stad die er toe deed en herkenbaar was voor een groot en gemêleerd publiek, met een programmering waarin Hindoestaans toneel en dans naast een bijzonder serie singer-songwriters, toneel, muziektheater en kleinschalige opera, ook het Nederlands Danstheater bewonderd kon worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With generous support from the Municipality and in particular from the Fonds 1818, De Regentes won a place in the city that mattered and was recognizable to a large and diverse audience, with a programming in which Hindustani theater and dance could be admired alongside a special series of singer-songwriters, theater, music theater and small-scale opera, as well as the Dutch Dance Theater.

facts.text: The facade and tilework still clearly show the building's special architecture.
facts.sourceQuote: De bijzondere architectuur en de authenticiteit van het gebouw zijn nog duidelijk herkenbaar bijvoorbeeld in de gevel en het tegelwerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The special architecture and the authenticity of the building are still clearly recognizable, for example in the facade and the tilework.

facts.text: The Great Hall was formerly a swimming pool hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat geldt ook voor de vijf zalen: De Grote zaal (de voormalige zwembadhal) De Kleine zaal (het voormalige kikkerbad) Het Ketelhuis (de voormalige ketelruimte) Het Diepe (voorheen het bassin van het zwembad) De Studio
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This also applies to the five rooms: The Great Hall (the former swimming pool hall) The Small Hall (the former frog pool) The Kettle House (the former boiler room) The Deep (formerly the pool's basin) The Studio

features.opening: Theater De Regentes (na een herstart officieel "De Nieuwe Regentes") in Den Haag heette oorspronkelijk Theater Zwembad de Regentes en is opgericht in 1996.

features.name: Oranjehotel

facts.text: The Scheveningen site houses a UN Detention Unit for international suspects like those at the ICTY.
facts.sourceQuote: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A special independent unit in the Scheveningen location serves as a United Nations Detention Unit (UNDU) for international offenders where they remain in pre-trial detention under the responsibility of the United Nations like suspects of the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia (ICTY) and of the International Criminal Court (ICC).

facts.text: The facility accommodates over 1,000 detainees across two separate locations in Zoetermeer and Scheveningen.
facts.sourceQuote: It can accommodate more than 1,000 detainees and consists of two locations, at Zoetermeer and Scheveningen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It can accommodate more than 1,000 detainees and consists of two locations, at Zoetermeer and Scheveningen.

facts.text: The Zoetermeer facility opened in 1995 within the Rokkenhage district.
facts.sourceQuote: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Zoetermeer location of the Hague Penitentiary Institution was built in 1995 and is located in the Rokkenhage district of Zoetermeer, a city in western Netherlands, in the province of South Holland.

facts.text: Nearly 400 detainees can be held at this specific location.
facts.sourceQuote: The location has capacity for nearly 400 detainees.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The location has capacity for nearly 400 detainees.

features.name: Heilige Familiekerk

facts.text: Jan Stuyt designed the church with two identical towers and a pediment featuring a mosaic of the Heilige Familiekerk.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect Jan Stuyt ontwierp een grote driebeukige kruiskerk in neoromaanse stijl. De voorzijde van de kerk is voorzien van twee identieke torens. De gevel wordt bekroond door een fronton, met een mozaïek waarop de Heilige Familie staat afgebeeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Architect Jan Stuyt designed a large three-aisled cruciform church in neo-Romanesque style. The front of the church is equipped with two identical towers. The facade is crowned by a pediment, with a mosaic depicting the Heilige Family.

features.opening: De Heilige Familiekerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan het Kamperfoelieplein in Den Haag.

features.name: Constantyn Huygens

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on Huygens's birthday in September 1897 after a foundation laid the previous May.
facts.sourceQuote: Pas in mei 1897 werd het fundament voor het gedenkteken gelegd en op 4 september 1897, Huygens' geboortedag, kon het worden onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was not until May 1897 that the foundation for the monument was laid and on September 4, 1897, Huygens's birthday, it could be unveiled.

facts.text: The monument honors Constantyn Huygens, whose bust wears a cloak loosely draped over one shoulder.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gedenkteken bestaat uit een buste van Huygens, die zijn hoofd enigszins heeft gedraaid en een mantel losjes over de schouder heeft hangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument consists of a bust of Huygens, who has turned his head slightly and has a cloak loosely hanging over his shoulder.

facts.text: A neo-baroque stone pedestal supports the bust and displays his family coat of arms in an engraved cartouche.
facts.sourceQuote: De buste is geplaatst op een neobarokke, hardstenen sokkel, waarop in een cartouche Huygens' familiewapen is aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bust is placed on a neo-baroque, stone pedestal, on which Huygens's family coat of arms is engraved in a cartouche.

facts.text: A battered field below bears the relief text identifying him as Constantyn Huygens with the dates 1596-1687.
facts.sourceQuote: Daaronder een gebouchardeerd veld met in reliëf de tekst: CONSTANTYNHUYGENS1596-1687
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Below it is a battered field with the text in relief: CONSTANTYNHUYGENS1596-1687

features.opening: Het gedenkmonument Constantijn Huygens werd in 1897 opgericht in Scheveningen.

features.name: Stadhouderspoort

facts.text: Stadhouderspoort was originally named Middelpoort before receiving its current title.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk werd de poort de Middelpoort genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the gate was called the Middelpoort.

facts.text: The name Stadhouderspoort likely reflects that only the stadtholder could use this gate from 1634.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens historicus Jacob de Riemer ontleent het zijn naam eraan dat deze, mogelijk vanaf 1634, toen de andere poorten waren vernieuwd, alleen door de stadhouder gebruikt mocht worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to historian Jacob de Riemer, its name derives from the fact that it was only allowed to be used by the stadtholder, possibly from 1634, when the other gates were renewed.

facts.text: A tram once ran through this gate, requiring a smaller pedestrian entrance added in 1879.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij werkzaamheden in 1879 werd naast de poort een kleiner voetgangerspoortje aangebracht. Dat was nodig omdat vanaf die tijd een tram door de poort over het Binnenhof reed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During work in 1879, in addition to the gate, a smaller pedestrian gate was installed. This was necessary because from that time on a tram ran through the gate over the Binnenhof.

facts.text: The current stone frame is an 1879 replica of the original late Gothic structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De natuurstenen poortomlijsting aan de kant van het Buitenhof is uitgevoerd in de stijl van de late Gotiek en dateerde oorspronkelijk van een veel oudere datum. De huidige natuurstenen poortomlijsting van de Stadhouderspoort is een replica uit 1879.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The natural stone gate framing on the side of the Buitenhof is executed in the style of late Gothic and originally dates from a much earlier date. The current natural stone gate frame of the Stadhouderspoort is a replica from 1879.

facts.text: A lift bridge at the gate vanished when the surrounding canal was filled in 1860.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de poort hoorde ook een ophaalbrug, maar deze verdween toen in 1860 de gracht om het Binnenhof werd gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the gate there was also a lift bridge, but this disappeared when the canal around the Binnenhof was filled in in 1860.

features.opening: De Stadhouderspoort is een poort die het Binnenhof en Buitenhof in Den Haag met elkaar verbindt.

features.name: Spinoza

facts.text: French sculptor Frédéric Hexamer won the competition to create the statue in July 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen in totaal zeventien ontwerpen binnen, waarvan dat van de Franse beeldhouwer Frédéric Hexamer (1847-1924) in juli 1878 met vijf tegen één werd verkozen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A total of seventeen designs were submitted, of which that of the French sculptor Frédéric Hexamer (1847-1924) was chosen in July 1878 with five against one.

facts.text: The statue depicts Spinoza sitting, a choice that initially drew criticism from committee member Van Limburg Stirum.
facts.sourceQuote: Van Limburg Stirum was tegen het ontwerp, omdat Spinoza zittend was afgebeeld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Van Limburg Stirum was against the design, because Spinoza was depicted sitting.

facts.text: The statue's pedestal is made of red Swedish granite polished in Berlin.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld staat op een sokkel van rood Zweeds graniet, gehakt en gepolijst in Berlijn, met de inscriptie SPINOZA Het geheel wordt omgeven door een hekwerk, dat werd gemaakt bij de Haagse firma Enthoven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image stands on a pedestal of red Swedish granite, cut and polished in Berlin, with the inscription SPINOZA The whole is surrounded by a fence, which was made by the Hague company Enthoven.

facts.text: Spinoza holds a pen against his head while resting papers on his knee.
facts.sourceQuote: In zijn linkerhand, die op de knie rust, houdt hij een stapeltje papieren. Zijn rechterhand, waarin hij een pen vasthoudt, leunt tegen het hoofd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In his left hand, resting on his knee, he holds a stack of papers. His right hand, holding a pen, rests against his head.

features.opening: Het standbeeld van Spinoza is een 19e-eeuws gedenkteken in Den Haag, ter nagedachtenis aan de filosoof Benedictus de Spinoza.

features.name: Theater PePijn

facts.text: Paul van Vliet founded the group with his wife Liselore, Ferd Hugas, and pianist Rob van Kreeveld.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1964 richtte Paul van Vliet met Liselore, inmiddels zijn echtgenote, en Ferd Hugas en de pianist Rob van Kreeveld de cabaretgroep PePijn (1964-1970) en het theater PePijn op.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1964, Paul van Vliet founded the cabaret group PePijn (1964-1970) and the theater PePijn with Liselore, now his wife, and Ferd Hugas and the pianist Rob van Kreeveld.

facts.text: The theater group collapsed after seven years before Paul van Vliet launched a solo career in 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: De theatergroep viel na zeven jaar uiteen en in 1971 startte Paul van Vliet zijn solocarrière, met PePijn als thuisbasis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater group collapsed after seven years and in 1971 Paul van Vliet started his solo career, with PePijn as his home base.

facts.text: Mayor Kolfschoten opened the venue hours after a nearby arts building burned down.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 18 december 1964 opende burgemeester Kolfschoten het theater PePijn van Paul van Vliet met de woorden: "La Reine est morte, vive le petit prince" want enkele uren eerder was het Gebouw voor Kunsten en Wetenschappen afgebrand.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On December 18, 1964, Mayor Kolfschoten opened the PePijn theater by Paul van Vliet with the words: "La Reine est morte, vive le petit prince" because a few hours earlier the Building for Arts and Sciences had been burned down.

facts.text: Performers originally sold tickets and managed the wardrobe without any staff.
facts.sourceQuote: In het begin was er geen personeel, de cabaretiers zorgden voor de kaartverkoop en de garderobe en ontvingen zelf de bezoekers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At first there was no staff, the cabaret performers took care of ticket sales and the wardrobe and received the visitors themselves.

facts.text: The venue hosted jazz legends like Dexter Gordon under the Jazz in PePijn series.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren '70 was het theater ook een huiskamer voor ervaren en beginnende jazzmusici, en onder de naam 'Jazz in PePijn' (JIP) geïntroduceerd door Wim van Woerkens; onder andere speelden er: Frans Elsen, Billy Higgins, Ferdinand Povel, Rob Agerbeek, Dexter Gordon, Ack van Rooyen en Woody Shaw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1970s, the theater was also a living room for experienced and beginning jazz musicians, and introduced under the name 'Jazz in PePijn' (JIP) by Wim van Woerkens; among others, there played: Frans Elsen, Billy Higgins, Ferdinand Povel, Rob Agerbeek, Dexter Gordon, Ack van Rooyen and Woody Shaw.

features.opening: PePijn is een theater in Den Haag dat zich heeft toegespitst op cabaret, stand-upcomedy en kleinkunst.

features.name: O.L.V. Onbevlekt Ontvangen / Elandstraatkerk

facts.text: The parish board announced in November 2023 that it intended to withdraw the church from worship.
facts.sourceQuote: In november 2023 heeft het parochiebestuur het voornemen bekendgemaakt om de Onze Lieve Vrouw Onbevlekt Ontvangen-kerk en de Agneskerk aan de eredienst te onttrekken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2023, the parish board announced its intention to withdraw the Onze Lieve Vrouw Onbevlekt Ontvangen church and the Agnes church from worship.

facts.text: The auxiliary church became an independent parish on June 5, 1878, blessed by Bishop Snickers of Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 5 juni 1878 werd de hulpkerk een zelfstandige parochiekerk, ingezegend door bisschop Snickers van Haarlem.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On June 5, 1878, the auxiliary church became an independent parish church, blessed by Bishop Snickers of Haarlem.

facts.text: Father Marijnen purchased the land from Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, daughter of King William II.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1877 kocht pater Marijnen van de Teresia van Avilakerk grond van Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, de enige dochter van koning Willem II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1877, Father Marijnen van de Teresia van Avilakerk bought land from Sophie van Sachsen-Weimar, the only daughter of King William II.

facts.text: A parish house was put into use just months after the order to build a chapel was given in 1878.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1878 werd opdracht gegeven een hulpkerk te bouwen. Er kwam ook een pastorie bij, die in april 1878 in gebruik werd genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1878, an order was given to build a chapel. A parish house was also added, which was put into use in April 1878.

features.opening: De Onze Lieve Vrouw Onbevlekt Ontvangenkerk, ook bekend als de Elandkerk of Elandstraatkerk, is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Elandstraat in het…

features.name: Vrijmetselarij Museum

facts.text: Prince Frederick served as Grand Master from 1816 to 1881 before donating his library in 1866.
facts.sourceQuote: Prins Frederik was van 1816 tot 1881 Grootmeester van de Orde van Vrijmetselaren onder het Grootoosten der Nederlanden en schonk de Orde in 1866 de Bibliotheca Klossiana, die een belangrijk onderdeel werd van de collectie van het CMC.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prince Frederick was Grand Master of the Order of Freemasons under the Grand Orient of the Netherlands from 1816 to 1881 and donated the Bibliotheca Klossiana to the Order in 1866, which became an important part of the CMC's collection.

facts.text: The collection spans nearly 250 years of artifacts gathered by Dutch Freemasons over centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: Het centrum beheert de collectie die de Nederlandse vrijmetselaren in ruim 250 jaar bijeen hebben gebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The center manages the collection that the Dutch Freemasons have brought together over nearly 250 years.

features.opening: Het Cultureel Maçonniek Centrum 'Prins Frederik' (CMC) te Den Haag, in de Nederlandse provincie Zuid-Holland, is een museum, archief en bibliotheek van de Orde…

features.name: Museum Beelden aan Zee

facts.text: Beelden aan Zee means "Images/sculptures by the sea".
facts.sourceQuote: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida Scholten, is the only Dutch museum which specialises in only exhibiting sculpture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida Scholten, is the only Dutch museum which specialises in only exhibiting sculpture.

facts.text: The Sculptuur Instituut research institute joined the museum in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2004, the museum building also houses the Sculptuur Instituut ("Sculpture Institute"), a research institute on contemporary sculpture.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2004, the museum building also houses the Sculptuur Instituut ("Sculpture Institute"), a research institute on contemporary sculpture.

facts.text: Brigitte Bloksma became director in May 2022 after Jan Teeuwisse served for twenty years.
facts.sourceQuote: The current director is Brigitte Bloksma. In May 2022, she replaced Jan Teeuwisse, who had acted as museum director for twenty years.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current director is Brigitte Bloksma. In May 2022, she replaced Jan Teeuwisse, who had acted as museum director for twenty years.

facts.text: Visitors can see the sea from the roof but cannot view the nearby Scheveningen beach.
facts.sourceQuote: From the roof of the museum one can see the sea, but not the boulevard nor the Scheveningen beach.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From the roof of the museum one can see the sea, but not the boulevard nor the Scheveningen beach.

facts.text: Concrete walls feature a unique slot system allowing art to hang from bolts set into wall blocks.
facts.sourceQuote: The concrete and glass museum has an unusual slot-system in the concrete walls designed by the architect, so that sculpture or paintings can be hung from a bolt set into one of the many blocks in the walls.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The concrete and glass museum has an unusual slot-system in the concrete walls designed by the architect, so that sculpture or paintings can be hung from a bolt set into one of the many blocks in the walls.

facts.text: Architect Wim Quist designed the structure beneath the historic Pavilion of Wied.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum building was designed by architect Wim Quist, underneath the historic "Pavilion of Wied" King William I built in 1826 for his wife, Princess Wilhelmine of Prussia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum building was designed by architect Wim Quist, underneath the historic "Pavilion of Wied" King William I built in 1826 for his wife, Princess Wilhelmine of Prussia.

features.opening: Beelden aan Zee ("Images/sculptures by the sea") museum in the Scheveningen district of The Hague, founded in 1994 by the sculpture collectors Theo and Lida…

features.name: Onbevlekt Hart van Maria

facts.text: Construction was completed in just twenty weeks starting with a stone laid on Easter Monday 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw duurde slechts twintig weken. Op Paasmaandag 1947 werd de eerste steen gelegd door Mgr.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction only lasted twenty weeks. On Easter Monday 1947, the first stone was laid by Bishop.

facts.text: Before the church existed, parishioners gathered at changing locations including Welgelegen farm in Wassenaar.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot die tijd kwamen de gelovingen uit die wijk bijeen op wisselende lokaties, waaronder boerderij Welgelegen aan de Zijdeweg 56, net over de gemeentegrens in Wassenaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until then, the believers from that neighborhood gathered at changing locations, including Welgelegen farm at Zijdeweg 56, just across the municipal border in Wassenaar.

facts.text: In 2007, it became a prayer house for the Holy Three Kings parish.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 2007 een gebedshuis van de parochie 'Heilige Driekoningen', deze ging in 2015 deel uitmaken van de parochie Maria Sterre der Zee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church became a prayer house of the parish 'Holy Three Kings' in 2007, which became part of the parish Maria Star of the Sea in 2015.

facts.text: By 2015, this church joined the Maria Star of the Sea parish.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 2007 een gebedshuis van de parochie 'Heilige Driekoningen', deze ging in 2015 deel uitmaken van de parochie Maria Sterre der Zee.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church became a prayer house of the parish 'Holy Three Kings' in 2007, which became part of the parish Maria Star of the Sea in 2015.

features.opening: De Onbevlekt Hart van Mariakerk, ook wel bekend als de Marlotkerk is een rooms-katholieke kerkgebouw aan het Bloklandenplein in Den Haag.

features.name: Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk

facts.text: The architect placed buttresses inside the walls to maximize interior space.
facts.sourceQuote: Bijzonder is dat de architect de steunberen aan de binnenkant van de muren plaatste om de beschikbare ruimte optimaal te kunnen benutten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: What is special is that the architect placed the buttresses on the inside of the walls in order to make the most of the available space.

facts.text: Rich polychromy made Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk the most expensive Dutch church of the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Mede door de kostbare polychromie was de Sint-Jacobus de duurste Nederlandse kerk van de 19e eeuw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In part due to the precious polychromy, the Sint-Jacobus was the most expensive Dutch church of the 19th century.

features.opening: De Sint-Jacobus de Meerderekerk (ook: Jacobuskerk) is een rooms-katholieke kerk aan de Parkstraat in het Centrum van Den Haag.

features.name: Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen

facts.text: 138,000 people were evicted from their homes in Scheveningen and The Hague to make way for the fortifications.
facts.sourceQuote: Alleen al in Scheveningen en Den Haag werden 138.000 mensen uit hun woning verdreven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Scheveningen and The Hague alone, 138,000 people were evicted from their homes.

facts.text: Scheveningen became one of the most heavily fortified sectors despite lacking an important port itself.
facts.sourceQuote: Scheveningen beschikte niet over een belangrijke haven, maar het Duitse civiel bestuur in Nederland met het hoofdkwartier van de Rijkscommissaris Arthur Seyss-Inquart, op Clingendael, lag niet ver landinwaarts. Daarom was zij kwetsbaar voor verrassingsaanvallen en werd de verdedigingslinie in Scheveningen een van de zwaarder uitgevoerde delen ervan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Scheveningen did not have an important port, but the German civil administration in the Netherlands with the headquarters of the Reich Commissioner Arthur Seyss-Inquart, at Clingendael, was not far inland. Therefore, it was vulnerable to surprise attacks and the defensive line in Scheveningen became one of the most heavily fortified parts of it.

facts.text: Some former bunkers now serve as foundations for houses or other buildings after decades of abandonment.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de oorlog is veel afgebroken, maar sommige bunkers of delen daarvan dienen thans als fundament voor woningen (bunkerwoningen) en andere gebouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the war, much was demolished, but some bunkers or parts of them now serve as the foundation for houses (bunkhouse homes) and other buildings.

facts.text: Volunteers keep the Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen running today.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum wordt draaiende gehouden door vrijwilligers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum is kept running by volunteers.

features.opening: Het Atlantikwall Museum Scheveningen is een in het stadsdeel Scheveningen (Den Haag) gevestigd museum, waarbij overgebleven delen van de Atlantikwall worden…

features.name: Oorlogsmonument 'De Ooievaars'

facts.text: The name Oorlogsmonument 'De Ooievaars' was chosen because the stork is central to The Hague's coat of arms.
facts.sourceQuote: Maar toen bleek dat er in Arnhem al een club met die naam was, werd gekozen voor het dier dat in het wapen van Den Haag centraal stond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: But when it turned out that there was already a club with that name in Arnhem, the animal that was central to the coat of arms of The Hague was chosen.

facts.text: The founders originally planned to call the club Vitesse before discovering an existing team with that name.
facts.sourceQuote: Aanvankelijk zou de club Vitesse gaan heten. Maar toen bleek dat er in Arnhem al een club met die naam was, werd gekozen voor het dier dat in het wapen van Den Haag centraal stond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, the club was going to be called Vitesse. But when it turned out that there was already a club with that name in Arnhem, the animal that was central to the coat of arms of The Hague was chosen.

facts.text: A Star of David is attached to the center of the marble plaque.
facts.sourceQuote: In het midden van de gedenkplaat is een davidster aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the center of the plaque is a star of David attached.

facts.text: The memorial stone moved to the Hague Football History Museum in 2020.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2020 bevindt de gedenksteen zich in het Haagse Voetbalhistorie museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2020, the memorial stone has been located in the Hague Football History Museum.

features.opening: Monument De Ooievaars is een marmeren gedenksteen op het clubgebouw van de Haagse Scheidsrechtersvereniging, gelegen aan de Kijkduinsestraat te Den Haag.

features.name: HDV Mescid-I Aksa Camii

facts.text: The Jewish community sold the building in 1976 with a condition that it never become a church.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1976 the Jewish community sold the building to the city on condition that it never be converted into a church.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1976 the Jewish community sold the building to the city on condition that it never be converted into a church.

facts.text: Turkish Muslims began using the site without permission during Ramadan in 1979 due to safety concerns.
facts.sourceQuote: The city's Turkish Muslim community began using it without permission during Ramadan 1979 due to safety concerns over their previous mosque.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The city's Turkish Muslim community began using it without permission during Ramadan 1979 due to safety concerns over their previous mosque.

features.opening: The Aqsa Mosque (Dutch: Mescidi Aksamoskee) is a mosque, located on the Wagenstraat, in the city of The Hague, in the Netherlands.

features.name: Abdijkerk Loosduinen

facts.text: The tower, owned by The Hague municipality, underwent restoration in 1941.
facts.sourceQuote: De toren, eigendom van de gemeente Den Haag, werd in 1941 gerestaureerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower, owned by the municipality of The Hague, was restored in 1941.

facts.text: Side chapels built in 1908 were removed during the major restoration starting in 1971.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1971 werd met de restauratie begonnen en daarbij werden de zijbeuken uit 1908 verwijderd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1971 restoration began and the side chapels from 1908 were removed.

facts.text: Abdijkerk Loosduinen received its official name as an abbey church in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1974 werd de kerk pas de abdijkerk genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was not until 1974 that the church was officially named the abbey church.

facts.text: The Geuzen destroyed the abbey in 1574, and Spanish forces later demolished the remaining ruins.
facts.sourceQuote: De abdij werd in 1574 door de Geuzen vernield, en daarna werden de restanten nog eens door de Spanjaarden verwoest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The abbey was destroyed by the Geuzen in 1574, and then the remains were destroyed again by the Spanish.

facts.text: Count Floris IV and Countess Machteld of Brabant made numerous donations to support the abbey.
facts.sourceQuote: Graaf Floris IV en gravin Machteld van Brabant deden veel schenkingen aan de abdij.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Count Floris IV and Countess Machteld of Brabant made many donations to the abbey.

features.opening: De Abdij van Loosduinen was een cisterciënzer nonnenklooster in Loosduinen.

features.name: De Vulkaan

facts.text: Year-round bird migration counts have been conducted here since the early 1980s.
facts.sourceQuote: Op deze locatie worden vanaf begin jaren 1980 jaarrond systematisch vogeltrektellingen verricht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Systematic bird migration counts have been carried out on this site year-round since the early 1980s.

features.opening: De Vulkaan is de hoogste duintop van het Westduinpark in Den Haag.

features.name: Pathé Buitenhof

facts.text: The former cinema hall became a café and restaurant on the first floor in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: De hal met de balie voor de kaartverkoop is in 2009 verbouwd tot café met op de eerste etage een restaurant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hall with the ticket office was converted into a café with a restaurant on the first floor in 2009.

facts.text: Ticket sales moved to vending machines while the old exit hallway now serves as the main entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: De gang die uitgang was van de bioscoop dient als ingang, de kaartverkoop is bij de automaten in de voorhal en aan de balie van de foyer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The hallway that was the exit from the cinema serves as the entrance, ticket sales are at the vending machines in the lobby and at the counter of the foyer.

facts.text: The venue later reopened under its historic name Des Deux Villes after a brief bankruptcy.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit café-restaurant (een vestiging van Maxime) ging in 2010 failliet maar maakte een doorstart. Het Grand Café en Restaurant wordt weer voortgezet onder de historische naam "Des Deux Villes".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This café-restaurant (a branch of Maxime) went bankrupt in 2010 but made a comeback. The Grand Café and Restaurant will be continued under the historic name "Des Deux Villes".

facts.text: Wrought iron balconies on the facade were crafted in the Vienna Secession style.
facts.sourceQuote: De smeedijzeren balkons werden gemaakt in stijl van de Weense Sezession.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The wrought iron balconies were made in the style of the Vienna Secession.

facts.text: Before the war, the first floor housed the Bridgeclub Buitenhof social club.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de eerste verdieping zat voor de oorlog Bridgeclub Buitenhof.De naam van restaurant "Des Deux Villes" staat nog op de gevel, en daartussen prijken de gebeeldhouwde wapens van Alkmaar en Enkhuizen, gemaakt door Rien Hack.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the first floor, before the war, there was the Bridgeclub Buitenhof. The name of the restaurant "Des Deux Villes" is still on the facade, and between them are the sculpted weapons of Alkmaar and Enkhuizen, made by Rien Hack.

features.opening: Pathé Buitenhof is een bioscoop in Den Haag aan het Buitenhof van Pathé Nederland.

features.name: Huis ten Bosch

facts.text: Workers replaced the roof and staircase while removing asbestos and wood rot from the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: The renovation included making the palace more sustainable, renewing installations and adjusting the layout; by replacing the roof and the landing staircase, renovating historic stucco ceilings and the facade, removing asbestos and wood rot, and renewing technical installations, according to Architectenweb.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The renovation included making the palace more sustainable, renewing installations and adjusting the layout; by replacing the roof and the landing staircase, renovating historic stucco ceilings and the facade, removing asbestos and wood rot, and renewing technical installations, according to Architectenweb.

facts.text: Huis ten Bosch translates to "House in the Woods".
facts.sourceQuote: Huis ten Bosch (Dutch: Paleis Huis ten Bosch, pronounced [paːˈlɛis ˌɦœys tɛm ˈbɔs]; English: "House in the Woods") is a royal palace in The Hague, Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis ten Bosch (Dutch: Paleis Huis ten Bosch, pronounced [paːˈlɛis ˌɦœys tɛm ˈbɔs]; English: "House in the Woods") is a royal palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.text: Queen Beatrix resided here from 1981 until her abdication in 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander and his family moved into Huis ten Bosch on January 13, 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Huis ten Bosch was the home of Queen Beatrix from 1981 to her abdication in 2013; King Willem-Alexander and his family moved in on 13 January 2019.

features.opening: Huis ten Bosch (Dutch: Paleis Huis ten Bosch, pronounced [paːˈlɛis ˌɦœys tɛm ˈbɔs]; English: "House in the Woods") is a royal palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: American Protestant Church Of The Hague

facts.text: Official heritage status as a reconstruction-period monument was granted in April 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: It was designated as a reconstruction-period Rijksmonument on April 24, 2015.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was designated as a reconstruction-period Rijksmonument on April 24, 2015.

features.opening: The American Protestant Church is a Protestant church building from 1958 in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: Waals-Hervormde Gemeente

facts.text: Louis Napoleon funded a new church after seizing the Hofkapel for Catholic mass in 1806.
facts.sourceQuote: Hieraan kwam een einde in de Franse tijd toen Lodewijk Napoleon Bonaparte, koning van het Koninkrijk Holland, in 1806 het Binnenhof als residentie nam en de Hofkapel wilde gebruiken voor de katholieke mis. Lodewijk Napoleon kwam de Waals-Hervormde gemeente financieel tegemoet zodat deze nieuwe kerk kon laten bouwen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This came to an end during the French period when Louis Napoleon Bonaparte, king of the Kingdom of Holland, took the Binnenhof as his residence in 1806 and wanted to use the Hofkapel for the Catholic mass. Louis Napoleon financially supported the Waals-Hervormde municipality so that it could have a new church built.

facts.text: Parisian builder Aristide Cavaillé-Coll constructed the organ installed in 1885.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel uit 1885 is gebouwd door de Parijse orgelbouwer Aristide Cavaillé-Coll, het heeft twee manualen, 23 registers en een vrij pedaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The 1885 organ was built by the Parisian organ builder Aristide Cavaillé-Coll, it has two manuals, 23 registers and a free pedal.

facts.text: J. van Duijfhuijs designed the neoclassical facade featuring round arched windows.
facts.sourceQuote: In de neoclassicistische gevel bevinden zich enkele rondboogvensters. De architect was J. van Duijfhuijs.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There are several round arched windows in the neoclassical facade. The architect was J. van Duijfhuijs.

features.opening: De Waalse kerk is een kerkgebouw van de Waals-Hervormde gemeente aan het Noordeinde in Den Haag.

features.name: Grondwetsherziening van 1848

facts.text: A parking garage with 86 spaces sits beneath shops on the east side of Heulstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: In de Heulstraat zijn aan de oostkant een aantal winkels en tussen die winkels bij nummer 21 is de ingang van een parkeergarage met 86 plaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the east side of the Heulstraat are a number of shops and between those shops at number 21 is the entrance to a parking garage with 86 spaces.

facts.text: De Nederlandsche Bank occupied a building at Noordeinde 33 until 1994.
facts.sourceQuote: De westkant wordt geheel in beslag genomen door enkele panden die bij paleis Kneuterdijk horen en een bankgebouw (Noordeinde 33) waar tot 1994 De Nederlandsche Bank zat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The west side is completely occupied by several buildings that belong to palace Kneuterdijk and a bank building (Noordeinde 33) where De Nederlandsche Bank was located until 1994.

facts.text: The golden carriage route through Den Haag connects Noordeinde Palace to the Binnenhof.
facts.sourceQuote: De gouden koets brengt op Prinsjesdag de koningin van het Paleis Noordeinde via de Heulstraat, het Lange Voorhout en de Korte Vijverberg naar het Binnenhof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On King's Day, the golden carriage takes the queen of the Noordeinde Palace through the Heulstraat, the Lange Voorhout and the Korte Vijverberg to the Binnenhof.

features.opening: De Heulstraat in Den Haag is een korte, eeuwenoude straat tussen het Noordeinde en de Kneuterdijk.

features.name: Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on June 14, 1966 to honor naval victims of World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op 14 juni 1966 onthuld en gedenkt de marineslachtoffers van de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was unveiled on June 14, 1966 and commemorates the naval victims of World War II.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina's quote The Marine did well appears on the pedestal.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het voetstuk staat een citaat van koningin Wilhelmina: "De Marine heeft het goed gedaan." Het beeld toont drie mariniers die op de boeg van een oorlogsschip met geschuttoren staan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the pedestal is a quote from Queen Wilhelmina: "The Marine did well." The image shows three marines standing on the bow of a warship with gun turrets.

features.opening: Het Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine bevindt zich aan de Zeekant in Scheveningen.

features.name: The Hague City Hall

facts.text: Two slab buildings of 10 and 12 storeys flank a central atrium.
facts.sourceQuote: At its centre is a large atrium, flanked by two large slab buildings, 10 and 12 storeys tall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At its centre is a large atrium, flanked by two large slab buildings, 10 and 12 storeys tall.

features.opening: The Hague City Hall (Dutch: Stadhuis van Den Haag) is the city hall of The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: Mauritshuis, the Royal Dutch Shell wing

facts.text: John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, purchased the land in 1631 while governing Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1631, John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, a cousin of Stadtholder Frederick Henry, bought a plot bordering the Binnenhof and the adjacent Hofvijver pond in The Hague, at that time the political centre of the Dutch Republic. Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1631, John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen, a cousin of Stadtholder Frederick Henry, bought a plot bordering the Binnenhof and the adjacent Hofvijver pond in The Hague, at that time the political centre of the Dutch Republic. Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.

facts.text: Architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post designed this strictly symmetrical two-storey structure.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.

facts.text: During Nazi occupation, people hid in the attic and basement despite the building housing enemy offices.
facts.sourceQuote: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands from 1940 to 1945, the Mauritshuis, despite being a prominent landmark and even occupied by the Nazis, was somehow able to serve as a hideout for people in the area who were evading Nazi slave labour, with people hiding in the building's attic and basement despite being close to Nazi offices in the building.

features.name: 'Bevrijdingsmonument Irene'

facts.text: Bronze birds in flight soar upward on a low platform that also holds a flagpole.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is een raamwerk met symbolische vrijheidslievende vogels in brons, in een vlucht omhoog, op een laag platform waarop ook een vlaggenmast staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is a framework with symbolic freedom-loving birds in bronze, in flight upwards, on a low platform on which there is also a flagpole.

facts.text: A messenger hoisted and lowered the flag daily while the monument stood near the old town hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Op de rand van het platform staat de tekst: ”Gedenk de offers die ’t herwinnen van vrijheids vreugden vroeg - bedenk welk daaglijks offer het doen groeien van vrijheid steeds weerom U vraagt.” Toen het monument bij het oude stadhuis (1953-1996) aan de Burgemeester Patijnlaan stond, werd iedere dag de vlag door een bode gehesen en neergehaald.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the edge of the platform is the text: "Remember the sacrifices that asked for the return of the joys of freedom - remember what daily sacrifice it asks again and again to grow freedom." When the monument stood near the old town hall (1953-1996) on Burgemeester Patijnlaan, the flag was hoisted and lowered every day by a messenger.

facts.text: The municipality completely washed the structure in 2007 to protect it from salty sea wind and graffiti.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 heeft de gemeente Den Haag het monument geheel in de was gezet. Dit is ter bescherming tegen de zoute zeewind, en tegen graffiti.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, the municipality of The Hague completely washed the monument. This is for protection against the salty sea wind, and against graffiti.

features.opening: Het Irenemonument is het bevrijdingsmonument van Den Haag.

features.name: Oude Kerk

facts.text: A Reformed preacher replaced the Roman Catholic priest in Scheveningen during 1578.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1578 verdween de roomse geestelijke uit Scheveningen en werd hij vervangen door een reformatorische predikant.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1578, the Roman Catholic priest disappeared from Scheveningen and was replaced by a Reformed preacher.

facts.text: The organ was temporarily ready on September 14, 1845 after several expansions.
facts.sourceQuote: Steevens een eenklaviers orgel met aangehangen pedaal en na diverse uitbreidingen was het orgel op 14 september 1845 voorlopig klaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Steevens a single-key organ with attached pedal and after several expansions, the organ was temporarily ready on September 14, 1845.

facts.text: Flentrop carried out restorations in 1973 and replaced part of the pedal work in 2006.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1973 heeft Flentrop nog restauraties uitgevoerd en in 2006 werd een deel van het pedaalwerk vervangen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1973, Flentrop carried out restorations and in 2006, part of the pedal work was replaced.

features.opening: De Oude Kerk staat in de Keizerstraat, ooit een van de drukste winkelstraten van Scheveningen, in de Nederlandse gemeente Den Haag.

features.name: Johan de Witt

facts.text: Johan de Witt and his brother Cornelis were murdered on August 20, 1672.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 20 augustus 1672 werden De Witt en zijn broer Cornelis vermoord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On August 20, 1672, De Witt and his brother Cornelis were murdered.

facts.text: De Witt's hand gesture is interpreted as pointing to his murder site or taking an oath.
facts.sourceQuote: Er wordt wel aangenomen dat De Witt met zijn rechterhand naar de plaats wijst waar hij werd vermoord. Mogelijk doelde de beeldhouwer echter op de gebeurtenissen rond de vrede van Breda in 1667, de pose van de hand met gestrekte wijs- en middelvinger lijkt te verwijzen naar een eedaflegging.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is assumed that De Witt points with his right hand to the place where he was murdered. However, the sculptor may have been referring to the events surrounding the peace of Breda in 1667, the pose of the hand with extended index and middle finger seems to refer to an oath-taking.

facts.text: William Temple described him as a complete Hollander.
facts.sourceQuote: Op elke zijde is een bronzen plaquette met opschrift geplaatst: De voorkant: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 RAADPENSIONARIS VAN HOLLAND EN WEST-FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Linkerkant (De tekst verwijst naar een brief van Johan de Witt, die hij in 1665 schreef na zijn bezoek met de vloot dat jaar aan het Noorse Bergen.): ICK HEBBE GEDUYRENDE DE STORM NAER MYN CRANCK VERMOGEN ALLMEDE HELPEN UYTKYCKEN EN SELFFS IN T ALLERHARTSTE VAN T WEDER BOVEN GESTAEN Achterkant: LEIDER EN DIENAAR VAN DE REPUBLIEK, VORMER HARER MACHTIGSTE VLOTEN, VERDEDIGER DER VRIJE ZEE, VERZORGER VAN S LANDS GELDEN, WISKUNDIGE Rechterkant: HIJ WAS EEN VOLMAAKT HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On each side is a bronze plaque with inscription: Front: JOHAN DE WITT 1625-1672 COUNCIL PENSIONARY OF THE LOW COUNTRY AND WEST FRIESLAND 1653-1672 Left side (The text refers to a letter from Johan de Witt, which he wrote in 1665 after his visit with the fleet that year to the Norwegian Bergen.): I HAVE ENDURED THE STORM TO THE FULLEST EXTENT OF MY CRANKING ABILITY TO HELP YOU ESCAPE AND TO SURVIVE THE STORM IN THE HEART OF THE STORM BACKside: LEADER AND SERVANT OF THE REPUBLIC, FORMER OF HER MOST POWERFUL FLOTTS, DEFENDER OF THE FREE SEAS, PROVIDER OF THE COUNTRY'S MONEY, SKILLED Legal Counsel: HE WAS A COMPLETE HOLLANDER(WILLIAM TEMPLE)

features.opening: Het standbeeld van Johan de Witt is een 20e-eeuws gedenkteken op de Plaats in Den Haag, ter nagedachtenis aan raadpensionaris Johan de Witt.

features.name: Aartsengel Michael

facts.text: The shield bears the phrase WHO IS LIKE GOD, the literal meaning of Aartsengel Michael.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het schild staat: WIE IS ALS GOD Op het rechthoekige voetstuk staat: UIT DANKBAARHEID AAN DEN AARTSENGEL MICHAËL VOOR ZIJN BESCHERMING TIJDENS DEN WERELDOORLOG 10 MEI 1940 .
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the shield it says: WHO IS LIKE GOD On the rectangular base it says: IN GRATITUDE TO THE ARCHANGEL MICHAEL FOR HIS PROTECTION DURING THE WORLD WAR 10 MAY 1940.

facts.text: Herman van Remmen created this stone monument which was unveiled in 1947.
facts.sourceQuote: Het beeld werd gemaakt door Herman van Remmen en in 1947 onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The image was created by Herman van Remmen and unveiled in 1947.

facts.text: When the hospital relocated in 1979, the monument moved with it to a new garden bed.
facts.sourceQuote: Toen het ziekenhuis in 1979 naar de huidige locatie verhuisde, ook aan het Westeinde, werd dit monument meeverhuisd. Het staat nu in een plantsoentje bij de parkeerplaats die zich voor het ziekenhuis bevindt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: When the hospital moved to its current location in 1979, also on the Westeinde, this monument was also moved. It is now in a garden bed near the parking lot in front of the hospital.
