features.name: De Mesdag Collectie

facts.text: Hendrik Willem Mesdag and Sina Van Houten built the structure next to their home in 1887.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1887, Hendrik Willem Mesdag and Sina Van Houten finished construction on a building next to their house to serve as a museum for their art collection.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1887, Hendrik Willem Mesdag and Sina Van Houten finished construction on a building next to their house to serve as a museum for their art collection.

facts.text: Management of De Mesdag Collectie transferred to the Van Gogh Museum in 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1990, the museum came under the management of the Van Gogh Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1990, the museum came under the management of the Van Gogh Museum.

facts.text: Parts of the private collection were sold after Henrik Mesdag died in 1915.
facts.sourceQuote: After Henrik Mesdag's death in 1915, parts of his private collection were sold.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After Henrik Mesdag's death in 1915, parts of his private collection were sold.

facts.text: On May 14, 2011, the venue reopened after renovation and changed its name from Museum Mesdag to De Mesdag Collectie.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was closed for renovation for roughtly two years until Spring 2011. On 14 May 2011 it was re-opened and renamed from "Museum Mesdag" to "The Mesdag Collection".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was closed for renovation for roughtly two years until Spring 2011. On 14 May 2011 it was re-opened and renamed from "Museum Mesdag" to "The Mesdag Collection".

facts.text: A significant portion of the collection features Japanese art and pottery displayed within a typical 19th-century setting.
facts.sourceQuote: There is also a large collection of Japanese art and Japanese craftwork (pottery) on show. This all is shown in a typical 19th-century setting.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is also a large collection of Japanese art and Japanese craftwork (pottery) on show. This all is shown in a typical 19th-century setting.

facts.text: Visitors can view works by French Barbizon School artists like Jean-Baptiste Camille Corot alongside Dutch Hague School painters.
facts.sourceQuote: It features work of the painters of the Hague School like Willem Roelofs and Anton Mauve and work of the French Barbizon School (Jean-Baptiste Camille Corot, Théodore Rousseau, Jean-François Millet, Charles-François Daubigny and Eugène Delacroix and paintings of Lawrence Alma-Tadema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It features work of the painters of the Hague School like Willem Roelofs and Anton Mauve and work of the French Barbizon School (Jean-Baptiste Camille Corot, Théodore Rousseau, Jean-François Millet, Charles-François Daubigny and Eugène Delacroix and paintings of Lawrence Alma-Tadema.

features.opening: The Mesdag Collection is an art museum in The Hague, Netherlands.

features.name: Indië-monument

facts.text: The monument was unveiled on September 18, 2002 by mayor Wim Deetman.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument werd op initiatief van de Vereniging Oud Militaire Indiëgangers (VOMI) opgericht en op 18 september 2002 onthuld door burgemeester Wim Deetman.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was established at the initiative of the Association of Old Military Indochinese Veterans (VOMI) and was unveiled on September 18, 2002 by mayor Wim Deetman.

facts.text: Highlighted gold letters on the wall spell out a question about why soldiers were placed in foreign lands.
facts.sourceQuote: Enkele letters zijn goudkleurig uitgelicht. Deze letters vormen de volgende door dichter Jan Eijkelboom uit Dordrecht geschreven tekst: OP WELKE GROND WERDEN ZE GELEGD IN VREEMDE AARDE Eijkelboom is zelf ook Indië-veteraan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some letters are highlighted in gold. These letters form the following text written by poet Jan Eijkelboom from Dordrecht: ON WHAT BASIS WERE THEY PLACED IN FOREIGN LAND Eijkelboom is also a Indië veteran himself.

facts.text: The poet who wrote the inscription text was also an Indië veteran himself.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze letters vormen de volgende door dichter Jan Eijkelboom uit Dordrecht geschreven tekst: OP WELKE GROND WERDEN ZE GELEGD IN VREEMDE AARDE Eijkelboom is zelf ook Indië-veteraan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These letters form the following text written by poet Jan Eijkelboom from Dordrecht: ON WHAT BASIS WERE THEY PLACED IN FOREIGN LAND Eijkelboom is also a Indië veteran himself.

features.name: 'Centraal Monument voor Gevallen PTT'ers'

facts.text: Crown lanterns were reinstalled on both sides of the inner courtyard to restore the square's original allure.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen aan beide zijden van het plein (binnenplantsoen) weer kroontjeslantaarns, zodat het monumentale plein in allure weer aansluit bij de Vijverberg, Voorhout en Willemspark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Crown lanterns have been installed again on both sides of the square (inner courtyard), so that the monumental square once again connects in allure with the Vijverberg, Voorhout and Willemspark.

facts.text: More than thirty trees and new hedges along a shell path were planted within the square during renovation.
facts.sourceQuote: Daarbinnen zijn ruim dertig bomen geplaatst en langs het schelpenpad zijn nieuwe perken aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Within it, more than thirty trees have been planted and new hedges have been laid along the shell path.

facts.text: Hedgebeeches line the outer edge specifically to divert the eye away from parked cars.
facts.sourceQuote: Langs de buitenrand zijn haagbeuken geplant die de geparkeerde auto's aan het oog onttrekken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Hedgebeeches are planted along the outer edge to divert the eye from the parked cars.

features.opening: Nassauplein is een lang rechthoekig plein in de Archipelbuurt in Den Haag met maar 43 huisnummers.

features.name: Duinzichtkerk

facts.text: A heavy storm once made the large clock hands swing noticeably back and forth.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens zware storm zwiepen de wijzers van de grote klok op de toren opvallend heen en weer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During a heavy storm, the hands of the large clock on the tower swung noticeably back and forth.

facts.text: Renowned architect Willem Verschoor created the design for the building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het ontwerp kwam van de bekende architect Willem Verschoor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The design was by the well-known architect Willem Verschoor.

facts.text: The cornerstone was laid on October 13 before services started that same year.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen werd gelegd op 13 oktober en reeds op 1 maart 1935 werd de eerste dienst gehouden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone was laid on October 13 and the first service was held as early as March 1, 1935.

features.opening: De Duinzichtkerk is een kerkgebouw aan de Van Hogenhoucklaan in Den Haag.

features.name: Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk

facts.text: Catholics regained access to their own church only in 1785, nearly two centuries later.
facts.sourceQuote: Een behoorlijk deel van de Loosduinse bevolking bleef Katholiek. Maar het duurde tot 1785 voordat ze weer de beschikking kregen over hun eigen kerkje.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A considerable part of the Loosduinen population remained Catholic. But it took until 1785 before they again had access to their own church.

facts.text: The organ likely moved from the old church located opposite the current building.
facts.sourceQuote: Dit oude kerkje lag tegenover de huidige OLV-Hemelvaartkerk. Aangenomen wordt dat het orgel uit de oude kerk geplaatst is in de nieuwe kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This old church was located opposite the current OLV-Hemelvaartkerk. It is assumed that the organ was placed from the old church in the new church.

features.opening: De Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk is een rooms-katholieke kerk in Loosduinen in de Nederlandse stad Den Haag.

features.name: Yi Jun Peace Museum

facts.text: Yi Jun died in a room at Hotel De Jong after protesting his delegation's rejection from the conference.
facts.sourceQuote: Yi protested against the decision. A few days later, he was found dead in his room at the Hotel De Jong on Wagenstraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Yi protested against the decision. A few days later, he was found dead in his room at the Hotel De Jong on Wagenstraat.

facts.text: Despite failing to attend, the mission gained worldwide attention through press coverage of their protest.
facts.sourceQuote: However, the three Koreans succeeded in receiving worldwide attention due to a press conference and coverage in an independent newspaper which reported on the Peace Conference.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the three Koreans succeeded in receiving worldwide attention due to a press conference and coverage in an independent newspaper which reported on the Peace Conference.

facts.text: Yi Jun died at the former hotel De Jong, which now houses the museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The former hotel De Jong, where Yi died, is now the Yi Jun Peace Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former hotel De Jong, where Yi died, is now the Yi Jun Peace Museum.

facts.text: North Korea has issued postage stamps honoring Yi Jun on several occasions.
facts.sourceQuote: On several occasions postage stamps have been issued by North Korea honoring Yi Jun.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On several occasions postage stamps have been issued by North Korea honoring Yi Jun.

facts.text: Although buried locally for years, Yi Jun's remains were exhumed and transferred to South Korea in 1963.
facts.sourceQuote: His remains were exhumed on September 26, 1963 and transferred to South Korea and there reburied.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: His remains were exhumed on September 26, 1963 and transferred to South Korea and there reburied.

features.name: Koninklijke Schouwburg

facts.text: The venue reopened on September 18, 1999, with a premiere of Oude Mensen.
facts.sourceQuote: On 18 September 1999 the Koninklijke Schouwburg was reopened by the alderman Louise Engering, followed by the premiere of "Oude Mensen" by the Nationale Toneel (directed by Ger Thijs).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On 18 September 1999 the Koninklijke Schouwburg was reopened by the alderman Louise Engering, followed by the premiere of "Oude Mensen" by the Nationale Toneel (directed by Ger Thijs).

facts.text: Koninklijke Schouwburg translates literally to Royal Theater or Royal Playhouse.
facts.sourceQuote: The Koninklijke Schouwburg (literally translated: Royal Theater or Royal Playhouse) is a theater in the city center of The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Koninklijke Schouwburg (literally translated: Royal Theater or Royal Playhouse) is a theater in the city center of The Hague.

facts.text: Although built in 1766, the venue has functioned as a theater since 1804.
facts.sourceQuote: The theater was built in 1766 and has been in use as theater since 1804.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater was built in 1766 and has been in use as theater since 1804.

facts.text: The main room seats 680 people across the floor and three balconies.
facts.sourceQuote: The main room of the Schouwburg is relatively small for current standards, and can seat 680 people in total with the main room and three balconies.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main room of the Schouwburg is relatively small for current standards, and can seat 680 people in total with the main room and three balconies.

facts.text: A functional antique revolving stage from 1929 remains on site but is no longer used.
facts.sourceQuote: The stage has a 1929 antique revolving stage that is still functional but no longer in use.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The stage has a 1929 antique revolving stage that is still functional but no longer in use.

features.opening: The Koninklijke Schouwburg (literally translated: Royal Theater or Royal Playhouse) is a theater in the city center of The Hague.

features.name: Juliana van Stolberg

facts.text: The first stone was laid on April 30, 1927, by Dirk Jan de Geer.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen voor het monument werd gelegd op de achttiende verjaardag van prinses Juliana, op 30 april 1927, door Dirk Jan de Geer, voorzitter van de ministerraad.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone for the monument was laid on the eighteenth birthday of Princess Juliana, on April 30, 1927, by Dirk Jan de Geer, chairman of the Council of Ministers.

facts.text: Queen Wilhelmina and Queen Mother Emma attended the 1930 unveiling ceremony.
facts.sourceQuote: Drie jaar later, op 23 april 1930, werd het monument onthuld door de prinses ter gelegenheid van haar 18e verjaardag, in aanwezigheid van koningin Wilhelmina en koningin-moeder Emma.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three years later, on April 23, 1930, the monument was unveiled by the princess on the occasion of her 18th birthday, in the presence of Queen Wilhelmina and Queen Mother Emma.

facts.text: The monument survived the March 1945 bombing of Bezuidenhout with only slight damage.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens het bombardement op het Bezuidenhout op 3 maart 1945 blijft het monument overeind staan te midden van de ruïnes van de omgeving. Het wordt slechts licht beschadigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the bombing of Bezuidenhout on March 3, 1945, the monument remains standing in the middle of the ruins of the surrounding area. It is only slightly damaged.

facts.text: In November 1954, the statue was rolled to its current spot overlooking Juliana van Stolberglaan.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de wederopbouw van het Bezuidenhout wordt het monument in november 1954 verrold van het Louise de Colignyplein naar de huidige locatie op de Koningin Marialaan, uitkijkend over de Juliana van Stolberglaan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the reconstruction of Bezuidenhout, the monument was rolled from Louise de Colignyplein to its current location on Koningin Marialaan in November 1954, overlooking the Juliana of Stolberglaan.

features.opening: Juliana van Stolberg en haar vijf zoons is een monument in de Zuid-Hollandse stad Den Haag.

features.name: Kerk van de H.H. Jacobus en Augustinus

facts.text: The municipal government permitted its construction in 1720 only if it remained invisible from the street.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1720 gaf het stadsbestuur toestemming een katholieke kerk te bouwen mits die niet vanaf de straat te zien zou zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1720, the municipal government gave permission to build a Catholic church provided that it would not be visible from the street.

facts.text: In 1991, this site was listed among top real estate properties for protection under exceptional circumstances.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk maakte in 1991 onderdeel uit van de Lijst 'Top 100' onroerende objecten van het toenmalige ministerie van WVC in verband met aanvullende beschermende maatregelen bij buitengewone omstandigheden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1991, the church was part of the List 'Top 100' of real estate properties of the then Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and Infrastructure in connection with additional protective measures in exceptional circumstances.

facts.text: The ceiling features twelve apostles surrounding a central depiction of Christ's ascension.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het plafond staan de twaalf apostelen afgebeeld. In het midden is een voorstelling van de hemelvaart van Christus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The twelve apostles are depicted on the ceiling. In the center is a depiction of the ascension of Christ.

facts.text: Jean Baptist Xavery crafted the pulpit in 1729, adding its crown shortly thereafter.
facts.sourceQuote: De kansel werd gemaakt door Jean Baptist Xavery en is uit 1729, de bekroning is enkele jaren later gemaakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The pulpit was made by Jean Baptist Xavery and dates from 1729, the crown was made a few years later.

facts.text: Rudolph Garrels built the organ in 1726, which is now designated as a national monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het orgel is in 1726 gemaakt door Rudolph Garrels en is nu een rijksmonument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The organ was made in 1726 by Rudolph Garrels and is now a national monument.
