features.name: Grondwetbank

facts.text: The Grondwetbank stretches 45 meters long and is carved from smooth marble.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument heeft de vorm van een 45 meter lange zitbank van glad marmer waarop de tekst is aangebracht van artikel 1 van de Nederlandse Grondwet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument is in the shape of a 45-meter-long bench of smooth marble on which the text of article 1 of the Dutch Constitution is inscribed.

facts.text: The Hague municipality gifted this marble bench to the government in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: De gemeente Den Haag heeft het monument in 1992 cadeau gedaan aan de regering.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The municipality of The Hague gave the monument as a gift to the government in 1992.

features.opening: De grondwetbank is een monument voor de Nederlandse Grondwet gelegen aan de Hofplaats te Den Haag.

features.name: Ver Huellbank

facts.text: Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell served on The Hague's municipal council from 1861 to 1881.
facts.sourceQuote: Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell, lid van de adellijke familie Ver Huell, was van 1861 tot 1881 gemeenteraadslid in Den Haag en daarnaast lid van de Provinciale Staten van Zuid-Holland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell, a member of the noble Ver Huell family, was a member of the municipal council in The Hague from 1861 to 1881 and also a member of the Provincial States of South Holland.

facts.text: Critics noted the marble benches were too cold to rely upon for sitting.
facts.sourceQuote: De Tijd sloot zich bij deze kritiek aan en vond bovendien: "Het woord "bank" geeft toch het begrip, dat men er op kan uitrusten, en dit nu is, wegens de koude van het marmer, totaal onmogelijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Times joined this criticism and also found: "The word "bank" does give the idea that one can rely on it, and this is now, because of the coldness of the marble, totally impossible.

facts.text: Contemporary reviews complained that aloe plants disturbed the bench's lining system.
facts.sourceQuote: De reacties op het monument waren niet onverdeeld positief, de Spectator vond dat de vazen en de daarin geplante aloë "het lijnen-systeem der bank" bedierven en het monumentale karakter in hoge mate benadeelden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The reactions to the monument were not unanimously positive, the Spectator found that the vases and the aloe planted in them "disturbed the lining system of the bench" and greatly impaired the monumental character.

facts.text: The semi-circular seat is crafted from Italian blanclair marble.
facts.sourceQuote: De halfronde bank werd uitgevoerd in Italiaans marmer, zogenaamde "blanclair".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The semi-circular sofa was made of Italian marble, so-called "blanclair".

facts.text: Sculptor Eugène Lacomblé likely designed this neo-imperial monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument in neo-empirestijl werd waarschijnlijk ontworpen door beeldhouwer Eugène Lacomblé en werd gemaakt door de firma Laurent Phillips uit Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument in neo-imperial style was probably designed by sculptor Eugène Lacomblé and was made by the company Laurent Phillips from The Hague.

features.opening: De Ver Huellbank is een gedenkbank die in 1881 werd opgericht in Den Haag ter nagedachtenis aan jhr.

features.name: The Hague University of Applied Sciences

facts.text: The university merged with Technische Hogeschool Rijswijk in 2003.
facts.sourceQuote: In the years that followed, the university continued to expand, merging with the Technische Hogeschool Rijswijk in 2003 and opening a new building at the campus of Delft University of Technology.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the years that followed, the university continued to expand, merging with the Technische Hogeschool Rijswijk in 2003 and opening a new building at the campus of Delft University of Technology.

facts.text: Professionals with years of experience can study part-time or via dual programmes at the bachelor level.
facts.sourceQuote: Professionals with several years of work experience can follow a part-time or dual programme at bachelor level.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Professionals with several years of work experience can follow a part-time or dual programme at bachelor level.

facts.text: The institution offers extensive master's degrees and postgraduate education through The Hague Graduate School.
facts.sourceQuote: The university also offers an extensive range of master's degree programmes and further postgraduate education through The Hague Graduate School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university also offers an extensive range of master's degree programmes and further postgraduate education through The Hague Graduate School.

features.opening: The Hague University of Applied Sciences (abbreviated as: THUAS; Dutch: De Haagse Hogeschool) is a university of applied sciences with its campuses located in…

features.name: Mauritspoort

facts.text: The name Mauritspoort derives from the adjacent Mauritshuis palace.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Mauritspoort is afkomstig van het naastgelegen Mauritshuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Mauritspoort comes from the adjacent Mauritshuis.

facts.text: In 1860, the canal running beneath the gate's bridge was filled in.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1860 is de hofgracht onder de brug gedempt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1860, the canal under the bridge was filled in.

facts.text: Pulley holes used to operate the original drawbridge remain visible on the exterior wall.
facts.sourceQuote: De poort is gebouwd in 1634 samen met de nabijgelegen Binnenpoort en had destijds een ophaalbrug over een binnengracht. De katrolgaten zijn nog zichtbaar aan de buitenzijde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The gate was built in 1634 together with the nearby Binnenpoort and had a drawbridge over an inner moat at the time. The pulley holes are still visible on the outside.

features.opening: De Mauritspoort of Grenadierspoort is de oostelijke toegangspoort tot het Binnenhof in Den Haag.

features.name: Geünieerde Loge van Theosofen

facts.text: Robert Crosbie left Point Loma in 1904 after feeling original teachings were eclipsed by sensational programs.
facts.sourceQuote: However, by 1904, he felt the original teachings of Theosophy were almost completely eclipsed by Katherine Tingley's sensational programs. Convinced that further effort was futile, he quietly left Point Loma and moved to Los Angeles.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, by 1904, he felt the original teachings of Theosophy were almost completely eclipsed by Katherine Tingley's sensational programs. Convinced that further effort was futile, he quietly left Point Loma and moved to Los Angeles.

facts.text: By February 1909, Robert Crosbie had gathered seven individuals to form a study group restoring original Theosophy.
facts.sourceQuote: By February 1909, he had gathered around him seven individuals as part of a study group, four of whom were new to Theosophy. This nucleus, under Robert Crosbie's guidance, set to the task of restoring Theosophy along the original lines of its founders without organizational distractions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By February 1909, he had gathered around him seven individuals as part of a study group, four of whom were new to Theosophy. This nucleus, under Robert Crosbie's guidance, set to the task of restoring Theosophy along the original lines of its founders without organizational distractions.

facts.text: The Geünieerde Loge van Theosofen traces its roots to a 1909 founding in Los Angeles by Robert Crosbie.
facts.sourceQuote: The first parent lodge of the ULT was started in Los Angeles by Robert Crosbie and seven other associates through the adoption of its Declaration on February 18, 1909.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first parent lodge of the ULT was started in Los Angeles by Robert Crosbie and seven other associates through the adoption of its Declaration on February 18, 1909.

features.opening: The United Lodge of Theosophists or ULT is an informal and wholly voluntary association of students of Theosophy.

features.name: Mijlpalen van het Wateringse Veld

facts.text: Two rectangular natural stone blocks served as the bases for two of the mile markers.
facts.sourceQuote: De rechthoekige blokken bleken de sokkels te zijn geweest waarop twee van de mijlpalen ooit stonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rectangular blocks turned out to have been the bases on which two of the mile markers once stood.

facts.text: Four replicas now stand at the intersection where the original poles were excavated.
facts.sourceQuote: De palen werden uitgegraven en staan tentoongesteld in het Museon in Den Haag, bij het kruispunt Oosteinde-Laan van Wateringse Veld zijn vier replica's van de palen geplaatst met daarbij een informatiebord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The poles were excavated and are on display in the Museum in The Hague, at the intersection of Oosteinde-Laan van Wateringse Veld four replicas of the poles have been placed with an information board.

facts.text: Mijlpalen van het Wateringse Veld were placed along this route during the second and third centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: De mijlpalen zijn in de tweede en derde eeuw langs een belangrijke weg geplaatst, die vermoedelijk langs het Kanaal van Corbulo van Naaldwijk, via Rijswijk naar de stad Forum Hadriani liep en van hieruit verder in noordelijke richting tot aan de Limes, de noordelijke grens van het Romeinse Rijk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The milestones were placed in the second and third centuries along an important road, which presumably ran along the Canal of Corbulo of Naaldwijk, via Rijswijk to the city of Forum Hadriani and from here further in a northerly direction to the Limes, the northern border of the Roman Empire.

facts.text: New Roman milestones were often set directly beside older ones rather than replacing them.
facts.sourceQuote: De oudere palen werden niet vervangen, er werd gewoon een nieuwe naast geplaatst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The older poles were not replaced, a new one was simply placed next to them.

features.opening: De Mijlpalen van het Wateringse Veld zijn vier mijlpalen uit de Romeinse tijd, die zijn gevonden bij opgravingen in de wijk Wateringse Veld in Den Haag.

features.name: Peace Palace Library

facts.text: Carnegie insisted the building include a legal library alongside the court.
facts.section: History and relationship with the Carnegie Foundation
facts.sourceQuote: The palace was built to accommodate the Permanent Court of Arbitration, but Carnegie insisted that room be made available also for a legal library.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was built to accommodate the Permanent Court of Arbitration, but Carnegie insisted that room be made available also for a legal library.

facts.text: The collection specializes in international law to support the Permanent Court of Justice.
facts.sourceQuote: The Peace Palace Library is a collection of studies and references specializing in international law. It is located in The Hague, Netherlands, and was established to support the Permanent Court of Justice.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Peace Palace Library is a collection of studies and references specializing in international law. It is located in The Hague, Netherlands, and was established to support the Permanent Court of Justice.

features.opening: The Peace Palace Library is a collection of studies and references specializing in international law.

features.name: Lourdeskapel

facts.text: The name Lourdeskapel honors the French town where Mary appeared to Bernadette Soubirous in 1858.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kapelgedeelte achter het altaar herbergt een getrouwe kopie op een schaal van 1:13 van de grot bij Lourdes in Zuid-Frankrijk waar Maria, de moeder van Jezus, in 1858 aan Bernadette Soubirous zou zijn verschenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel section behind the altar houses a faithful copy at a scale of 1:13 of the grotto in Lourdes, southern France, where Mary, the mother of Jesus, is said to have appeared to Bernadette Soubirous in 1858.

facts.text: A faithful 1:13 scale copy of the original grotto stands behind the altar inside this chapel.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kapelgedeelte achter het altaar herbergt een getrouwe kopie op een schaal van 1:13 van de grot bij Lourdes in Zuid-Frankrijk waar Maria, de moeder van Jezus, in 1858 aan Bernadette Soubirous zou zijn verschenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel section behind the altar houses a faithful copy at a scale of 1:13 of the grotto in Lourdes, southern France, where Mary, the mother of Jesus, is said to have appeared to Bernadette Soubirous in 1858.

facts.text: Artist Leo Stracké designed the cave containing the statue of Mary within the structure.
facts.sourceQuote: De grot met het Mariabeeld zijn ontworpen door kunstenaar Leo Stracké (1851-1923).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cave with the Mary statue was designed by artist Leo Stracké (1851-1923).

facts.text: While the complex dates to the 1920s, its church tower was not finished until 1965.
facts.sourceQuote: Het complex met kerk en omringende woonhuizen dateert verder uit de jaren twintig van de twintigste eeuw, terwijl de toren van de kerk pas in 1965 gereed kwam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The complex with the church and surrounding residential houses dates back to the 1920s, while the church tower was only completed in 1965.

features.opening: De Lourdeskapel te Scheveningen is onderdeel van het in het register van rijksmonumenten opgenomen stedenbouwkundig complex dat wel 'het kerkdorp' wordt…

features.name: Willibrorduskapel

facts.text: The chapel was constructed in 1928 for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is een gemeentelijk monument en werd in 1928 gebouwd in de stijl van de Delftse School, naar ontwerp van de Haagse architect Jos Duynstee, voor de Zusters van Liefde uit Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is a municipal monument and was built in 1928 in the style of the Delft School, designed by the Hague architect Jos Duynstee, for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.

facts.text: Architect Jos Duynstee designed the structure in the distinctive Delft School style.
facts.sourceQuote: De kapel is een gemeentelijk monument en werd in 1928 gebouwd in de stijl van de Delftse School, naar ontwerp van de Haagse architect Jos Duynstee, voor de Zusters van Liefde uit Tilburg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The chapel is a municipal monument and was built in 1928 in the style of the Delft School, designed by the Hague architect Jos Duynstee, for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg.

facts.text: A wooden gable with a finial crowns the chapel's saddle roof.
facts.sourceQuote: Het zadeldak wordt bekroond door een houten dakruiter met spits.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The saddle roof is crowned by a wooden gable with finial.

facts.text: Three ground-floor windows are framed by distinctive sandstone corner blocks.
facts.sourceQuote: Bovenin bevindt zich een roosvenster, daaronder een in natuursteen gehouwen beeld van de heilige Willibrordus, en op de begane grond drie vensters met zandstenen hoekblokken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the top is a rose window, below it a stone-carved image of the saint Willibrordus, and on the ground floor three windows with sandstone corner blocks.

facts.text: The chapel's pointed brick facade shares architectural similarities with Alexander Kropholler.
facts.sourceQuote: De bakstenen puntgevel van de kapel vertoont verwantschap met de architectuur van Alexander Kropholler.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The brick pointed facade of the chapel shows similarities with the architecture of Alexander Kropholler.

features.opening: De Willibrorduskapel is een katholieke kapel in Den Haag, gelegen op de eerste verdieping van het Willibrordushuis aan de Oude Molstraat 35.

features.name: H. Teresia van Avila

facts.text: Dutch Sunday masses stopped, yet Polish Eucharistic celebrations continue there.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk wordt vanwege het gestaag afnemende kerkbezoek niet meer zondags gebruikt voor eucharistievieringen in het Nederlands. Wel vinden er op zondag Poolse eucharistievieringen plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the steadily declining church attendance, the church is no longer used on Sundays for Eucharistic celebrations in Dutch. However, Polish Eucharistic celebrations take place on Sunday.

facts.text: The chapel reopened in 1816 after being closed for religious services since Spain sold the residence in 1811.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1811 verkocht Spanje de residentie en de kapel waarna deze voor erediensten werd gesloten. Op aandingen van gelovigen heropende de kapel in 1816.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1811, Spain sold the residence and chapel, after which it was closed for religious services. At the urging of believers, the chapel reopened in 1816.

facts.text: Jesuit priests served the Spanish chapel even after all Jesuits were forced to leave the Netherlands in 1708.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook na 1708, toen alle Jezuïeten Nederland moesten verlaten, werd de Spaanse kapel door een Jezuïet bediend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Even after 1708, when all Jesuits had to leave the Netherlands, the Spanish chapel was served by a Jesuit.

facts.text: Friars replaced the Jesuits as priests in the chapel after Charles III of Spain abolished the order in 1766.
facts.sourceQuote: Nadat Karel III van Spanje in 1766 de orde van de jezuïeten afschafte in Spanje, namen in de Spaanse kapel priesters van de minderbroeders hun plaats in.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After Charles III of Spain abolished the order of the Jesuits in Spain in 1766, priests of the friars took their place in the Spanish chapel.

features.opening: De Teresia van Avilakerk, ook Kerk van de Heilige Teresia van Avila genoemd, is een rooms-katholieke kerk uit 1841 die zich bevindt in het voormalige…

features.name: Omniversum

facts.text: Visitors found the jeep tour simulation in Wild Safari so unpleasant it was immediately replaced by Africa: The Serengeti.
facts.sourceQuote: In februari 2007 werd de film Wild Safari per direct vervangen door de film Africa: The Serengeti. De film Wild Safari moest plaatsmaken omdat de film als "onprettig werd ervaren", aldus de bezoekers. De combinatie van het grote scherm en de jeeptochten zorgden ervoor dat deze film een erg onaangenaam gevoel bij mensen opwekte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In February 2007, the film Wild Safari was immediately replaced by the film Africa: The Serengeti. The film Wild Safari had to be replaced because the film was "experienced as unpleasant", according to the visitors. The combination of the large screen and the jeep tours made this film create a very unpleasant feeling in people.

facts.text: In January 2022, Omniversum merged with Museon to operate together under the new name Museon-Omniversum.
facts.sourceQuote: In januari 2022 is Omiversum gefuseerd met het Museon en zijn zij samen verdergegaan onder de nieuwe naam Museon-Omniversum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In January 2022, Omiversum was merged with the Museon and they continued together under the new name Museon-Omniversum.

facts.text: The name Omniversum blends 'Omnimax' and 'Universum' to reflect its dome projection system and astronomical themes.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam Omniversum is samengesteld uit 'Omnimax' en 'Universum'. Omnimax is de oorspronkelijke naam van het gebruikte filmprojectiesysteem, dat later is omgedoopt naar IMAX Dome. Universum herinnert aan de sterrenkundige kant van de programma's die vroeger vertoond werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Omniversum is composed of 'Omnimax' and 'Universum'. Omnimax is the original name of the used film projection system, which was later renamed IMAX Dome. Universum reminds us of the astronomical side of the programs that used to be shown.

features.opening: Omniversum is een grootbeeld filmtheater in het westen van de wijk Zorgvliet in Den Haag.

features.name: Haags Historisch Museum

facts.text: The collection first became a museum in 1871 when moved to a house on the Beestenmarkt.
facts.sourceQuote: The collection was transferred to a house on the Beestenmarkt in 1871, where nineteenth-century art was shown; this became the first museum in The Hague.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection was transferred to a house on the Beestenmarkt in 1871, where nineteenth-century art was shown; this became the first museum in The Hague.

facts.text: In 1912, art and history collections split, leaving the guild house with a distinct historical character.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1912, the art and historical collection are split up, leaving a distinctive historical character to the museum in the guild house.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1912, the art and historical collection are split up, leaving a distinctive historical character to the museum in the guild house.

facts.text: Formal managerial control was transferred to the Haags Historisch Museum in 1991.
facts.sourceQuote: It was not until the 1980s that the historical collection returned to its spot in the guild house of Saint Sebastian; in 1991 the Kunstmuseum gave formal managerial control of the collection to the newly created Haags Historische Museum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was not until the 1980s that the historical collection returned to its spot in the guild house of Saint Sebastian; in 1991 the Kunstmuseum gave formal managerial control of the collection to the newly created Haags Historische Museum.

facts.text: Members of the Saint Sebastian militia are depicted in some museum collections.
facts.sourceQuote: In the seventeenth century, this guild house was the home of the civilian militia of Saint Sebastian, whose members are depicted in some of the museum collections.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the seventeenth century, this guild house was the home of the civilian militia of Saint Sebastian, whose members are depicted in some of the museum collections.

features.opening: The Haags Historisch Museum is a museum situated on the Korte Vijverberg in The Hague, Netherlands, dedicated to the history of the city.

features.name: Het Nutshuis

facts.text: Visitors can listen to the Great Church carillon from a spot in the Nut Garden three times weekly at noon.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier is ook een luisterplaats te vinden waar op maandag, woensdag en vrijdag tussen 12:00 uur en 13:00 uur naar het carillon van de Grote Kerk kan worden geluisterd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here you can also find a listening place where on Monday, Wednesday and Friday between 12:00 pm and 1:00 pm you can listen to the carillon of the Great Church.

features.opening: Het Nutshuis is het voormalige hoofdkantoor van de Haagse Nutsspaarbank.

features.name: Long Walk to Freedom

facts.text: Artist Arie Schippers created the bronze statue of Nelson Mandela.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bronzen standbeeld van Nelson Mandela werd gemaakt door kunstenaar Arie Schippers en het staat aan de Johan de Wittlaan in Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bronze statue of Nelson Mandela was made by artist Arie Schippers and stands on Johan de Wittlaan in The Hague.

facts.text: The artist studied at Rotterdam's Academy of Fine Arts and Amsterdam's Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten.
facts.sourceQuote: Schippers studeerde aan de Academie van Beeldende Kunsten (thans Willem de Kooning Academie) in Rotterdam en de Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten in Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Schippers studied at the Academy of Fine Arts (now Willem de Kooning Academy) in Rotterdam and the Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten in Amsterdam.

facts.text: In summer 2012, the Beelden aan Zee museum displayed plaster preliminary studies of this monument.
facts.sourceQuote: In de zomer van 2012 vertoonde het museum Beelden aan Zee enkele gipsen voorstudies van dit monument.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the summer of 2012, the Beelden aan Zee museum exhibited several plaster preliminary studies of this monument.

features.opening: Long Walk to Freedom is een standbeeld in Den Haag.

features.name: Maranathakerk

facts.text: Construction began in 1949 on land cleared by WWII demolition work.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk werd in 1949 gebouwd op een terrein dat braak lag door afbraakwerkzaamheden voor de Atlantikwall, een verdedigingswerk van de Duitsers tegen mogelijke geallieerde aanvallen in de Tweede Wereldoorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1949 on a site that was vacant due to demolition work for the Atlantikwall, a German defensive work against possible Allied attacks during World War II.

facts.text: Emil Staudacher designed the wooden roof structure from Zurich.
facts.sourceQuote: Emil Staudacher uit Zürich ontworpen houten dakconstructie aangeboden, inclusief spanten, ramen en deuren, een overgebleven prototype van een serie noodkerken voor het door oorlogsgeweld geteisterde Duitsland.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Offered is a wooden roof construction designed by Emil Staudacher from Zurich, including beams, windows and doors, a surviving prototype of a series of emergency churches for war-torn Germany.

facts.text: Artist Paul Citroen decorated the interior of the church nave.
facts.sourceQuote: Het schip van de kerk werd gedecoreerd door de kunstenaar Paul Citroen (1896-1983), toen docent aan de Koninklijke Academie van Beeldende Kunsten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The ship of the church was decorated by the artist Paul Citroen (1896-1983), then a teacher at the Royal Academy of Fine Arts.

features.opening: De Maranathakerk is een Nederlandse Hervormde Kerk aan de Tweede Sweelinckstraat in Den Haag.

features.name: Van Karnebeekbron

facts.text: Spring water flows from a lion's head carved into the curved center section.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebogen middendeel is hoger dan de twee zijdelen en heeft in het midden een leeuwenkop waar bronwater uit komt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The curved middle part is higher than the two sides and has a lion's head in the middle where spring water comes out.

facts.text: An inscription on the pool wall commemorates the specific opening event of the Peace Palace rather than a general dedication.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het muurtje van het bassin staat: TER HERINNERING AAN DE OPENING VAN HET VREDESPALEIS.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the wall of the pool it says: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE OPENING OF THE PEACE PALACE.

features.opening: De Van Karnebeekbron is een zandstenen monument dat de Carnegie Stichting en de opening van het Vredespaleis in Den Haag op 28 augustus 1913 herdenkt.

features.name: Literatuurmuseum

facts.text: Poet Ellen Warmond served as the right-hand assistant to founder Gerrit Borgers.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Literatuurmuseum werd in 1954 opgericht als Nederlands Letterkundig Museum, met als eerste hoofdconservator Gerrit Borgers. Zijn rechterhand werd de dichteres Ellen Warmond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Literatuurmuseum was founded in 1954 as the Dutch Literary Museum, with Gerrit Borgers as its first head curator. His right hand became the poet Ellen Warmond.

facts.text: The Pantheon includes medieval poetess Hadewych, predating the usual 1750 literary boundary.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 werd een vaste opstelling van schrijvers gecreëerd, het Pantheon, dat honderd belangrijke auteurs uit de Nederlandstalige literatuur omvat. De begingrens is hier overigens niet het jaar 1750: ook de middeleeuwse dichteres Hadewych komt erin voor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, a permanent assembly of writers was created, the Pantheon, which includes hundreds of important authors from Dutch-language literature. By the way, the boundary of the beginning is not the year 1750 here: the medieval poetess Hadewych also appears in it.

facts.text: Until November 2016, the site operated under the longer name Dutch Literary Museum and Documentation Center.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot 1 november 2016 was de naam Nederlands Letterkundig Museum en Documentatiecentrum.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until November 1, 2016, the name was Dutch Literary Museum and Documentation Center.

features.opening: Het Literatuurmuseum, gevestigd in het Koninklijke Bibliotheek-complex in Den Haag, is gewijd aan auteurs uit het Nederlandstalige gebied vanaf 1750.

features.name: Fotomuseum Den Haag

facts.text: The institution was established in 2002 after its photography collection outgrew the Kunstmuseum Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuote: The museum was founded in 2002. It was a spin-off of the nearby Kunstmuseum Den Haag, when then director Wim van Krimpen decided that the Kunstmuseum's collection of photography had become so rich that it deserved a separate location.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was founded in 2002. It was a spin-off of the nearby Kunstmuseum Den Haag, when then director Wim van Krimpen decided that the Kunstmuseum's collection of photography had become so rich that it deserved a separate location.

facts.text: Visitors enter through a shared space and entrance with the contemporary art museum KM21.
facts.sourceQuote: It shares an entrance and space with the museum of contemporary art KM21.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It shares an entrance and space with the museum of contemporary art KM21.

facts.text: A 2016 expansion increased the gallery space from 400 to 1,000 square meters by taking area from the contemporary art museum.
facts.sourceQuote: The Foto Museum was expanded from 400 to 1,000 square meters in 2016, taking over more space from the then-called GEM for contemporary art museum, also located in the building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Foto Museum was expanded from 400 to 1,000 square meters in 2016, taking over more space from the then-called GEM for contemporary art museum, also located in the building.

features.opening: The Fotomuseum Den Haag (The Hague Museum of Photography) is a photography museum in The Hague.

features.name: Mauritshuis

facts.text: Prince John Maurice of Nassau-Siegen commissioned the structure during his governorship of Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuote: Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1636 and 1641, the Mauritshuis was built on this piece of land during John Maurice's governorship of Dutch Brazil.

facts.text: Architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post designed the strictly symmetrical two-storey building in Dutch Classicist style.
facts.sourceQuote: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in the Dutch Classicist style by the Dutch architects Jacob van Campen and Pieter Post. The two-storey building is strictly symmetrical; originally the interior contained four apartments and a great hall.

facts.text: Count John Maurice of Nassau originally lived in this seventeenth-century residence.
facts.sourceQuote: Originally, the 17th-century building was the residence of Count (later Prince) John Maurice of Nassau.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally, the 17th-century building was the residence of Count (later Prince) John Maurice of Nassau.

features.opening: The Mauritshuis (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmʌurɪtsˌɦœys]; The Hague dialect: [ˈmɑːʁɪtsˌɦœːs]; lit.

facts.text: During WWI, 1500 Belgian soldiers were interned on the estate.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog waren 1500 Belgische militairen geïnterneerd op het landgoed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War I, 1500 Belgian military personnel were interned on the estate.

facts.text: In 1944, a V2 rocket base was established here to fire at London and Antwerp.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944 werd op het landgoed een basis voor V2-raketten ingericht. Deze werden vooral afgeschoten op Londen en Antwerpen, waar ze veel schade veroorzaakten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, a base for V2 rockets was set up on the estate. These were mainly fired at London and Antwerp, where they caused a lot of damage.

facts.text: Jewish children fleeing Germany and Austria found refuge on the estate from 1938.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1938 werden uit Duitsland en Oostenrijk gevluchte Joodse kinderen op het landgoed gehuisvest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1938, Jewish children fleeing from Germany and Austria were housed on the estate.

facts.text: Fierce fighting occurred over the airfield during the German attack in 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Bij de Duitse aanval op Nederland in 1940 is zwaar gevochten om het vliegveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German attack on the Netherlands in 1940, fierce fighting took place over the airfield.

facts.text: The estate joined the Solleveld natural monument in 1990.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 1990 maakt het landgoed deel uit van het beschermd natuurmonument Solleveld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1990, the estate has been part of the protected natural monument Solleveld.

facts.text: The Blue Tram operated along the park from 1924 until 1957.
facts.sourceQuote: Langs het park en een stukje van de Kwekerijweg reed tussen 1924 & 1957 de Blauwe Tram.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Along the park and a section of Kwekerijweg, the Blue Tram ran between 1924 & 1957.

facts.text: Cycling is forbidden on the Park Route section passing through this park.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel de Parkenroute door het Hubertuspark loopt, mag er op dat deel van de fietsroute niet gefietst worden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although the Park Route runs through Hubertuspark, cycling is not allowed on that part of the cycling route.

facts.text: A steam tram ran here before 1924, though the park did not exist then.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor 1924 reed de stoomtram daar al, maar toen was het Hubertuspark er nog niet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Before 1924, the steam tram already ran there, but Hubertuspark was not yet there.

facts.text: One theory suggests the name honors Huybert Wouters, whose lane appeared on 1629 maps.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens een theorie is het gebied vernoemd naar Huybert Wouters. Op een kaart van 1629, gemaakt door Henricus Hondius, staat het “Huybert Wouters laentje” aangegeven op de weg die van de Denneweg naar het gebied leidt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to one theory, the area is named after Huybert Wouters. On a map of 1629, made by Henricus Hondius, the "Huybert Wouters laentje" is indicated on the road that leads from the Denneweg to the area.

facts.text: From 1880 until 1923, the site served as a gunpowder test ground and artillery training area.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1880 gaf de gemeente toestemming om het terrein te gebruiken voor buskruitproeven en als oefenterrein voor de artillerie. Dit duurde tot 1923.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1880, the municipality gave permission to use the site for gunpowder tests and as a training ground for the artillery. This lasted until 1923.

facts.text: During World War I the site served as an internment camp for British soldiers crossing from Belgium.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Eerste Wereldoorlog werd het terrein gebruikt als interneringskamp voor Britse militairen die vanuit België de Nederlandse grens waren overgestoken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War I, the site was used as an internment camp for British military personnel who had crossed the Dutch border from Belgium.

facts.text: Sand excavated here during canal construction was used to build Rotterdam's Delftsepoort station.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de aanleg van het Duinkanaal werd ook het naastgelegen duin afgegraven. Het zand werd gebruikt voor de aanleg van station Delftsepoort in Rotterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the construction of the Duinkanaal, the adjacent dune was also excavated. The sand was used for the construction of Delftsepoort station in Rotterdam.

facts.text: A Minangkabau house at a 1932 Indian exhibition drew significant attention from visitors.
facts.sourceQuote: Daar werd in 1932 een Indische tentoonstelling gehouden. Vooral het 'Minangkabause Huis' trok veel aandacht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An Indian exhibition was held there in 1932. Especially the 'Minangkabause House' attracted a lot of attention.

facts.text: Until mid-2007, the site hosted the Zuiderpark Stadium, home ground of football club fc/ADO The Hague.
facts.sourceQuote: In het park bevond zich tot medio 2007 het Zuiderparkstadion, de thuishaven van voetbalclub fc/ADO Den Haag, inmiddels gehuisvest in een nieuw stadion in het Forepark (Bingoal Stadion).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until mid-2007, the Zuiderpark Stadium was located in the park, the home ground of football club fc/ADO The Hague, which has since been housed in a new stadium in the Forepark (Bingoal Stadium).

facts.text: The district borders five other areas: Moerwijk, Morgenstond, Leyenburg, Rustenburg, and Oostbroek.
facts.sourceQuote: De wijk is onderdeel van stadsdeel Escamp en grenst aan de wijken Moerwijk, Morgenstond, Leyenburg en Rustenburg en Oostbroek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The district is part of the Escamp district and borders the districts Moerwijk, Morgenstond, Leyenburg and Rustenburg and Oostbroek.

facts.text: Garden architect Jan D. Zocher jr. transformed the landscape into an English garden during the 19th century.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 19e eeuw heeft de tuin- en landschapsarchitect Jan D. Zocher jr. de Koekamp veranderd in een Engelse tuin.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 19th century, the garden and landscape architect Jan D. Zocher jr. transformed the Koekamp into an English garden.

facts.text: During the 1940 invasion, Dutch radar equipment was stationed here to eavesdrop on German aircraft.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 10 mei 1940, bij de Duitse inval, stonden bij het hertenkamp enkele mitrailleurs en een van het Meetgebouw te Waalsdorp afkomstig elektrisch luistertoestel (Nederlandse radar). Met het luistertoestel werden Duitse vliegtuigen gepeild.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On May 10, 1940, during the German invasion, several machine guns and an electrical listening device (Dutch radar) from the Meetgebouw in Waalsdorp were stationed at the deer camp. The listening device was used to eavesdrop on German aircraft.

facts.text: A linen drapery house was established on the site during the seventeenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Eveneens in de 17e eeuw was er een lijndraaiershuis gevestigd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Also in the 17th century there was a linen drapery house established.

facts.text: A bicycle path on Koekamp bears the name Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov since 2015.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de centrumzijde van de Koekamp bevindt zich een fietspad dat sinds 2015 de naam Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov draagt, verwijzend naar de presidenten die in de jaren tachtig het einde van de Koude Oorlog inleidden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the center side of the Koekamp there is a bicycle path that has been called Laan van Reagan en Gorbatsjov since 2015, referring to the presidents who ushered in the end of the Cold War in the 1980s.

facts.text: Strong winds once powered mills and caused dust storms that prevented trees from growing for centuries.
facts.sourceQuote: Het landschap is glooiend en heeft een vrij kalkrijke bodem. Eeuwenlang bleven de gronden onbebost door overbeweiding, houtroof en verstuivingen. Er werd gejaagd en er waren schaapskooien en molens, die daar ruimschoots wind vingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The landscape is hilly and has a fairly calcareous soil. For centuries, the lands remained unplanted due to overgrazing, wood theft and dust storms. There was hunting and there were sheepfolds and mills, which caught plenty of wind there.

facts.text: The road through the dunes opened on December 5, 1666 after trees were planted to stop sand erosion.
facts.sourceQuote: Er kwamen bomen langs de weg om zandverstuivingen tegen te gaan. Op 5 december 1666 werd de weg geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Trees were planted along the road to combat sand erosion. On December 5, 1666, the road was opened.

facts.text: Jacob Cats built his country house Sorghvliet in the dunes and moved in during July 1652.
facts.sourceQuote: In het midden van de 17de eeuw liet Jacob Cats een buitenplaats bouwen in de duinen, die hij Sorghvliet noemde en die hij op 14 juli 1652 betrok.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the middle of the 17th century, Jacob Cats had a country house built in the dunes, which he called Sorghvliet and which he moved into on July 14, 1652.

facts.text: Between 1892 and 1895, the new forest section was created as a job project for unemployed workers.
facts.sourceQuote: Tussen 1892 en 1895 werden de Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes aangelegd als werkverschaffingsproject voor werklozen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1892 and 1895, the Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes were built as a job creation project for the unemployed.

facts.text: In 1864, the first horse-drawn tram line in the Benelux began running along the Scheveningseweg.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1864 ging de eerste paardentramlijn in de Benelux rijden over de Scheveningseweg, en korte tijd later ook aan de andere kant van het bosgebied, langs de Koninginnegracht, zodat een ringlijn tussen Centrum en Scheveningen ontstond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1864, the first horse-drawn tram line in the Benelux began operating over the Scheveningseweg, and shortly thereafter also on the other side of the wooded area, along the Koninginnegracht, so that a ring line between the City Center and Scheveningen was created.

facts.text: Wapendal derives from wapel, an old term for low-lying humid grazing land.
facts.sourceQuote: Wapendal is genoemd naar een oude benaming voor een laaggelegen vochtige plek, wapel, waar boeren hun vee lieten grazen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Wapendal is named after an old name for a low-lying humid place, wapel, where farmers let their livestock graze.

facts.text: Shetland ponies graze here to preserve original dune vegetation.
facts.sourceQuote: Beheersmaatregelen zoals plaggen, het selectief verwijderen van bomen en begrazing door Shetlandpony's moeten ervoor zorgen dat de oorspronkelijke duinbegroeiing behouden blijft.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Management measures such as clipping, selective removal of trees and grazing by Shetland ponies should ensure that the original dune vegetation is preserved.

facts.text: The estate once held two houses named De Roos and De Doorn, neither of which survives today.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het landgoed stonden twee huizen, De Roos en De Doorn. Beide bestaan niet meer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were two houses on the estate, De Roos and De Doorn. Neither exists anymore.

facts.text: The estate began as a farmer's farm first mentioned in 1561.
facts.sourceQuote: De buitenplaats kwam voort uit een boerenhoeve, die in 1561 voor het eerst genoemd werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The estate originated from a farmer's farm, which was first mentioned in 1561.

facts.text: Jacob Cats acquired the property known as Duinhoeve in 1644.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1644 kwam Duinhoeve in het bezit van Jacob Cats, wiens erfgenamen het in 1655 weer verkochten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1644 Duinhoeve came into the possession of Jacob Cats, whose heirs sold it again in 1655.

facts.text: The country house was demolished in the 1870s before the neighborhood was built.
facts.sourceQuote: In de jaren 70 van de 19de eeuw werd het huis gesloopt. De Archipelbuurt werd in de jaren 1869 - 1890 aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1870s, the house was demolished. The Archipelbuurt was built in the years 1869 - 1890.

features.name: Haagse Bos

facts.text: In 1576 William the Silent signed an Act of Redemption banning all future cutting or sale of the forest.
facts.sourceQuote: The so-called "Act of Redemption", signed on 1576 by William the Silent declared that no further cutting or sale of the forest would be permitted. This law still stands today.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The so-called "Act of Redemption", signed on 1576 by William the Silent declared that no further cutting or sale of the forest would be permitted. This law still stands today.

facts.text: German forces used the forest as a launch site for V-1 and V-2 rockets during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: In the Second World War the forest was used by the German Army as a launching place for their V-1 and V-2 rockets.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Second World War the forest was used by the German Army as a launching place for their V-1 and V-2 rockets.

facts.text: Haagse Bos means 'Forest of The Hague' in Dutch.
facts.sourceQuote: Haagse Bos (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌɦaːxsə ˈbɔs]; lit. 'Forest of The Hague') is a rectangular neighbourhood and forest in the Haagse Hout district of The Hague, Netherlands, reaching from the old city centre in the south-west to the border of Wassenaar in the north-east.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Haagse Bos (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌɦaːxsə ˈbɔs]; lit. 'Forest of The Hague') is a rectangular neighbourhood and forest in the Haagse Hout district of The Hague, Netherlands, reaching from the old city centre in the south-west to the border of Wassenaar in the north-east.

features.opening: Haagse Bos (Dutch pronunciation: [ˌɦaːxsə ˈbɔs]; lit.

facts.text: The General Civil Pension Fund originally used this site as its headquarters before other tenants arrived.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebouw was oorspronkelijk het hoofdkantoor van het Algemeen Burgerlijk Pensioenfonds.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was originally the headquarters of the General Civil Pension Fund.

facts.text: Sir Arend van Dorp bought the land in 1586 and moved into its main farm house.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1586 kocht jonkheer Arend van Dorp een stuk land met een boerenhoeve. Hij ging in het voorhuis wonen van de boerderij, de rest werd verpacht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1586, Sir Arend van Dorp bought a piece of land with a farmstead. He moved into the main house of the farm, the rest was rented out.

facts.text: An eight-sided two-floor pavilion built around 1650 is now known as the 'dome'.
facts.sourceQuote: Rond 1650 werd een apart paviljoen gebouwd, dat als buitenverblijf ging dienen. Dit achtkantige paviljoen van twee lagen onder een door pannen afgedekt tentdak, wordt sinds de twintigste eeuw de 'koepel' genoemd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1650, a separate pavilion was built, which was to serve as an outbuilding. This eight-sided pavilion of two floors under a tiled tent roof has been called the 'dome' since the twentieth century.

facts.text: A V2 rocket destroyed the Oostduin country house during the war before it was demolished in 1946.
facts.sourceQuote: Het landhuis op Oostduin werd in de oorlog door een V2 getroffen en werd in 1946 afgebroken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The country house on Oostduin was hit by a V2 during the war and was demolished in 1946.

facts.text: Part of the district was demolished in 1942-1943 to build the Atlantic Wall.
facts.sourceQuote: De groene villawijk werd gebouwd in de jaren 1910-1919 en tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog, in 1942-1943, voor een deel gesloopt ten behoeve van de aanleg van de Atlantikwall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The green villa district was built in the 1910s-1919 and during World War II, in 1942-1943, part of it was demolished for the construction of the Atlantic Wall.

facts.text: A 1959 deal gave the US new land and cash while transferring this site to the Dutch state.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1959 werd een overeenkomst getekend: de VS kreeg een nieuw terrein aan het Lange Voorhout plus een financiële compensatie van 2 miljoen dollar van Nederland. In ruil daarvoor droeg de VS Zorgvliet over aan de Nederlandse staat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1959, an agreement was signed: the US received new land at Lange Voorhout plus financial compensation of 2 million dollars from the Netherlands. In exchange, the US transferred Zorgvliet to the Dutch state.

facts.text: Johan de Wittlaan features high buildings constructed along the former tank ditch course.
facts.sourceQuote: In het wederopbouwplan van Dudok keerden de villa's niet terug, maar werd over het tracé van de tankgracht de Johan de Wittlaan met hoogbouw aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Dudok's reconstruction plan, the villas did not return, but the Johan de Wittlaan with high buildings was built along the course of the tank ditch.

facts.text: The name Sorghvliet means 'letting your worries fly away' or forgetting them.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam duidt op "je zorgen laten vlieden", oftewel je zorgen vergeten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name indicates "letting your worries fly away", or forgetting your worries.

facts.text: Poet and statesman Jacob Cats built the original country estate around 1643.
facts.sourceQuote: Zorgvliet of Sorghvliet werd rond 1643 als landgoed aangelegd door dichter en staatsman Jacob Cats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Zorgvliet or Sorghvliet was built around 1643 as a country estate by poet and statesman Jacob Cats.

facts.text: A wall surrounding the park was constructed in 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1920 werd de muur om het park gebouwd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1920 the wall around the park was built.

features.name: Malieveld

facts.text: Visitors often find this grassy expanse directly opposite The Hague's central train station.
facts.sourceQuote: Malieveld (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmaːlivɛlt] , lit. 'pall-mall field') is a large grass field in the city center of The Hague, Netherlands, located opposite the central train station.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Malieveld (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmaːlivɛlt] , lit. 'pall-mall field') is a large grass field in the city center of The Hague, Netherlands, located opposite the central train station.

facts.text: Anouk married her husband during a Malieveld concert attended by over 40,000 people in 2022.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2022, Anouk married her husband Dominique Schemmekes at the Malieveld during her concert there, attended by over 40,000 people.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2022, Anouk married her husband Dominique Schemmekes at the Malieveld during her concert there, attended by over 40,000 people.

facts.text: Bruce Springsteen performed at Malieveld for 67,500 people in 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: Other massive concerts at the Malieveld include Bruce Springsteen in 2016 (67,500 people), Muse in 2023 (67,000 people) and Coldplay in 2012 (65,000 people).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Other massive concerts at the Malieveld include Bruce Springsteen in 2016 (67,500 people), Muse in 2023 (67,000 people) and Coldplay in 2012 (65,000 people).

facts.text: Parkpop moved to Malieveld in 2022 after being held at Zuiderpark from 1981 to 2019.
facts.sourceQuote: Parkpop, a free festival that used be held annually in the Hague, was held at the Malieveld in 2022. From 1981 to 2019, it was held at the Zuiderpark.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Parkpop, a free festival that used be held annually in the Hague, was held at the Malieveld in 2022. From 1981 to 2019, it was held at the Zuiderpark.

features.opening: Malieveld (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmaːlivɛlt] , lit.

facts.text: Between 250 and 280 Dutch people were executed by German occupiers at Waalsdorpervlakte during World War II.
facts.sourceQuote: In het zuiden van Meijendel ligt de Waalsdorpervlakte waar in de Tweede Wereldoorlog tussen de 250 en 280 Nederlanders door de Duitse bezetters zijn geëxecuteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the south of Meijendel lies the Waalsdorpervlakte where between 250 and 280 Dutch people were executed by the German occupiers during World War II.

facts.text: The memorial features a stone with four bronze crosses behind it and a bell tower in the background.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bestaat uit een steen met daarachter vier bronzen kruisen; op de achtergrond staat een klokkenstoel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It consists of a stone with four bronze crosses behind it; in the background stands a bell tower.

facts.text: Meijendel belongs to the Natura-2000 zone known as Meijendel & Berkheide.
facts.sourceQuote: Meijendel maakt met Berkheide deel uit van het Natura-2000-gebied Meijendel & Berkheide en het toekomstige Nationaal Park Hollandse Duinen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Meijendel is part of the Natura-2000 area Meijendel & Berkheide and the future National Park Hollandse Duinen with Berkheide.

facts.text: A 1832 obelisk honors Swiss commander Nicholas Emanuel Frederick von Gumoëns, who died from injuries in the Ten-Day Campaign.
facts.sourceQuote: Tiendaagse Veldtocht Een monumentale obelisk uit 1832 gedenkt de Zwitserse opperbevelhebber Nicolaas Emanuel Frederik von Gumoëns, die vrijwillig tijdens de Tiendaagse Veldtocht betrokken was bij de verdediging van Antwerpen. Hij overleed later aan zijn verwondingen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Ten-Day Campaign A monumental obelisk from 1832 commemorates the Swiss Supreme Commander Nicholas Emanuel Frederick von Gumoëns, who volunteered during the Ten-Day Campaign to participate in the defense of Antwerp. He later died from his injuries.

facts.text: The Military Honor Square commemorates 167 soldiers who fell during the Battle of The Hague in May 1940.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Militair erehof Den Haag Kerkhoflaan gedenkt 167 militaire slachtoffers, gevallen tijdens de Slag om Den Haag in mei 1940.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Military Honor Square The Hague Kerkhoflaan commemorates 167 military victims, fallen during the Battle of The Hague in May 1940.

facts.text: A royal ban in 1829 forced the cemetery's opening in 1830 to stop church burials for public health.
facts.sourceQuote: De begraafplaats werd in 1830 in gebruik genomen, nadat er in 1829 een koninklijk verbod was uitgevaardigd om nog mensen in kerken te begraven, om redenen van de volksgezondheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cemetery was opened in 1830, after a royal ban was issued in 1829 prohibiting the burial of more people in churches, for reasons of public health.

facts.text: City architect Zeger Reyers designed this new burial ground on Kerkhoflaan.
facts.sourceQuote: De nieuwe begraafplaats aan de Kerkhoflaan werd ontworpen door de stadsarchitect Zeger Reyers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The new cemetery on Kerkhoflaan was designed by the city architect Zeger Reyers.

facts.text: In 1991, the Algemene Begraafplaats officially became a municipal cemetery.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1991 werd het een gemeentelijke begraafplaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1991 it became a municipal cemetery.

facts.text: The Dr. Abraham Schierbeek Tuin honors AVN chairman Dr. Abraham Schierbeek (1887-1974).
facts.sourceQuote: De vogeltuin is in 1928 opgericht door de AVN en genoemd naar hun toenmalige voorzitter, dr. Abraham Schierbeek (1887-1974).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The bird garden was founded in 1928 by the AVN and named after their then-chairman, Dr. Abraham Schierbeek (1887-1974).

facts.text: Visitors cannot enter the garden because it remains closed to the public.
facts.sourceQuote: De tuin is niet voor publiek geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The garden is not open to the public.

facts.text: The estate once held two houses named De Roos and De Doorn, neither of which survives today.
facts.sourceQuote: Op het landgoed stonden twee huizen, De Roos en De Doorn. Beide bestaan niet meer.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were two houses on the estate, De Roos and De Doorn. Neither exists anymore.

facts.text: German forces cut pine trees to create sharp anti-paratrooper spikes driven into the meadows.
facts.sourceQuote: De Duitsers haalden wel dennen uit het bos om ze te gebruiken om parachutisten af te weren. Er werden scherpe punten aan gemaakt, waarna ze in weilanden werden geprikt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Germans did cut down pine trees from the forest to use them to repel paratroopers. Sharp points were made to them, after which they were pierced into meadows.

facts.text: The forest survived WWII because it lay inside the protected Scheveningen Fortress zone.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog lagen de Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes binnen de Vesting Scheveningen, waardoor het bos gespaard bleef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, the Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes were located within the Scheveningen Fortress, which saved the forest.

facts.text: The project transformed just twenty hectares of thin, dry dunes where only helmgrass and moss once grew.
facts.sourceQuote: Het grote verschil was dat de Oostduinen veel schraler en droger waren zodat er slechts helmgras en mos groeide. Op 20 hectare hiervan werden de Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes aangelegd om het wonen in de omringende parken aantrekkelijker te maken.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The big difference was that the East Dunes were much thinner and drier so that only helmgrass and moss grew. On 20 hectares of this, the Nieuwe Scheveningse Bosjes were built to make living in the surrounding parks more attractive.

features.name: Landgoed Clingendael

facts.text: Landgoed Clingendael means valley in the dunes.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Clingendael means valley in the dunes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Clingendael means valley in the dunes.

facts.text: During WWII, Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart occupied the estate, leaving many bunkers in the grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: During World War II, the estate was confiscated by the Nazis and occupied by Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart. The many bunkers in the grounds of the estate date from this period.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During World War II, the estate was confiscated by the Nazis and occupied by Reichskommissar Arthur Seyss-Inquart. The many bunkers in the grounds of the estate date from this period.

facts.text: Landgoed Clingendael refers to a manor house and parkland established in the seventeenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Clingendael is the name of a 17th-century manor house and surrounding parkland just outside The Hague, Netherlands, in the municipality of Wassenaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Clingendael is the name of a 17th-century manor house and surrounding parkland just outside The Hague, Netherlands, in the municipality of Wassenaar.

features.opening: Clingendael is the name of a 17th-century manor house and surrounding parkland just outside The Hague, Netherlands, in the municipality of Wassenaar.

facts.text: A workshop for dismantling V1 flying bombs and V2 rockets was built on the grounds.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook werden er drie bunkers aangelegd en een werkplaats voor het afmonteren van V1-vliegende bommen en V2-raketten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Three bunkers were also built and a workshop for disassembling V1 flying bombs and V2 rockets.

facts.text: Radio pioneer Hanso Idzerda was executed by hanging under a beech tree on the estate.
facts.sourceQuote: Radio-omroeppionier Hanso Idzerda werd tijdens de Tweede Wereldoorlog op landgoed Oosterbeek onder een beukenboom standrechtelijk geëxecuteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Radio pioneer Hanso Idzerda was executed by hanging under a beech tree on Oosterbeek estate during World War II.

facts.text: Defensive bunkers and a tank ditch were constructed along the eastern side of the property.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de Duitse bezetting werd langs de oostelijke kant van Clingendael en Oosterbeek een tankgracht gegraven. Ook werden er drie bunkers aangelegd en een werkplaats voor het afmonteren van V1-vliegende bommen en V2-raketten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the German occupation, a tank ditch was dug along the eastern side of Clingendael and Oosterbeek. Three bunkers were also built and a workshop for disassembling V1 flying bombs and V2 rockets.

facts.text: Exotic bananas were already sold at this market in 1920.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo werden er al in 1920 exotische vruchten zoals bananen verkocht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, exotic fruits such as bananas were already sold in 1920.

facts.text: The market operates on four specific days: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday.
facts.sourceQuote: De markt is vier dagen per week geopend: maandag, woensdag, vrijdag en zaterdag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The market is open four days a week: Monday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday.

facts.text: Municipal officials claim this site ranks among the largest markets across all of Europe.
facts.sourceQuote: Volgens de gemeente is het een van de grootste markten van Europa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to the municipality, it is one of the largest markets in Europe.

facts.text: The movie Pizza Maffia filmed an action scene inside the Hubertustunnel.
facts.sourceQuote: Een actiescène uit de film Pizza Maffia is gedeeltelijk in deze tunnel opgenomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: An action scene from the movie Pizza Maffia was partially filmed in this tunnel.

facts.text: An assignment for the TV show The Phone took place within the Hubertustunnel in 2007.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2007 vond in aflevering 4 van The Phone een opdracht plaats in deze tunnel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2007, in episode 4 of The Phone, an assignment took place in this tunnel.

facts.text: The maximum speed limit inside the Hubertustunnel increased to 70 km/h in 2013.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2013 is de maximumsnelheid in de tunnel 70 km/u Voorheen bedroeg de maximumsnelheid in de tunnel 50 km/u.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2013, the maximum speed in the tunnel has been 70 km/h Previously, the maximum speed in the tunnel was 50 km/h.

facts.text: Together with the Sijtwendetunnel, it provides a fast route between Scheveningen and the A4 highway.
facts.sourceQuote: Samen met de Sijtwendetunnel door Leidschendam biedt dit traject een snelle verbinding tussen Scheveningen en de A4, ter ontlasting van de Utrechtsebaan (A12) en Waalsdorperweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with the Sijtwendetunnel through Leidschendam, this route offers a fast connection between Scheveningen and the A4, relieving the Utrechtsebaan (A12) and Waalsdorperweg.

facts.text: The House of Representatives temporarily occupied this building starting August 23, 2021.
facts.sourceQuote: De achteruitgang van deze kazerne was waar later op Kazernestraat 52 de Hoge Raad der Nederlanden zijn kantoor had. Sinds 23 augustus 2021 is in dat kantoorgebouw tijdelijk de Eerste Kamer gezeteld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The decline of this barracks was where later on Kazernestraat 52 the High Council of the Netherlands had its office. Since August 23, 2021, the House of Representatives has been temporarily housed in that office building.

facts.text: A single alley named Kleine Kazernestraat connects this street to the Lange Voorhout.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is slechts één straatje dat de Kazernestraat met het Lange Voorhout verbindt, de Kleine Kazernestraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There is only one alley that connects the Kazernestraat with the Lange Voorhout, the Kleine Kazernestraat.

facts.text: Bibliotheekstraat is only 7 meters long and 2 meters wide.
facts.sourceQuote: Dan is even verderop links een kort, breed, doodlopend zijstraatje, de Bibliotheekstraat, tevens de kortste straat van Den Haag. Deze kortste straat is maar 7 meter lang en 2 meter breed.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Then just further up on the left is a short, wide, dead-end side street, the Bibliotheekstraat, also the shortest street in The Hague. This shortest street is only 7 meters long and 2 meters wide.

facts.text: The canal was once called Rotterdamse Veerkade because tugboats to Rotterdam departed from here.
facts.sourceQuote: In de loop van de eeuwen veranderde de naam van de gracht herhaaldelijk van onofficiële naam – officiële straatnaambordjes en naamgeving zoals we in de 21e eeuw toepassen, bestonden nog niet – en zo werden benamingen als Eerste, Tweede en Derde Veerkade en Rotterdamse Veerkade (omdat de trekschuit naar Rotterdam er toen vertrok) gehanteerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over the centuries, the name of the canal changed repeatedly from unofficial name - official street signs and naming as we apply them in the 21st century did not yet exist - and so names such as Eerste, Tweede and Derde Veerkade and Rotterdamse Veerkade (because the tugboat to Rotterdam left then) were used.

facts.text: Until 1900, stagecoaches to Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht arrived and departed from this canal.
facts.sourceQuote: Tot zeker 1900 was de gracht aankomst- en vertrekpunt van pakschuitdiensten naar Amsterdam, Rotterdam en Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 1900, the canal was the arrival and departure point of stagecoach services to Amsterdam, Rotterdam and Utrecht.

facts.text: The canal served as a garbage dump and sewer before being silenced to create a traffic artery.
facts.sourceQuote: Redenen waren er te over: de grachten werden als afvalbak en riool gebruikt, wat zorgde voor veel stankoverlast; daarnaast was er verkeersoverlast, wegtrekken van de bedrijvigheid naar industriegebieden, en de opkomst van het goederenverkeer per trein en vrachtwagen in plaats van per boot. In de visie van het gemeentebestuur was een gedempte gracht een mooier en hygiënischer gezicht en kon door de plotseling verkregen breedte een verkeersader worden aangelegd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were too many reasons: the canals were used as a garbage dump and sewer, which caused a lot of nuisance; in addition, there was traffic nuisance, the withdrawal of business to industrial areas, and the rise of freight traffic by train and truck instead of by boat. In the vision of the municipal government, a culvert was a prettier and more hygienic appearance and could be used to lay a traffic artery due to the suddenly acquired width.

facts.text: In 2005, this street was declared the dirtiest in the Netherlands due to severe air pollution levels.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2005 was deze straat in het nieuws, omdat het de vuilste (qua luchtvervuiling) straat van Nederland zou zijn.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2005, this street was in the news because it would be the dirtiest (in terms of air pollution) street in the Netherlands.

facts.text: Willem II built a palace on an island in the dune lake in 1248.
facts.sourceQuote: In this dune lake there was an island (not the current island in the Hofvijver) on which Willem II built his palace in 1248.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In this dune lake there was an island (not the current island in the Hofvijver) on which Willem II built his palace in 1248.

facts.text: Count Albert defined the pond's rectangular shape during the 14th century.
facts.sourceQuote: Count Albert decided on the rectangular shape in the 14th century.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Count Albert decided on the rectangular shape in the 14th century.

facts.text: The central island was created roughly 300 years ago for unknown reasons.
facts.sourceQuote: The island in the Vijverberg, as known in its present form, was only created around 300 years ago. How or why it was created is unknown.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The island in the Vijverberg, as known in its present form, was only created around 300 years ago. How or why it was created is unknown.

facts.text: Protesters have occupied the island and displayed banners during demonstrations.
facts.sourceQuote: On a number of demonstrations the island has been occupied, and there have been banners displayed on the island.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On a number of demonstrations the island has been occupied, and there have been banners displayed on the island.

facts.text: The lake holds approximately 32,000 cubic meters of water within its central basin.
facts.sourceQuote: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands. its water volume approximately is 32000 m³ ( 26 ac ft ) It is adjoined in the east by the Korte Vijverberg road, in the south by the Binnenhof and the Mauritshuis, in the west by the Buitenhof and in the north by the Lange Vijverberg road.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands. its water volume approximately is 32000 m³ ( 26 ac ft ) It is adjoined in the east by the Korte Vijverberg road, in the south by the Binnenhof and the Mauritshuis, in the west by the Buitenhof and in the north by the Lange Vijverberg road.

features.opening: The Hofvijver (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈɦɔˌfɛivər]; English: Court Pond) is a small lake in the centre of The Hague, Netherlands.

facts.sourceQuote: Een gordel is ring-, of cirkelvormig, de Singelsgracht van Den Haag heeft een andere (hoekige) vorm.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A belt is ring- or circular in shape, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape.

facts.text: In 1345, the canal was widened and connected to the Vliet via the Zieke.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1345 werd dit kanaal, dat de eerste Haagse gracht kan worden genoemd, verbreed en door het graven van het Zieke en in het verlengde daarvan de Haagse Trekvliet aangesloten op de Vliet die tussen Delft en Leiden loopt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1345, this canal, which can be called the first Haagse canal, was widened and connected to the Vliet that runs between Delft and Leiden by digging the Zieke and, in the extension of it, the Haagse Trekvliet.

facts.text: The name Laak shares a linguistic connection with the river Lek.
facts.sourceQuote: Het woord heeft een samenhang met de riviernaam Lek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The word has a connection to the river name Lek.

facts.text: Historically, water flowed through this channel to discharge into the Haagvliet.
facts.sourceQuote: Via de Laak werd het water afgevoerd richting de Haagvliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Through the Laak, the water was discharged towards the Haagvliet.

facts.text: The name Kerstanje may derive from a chestnut tree, the personal name Kerstant, or Christmas.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kanaal werd misschien naar een kastanjeboom genoemd. Ook bestaat de mogelijkheid dat het verwijst naar een persoonsnaam, Kerstant. Misschien behoort een verkleinwoord van Kerst nog tot de mogelijkheden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The channel may have been named after a chestnut tree. There is also the possibility that it refers to a personal name, Kerstant. Perhaps a diminutive of Christmas is still possible.

facts.text: Westlanders used this channel to transport horticultural goods to Leiden and Amsterdam by barge.
facts.sourceQuote: De Kerstanje was een belangrijke vaarverbinding van en naar het Westland. De Westlanders gebruikten de Kerstanje om met hun schuiten hun tuinbouwproducten in Leiden en Amsterdam op de markt te brengen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Kerstanje was an important waterway connection from and to the Westland. The Westlanders used the Kerstanje to market their horticultural products in Leiden and Amsterdam with their barges.

facts.text: Romantic painter Andreas Schelfhout moved his family to Koninginnegracht 6 in 1842.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1842 verhuisde de Romantische landschapsschilder Andreas Schelfhout (1787-1870) met zijn gezin van de Zuidwal naar Koninginnegracht 6.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1842, the Romantic landscape painter Andreas Schelfhout (1787-1870) moved with his family from the Zuidwal to Koninginnegracht 6.

facts.text: Joseph Israëls lived at Koninginnegracht 6 starting in 1871 before moving to number 2.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1871 betrok Jozef Israëls (1824-1911) dezelfde Koninginnegracht 6, maar twee jaar later verhuisde hij naar nummer 2.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1871, Joseph Israëls (1824-1911) moved into the same Koninginnegracht 6, but two years later he moved to number 2.

facts.text: The route was initially called Koninginnelaan before changing to Koninginnegracht upon completion.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens het graven van de gracht sprak men over de Koninginnelaan, toen de gracht klaar was veranderde dit in Koninginnegracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the digging of the canal, they spoke about the Koninginnelaan, when the canal was finished this changed to Koninginnegracht.

facts.text: In 1890, the first electric trams in the Benelux ran here using batteries.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1890 reden hier de eerste elektrische trams in de Benelux, met accu's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1890, the first electric trams in the Benelux ran here, with batteries.

facts.text: The Hague Zoo stood on the opposite bank until it closed in 1943 due to the war.
facts.sourceQuote: Aan de overkant van de Koninginnegracht lag de Haagse Dierentuin, die in 1943 moest sluiten wegens de oorlog.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the other side of the Koninginnegracht was the Hague Zoo, which had to close in 1943 due to the war.

facts.text: Binckhorsthaven was constructed in the 1930s as a job creation project.
facts.sourceQuote: De Binckhorsthaven is deel van een in Den Haag in de jaren dertig van de 20e eeuw als werkgelegenheidsproject aangelegde haven en bedrijventerrein De Binckhorst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Binckhorsthaven is part of a port and industrial park De Binckhorst built in The Hague in the 1930s as a job creation project.

facts.sourceQuote: Ook Haagse Vliet of Haagvliet mogen in het dagelijks verkeer worden gebruikt, maar Trekvliet alleen is fout, omdat er bij Leiden, tussen de Oude Rijn en Vliet, nog een watergang bestaat met de naam Trekvliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Haagse Vliet or Haagvliet may also be used in daily traffic, but Trekvliet alone is wrong, because there is still another waterway in Leiden, between the Old Rhine and Vliet, with the name Trekvliet.

facts.text: Count William IV ordered the canal dug between 1344 and 1345 to connect local waterways.
facts.sourceQuote: De Haagse Trekvliet, ook bekend als Haagse Vliet, Haagvliet of Trekvliet, is een kanaal dat in 1344-1345 werd gegraven in opdracht van graaf Willem IV van Holland, als verbinding van het Haagse grachtenstelsel met de Vliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Haagse Trekvliet, also known as Haagse Vliet, Haagvliet or Trekvliet, is a canal that was dug in 1344-1345 at the behest of Count William IV of Holland, as a connection of the Hague canal system with the Vliet.

facts.text: Haagse Trekvliet officially joined The Hague territory during a municipal reorganization in July 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kanaal vormt praktisch gezien de grens tussen de Nederlandse steden Voorburg en Rijswijk, al behoort de Trekvliet zelf sinds de gemeentelijke herindeling van 2 juli 2001 tot het grondgebied van de gemeente Den Haag.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Practically speaking, the canal forms the border between the Dutch cities Voorburg and Rijswijk, although the Trekvliet itself has been part of the territory of the municipality of The Hague since the municipal reorganization of July 2, 2001.

facts.text: Mayor Copes of Cattenburch began digging the canal in 1825 to boost trade.
facts.sourceQuote: Copes van Cattenburch, sinds 1823 burgemeester van Den Haag, wilde de handel helpen en liet in 1825 een begin maken van de werkzaamheden om Het Kanaal te graven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Copes of Cattenburch, mayor of The Hague since 1823, wanted to help the trade and began work in 1825 to dig Het Kanaal.

facts.text: Construction paused due to problems until resuming in 1852 and finishing in 1863.
facts.sourceQuote: Financiële en technische problemen legden het werk in 1834 stil, maar in 1852 konden zij hervat worden. In 1862–1863 was Het Kanaal klaar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Financial and technical problems stopped the work in 1834, but in 1852 it could be resumed. In 1862–1863 Het Kanaal was ready.

facts.text: The canal featured two side arms known as the Shell Hole and the Beam Hole.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Kanaal had twee zijarmen: het Schelpengat bij de Neptunusstraat en het Balkengat bij de Seinpoststraat.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Het Kanaal had two side arms: the Shell Hole near Neptunusstraat and the Beam Hole near Seinpoststraat.

facts.text: Scheveningen became a major herring port before finally receiving a seaport in 1904.
facts.sourceQuote: Mede hierdoor is Scheveningen de belangrijkste haringhaven van Nederland geworden. Scheveningen kreeg uiteindelijk pas in 1904 een zeehaven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This has contributed to Scheveningen becoming the most important herring port in the Netherlands. Scheveningen did not finally get a seaport until 1904.
